name: Běh Labským údolím
location: Dolní Žleb, Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: LABÁCI (Děčínský horolezecký oddíl a Klub orientačního běhu Děčín)
description: The Run through the Elbe Valley is a traditional autumn running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Dolní Žleb, near Děčín. The race offers routes of various lengths, running mainly along forest roads and trails over varied terrain. It is organised by the Labáci group, which continues the long-standing tradition of local organisers. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including veterans and youth.
course_highlights: 16 km main course and 8 km shorter course over varied terrain
Mostly forest roads and trails
Picturesque autumn setting in the Elbe Valley
additional: Race-day check-in takes place from 10:45 at the “U Kosti” pub in Dolní Žleb. Travelling to the race by train is recommended. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup. Registration will open during spring 2026. Registration runs until 30 October 2025; the start is scheduled for 1 November at 12:00, with check-in until 10:45. Train transport from Děčín is available.

name: TRAIL LÁZNĚ VELICHOVKY
location: Lázně Velichovky, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trail Lázně Velichovky is the third edition of an autumn trail race in the historic spa town of Velichovky. It offers varied and beautiful running terrain, with the start and finish on the spa colonnade, where covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant are available. The race is complemented by spa amenities, including a café, and offers original medals, gifts and a race pack. The atmosphere is friendly, and the race is suitable for all lovers of trail running and spa surroundings.
course_highlights: The most colourful autumn running terrain
Start and finish on the spa colonnade
Covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant
additional: The race includes an original medal, race pack, electronic timing chip, refreshments during the race and at the finish, changing rooms, baggage storage, toilets, medical services and an accompanying programme. Gladiator Race clothing is also available for purchase, and parking is available near the event centre. Online registration via reg-sportvisio.cz, medals, chip timing, course photos, certificates, refreshments and spa services.

location: stadion Čelákovice, Čelákovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: přátelé a sportovní nadšenci z Hitgymu

description: Jizerun is a relay race connecting Prague and the Jizera Mountains. Teams of 4–5 runners cover a total of 164 km along cycle paths and Jizera Mountain trails in a single day. The race offers a unique team experience, with a choice of two entry packages featuring different benefits such as a sports T-shirt, headband, evening buffet and finisher medals. The event is open to men’s, women’s, mixed and corporate relay teams and is supported by general partner Metrostav a.s.
course_highlights: 164 km route from Prague to the Jizera Mountains
A combination of cycle paths and Jizera Mountain trails
Relays for teams of 4–5, with each runner completing at least 3 legs
additional: Entry packages are for teams of 5. The RUN&FUN package includes T-shirts, headbands, a buffet dinner, finisher medals, refreshments, race bibs, GPS tracking and a finisher party with live music. The NO FUN, JUST RUN package includes finisher medals, refreshments, race bibs, GPS tracking and a finisher party. Facilities and services include mobile toilets, showers at the finish, medical services, an announcer and full event support. When registering, the captain’s details must be provided; team members and T-shirt sizes can be added later. Each team member must run at least 3 legs, and only one car per team is allowed. The race supports a fundraiser for hospice and hospice care in the Czech Republic. Registration opens in April 2026.

name: Běh kolem Práchně
description: Běh kolem Práchně is a traditional running race in Horažďovice, offering a 9.5 km course. Since 2024, the updated route has followed the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit. The start and finish are located in front of Envicentrum PROUD, which provides runners with facilities including changing rooms, toilets and refreshments. The results are announced at approximately 12:00 after the race. The event is organized by DDM Horažďovice and KČT Horažďovice, who ensure a pleasant atmosphere and a smooth event.
course_highlights: The 9.5 km course follows the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit
Start and finish in front of Envicentrum PROUD, with full facilities
A mixed-type race in the picturesque surroundings of Horažďovice
additional: The results are announced at approximately 12:00 at Envicentrum PROUD, where refreshments, changing rooms and toilets are available. The course follows the Horažďovice Green Walking Circuit, with the start and finish in front of Envicentrum PROUD and refreshments and facilities available after the race.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - listopad
description: The 2 Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is welcomed at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward for their effort.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt circuit, just under two laps long (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children up to 12 years old (boys and girls). Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in both adult and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get to the start include by bike, on foot, by car, on roller skates, or by trolleybus no. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). Races take place on the first Saturday of every month, start at 9:00, and registration is from 8:15 to 8:55; you can arrive by bike, on foot, by car, or by trolleybus. The course is a precisely measured asphalt circuit; the main course is 3.2 km long and the children's course is 800 m long.

name: Memoriál MUDr. Josefa Podmolíka - Běžecký festival Otrokovice 2026
description: The Otrokovice Running Festival is a traditional sporting event offering a wide range of races, including a marathon, half marathon, half-marathon relay, decamarathon and youth races. The MUDr. Josef Podmolík Memorial is the flagship half-marathon race, held in the beautiful surroundings of Otrokovice. Runners can enjoy a well-maintained course with electronic timing and the atmosphere of a running festival with a varied program for all age groups. Race check-in and the awards ceremony take place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and marathon courses in Otrokovice with chip timing
A 4.2195 km decamarathon loop
Youth races over various distances from 200 m to 1,700 m
additional: Race check-in takes place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall. Runners must collect their race number and chip for electronic timing. Winners are presented with their awards after each race in turn, and winners are required to attend the ceremony. Registration is by email. The event includes various age groups and races on city streets and at the sports hall.

name: Svatojánská 20
location: TJ Lokomotiva Beroun, Beroun, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Svatojánská 20 is a traditional running race held in Beroun, offering two main routes of 11 and 18 kilometres. The start and finish are at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium. The routes run mainly on paved roads and cycle paths along the Berounka River and the Loděnice Stream, with turnarounds at the settlement of V Kozle (11 km) and in Svatý Jan pod Skálou (18 km). The race is open to a wide range of age groups and offers refreshments at the finish, as well as cash and non-cash prizes for the top runners.
course_highlights: The routes run mainly on paved roads and cycle paths along the Berounka River and the Loděnice Stream
The 11 km route turns around at the settlement of V Kozle; the 18 km route turns around in Svatý Jan pod Skálou
The start and finish are at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium
additional: On-site check-in and registration on race day from 11:00 to 12:40. Runners who register in advance and pay by 5 November will receive a race number bearing their name. Finish-line refreshments include tea and biscuits. The race takes place in open traffic; participants must obey traffic regulations and take part at their own risk. Parking is available around the stadium; nearby car parks are recommended because of the blue parking zones. Online and on-site registration are available. Medals and certificates are awarded, and cash prizes are paid.

name: Kovářská pětka
location: Baťovský areál, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Kovárna VIVA a spolkem Běhy Zlín
description: Kovářská pětka is a traditional 5-kilometre city road race held in the Baťa complex in Zlín. The race is open to both adults and children and is organised by Kovárna VIVA in cooperation with the Běhy Zlín association. The event offers a high-quality sporting experience in the centre of the regional capital, with international participation. It attracts a wide running community every year and is known for its friendly atmosphere and well-organised proceedings.
course_highlights: The course runs through the former Baťa complex in Zlín
A 5-kilometre road race in an urban setting
The race is suitable for adults and children
additional: The race is part of a year-round competition for runners from the Zlín region. The organisers provide online results and event photos. Children’s categories are also included. The event provides professional timing and support for the regional running community. It is part of a series of races in Zlín, offers various age categories and is suitable for the general public.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - listopad
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running levels, including children up to 12 years old, who run 1.6 km. The race is suitable for slow and fast runners, experienced runners and beginners who want to improve their personal best, train, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park setting. After the finish, everyone receives a warm cinnamon pancake. Times are recorded for every participant and results are published online; they count toward the year-round Lívancový Cup.
course_highlights: The course runs along Stromovka’s paved paths
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km); children run 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful setting of Královská obora–Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate area (beneath the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45. Online pre-registration is available for faster check-in. Arriving by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop) is recommended. Parking is available by the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. Tents are available for changing and leaving belongings (unattended), along with a mobile valuables storage service. Toilet cabins are available on site. Start at 9:07; registration from 8:15 to 8:45; online registration available. The race takes place in Královská obora–Stromovka Park. Parking is by the bridge to Císařský Island; changing facilities and toilets are available.

name: Labský půlmaraton
location: Lysá nad Labem, Lysá nad Labem, Středočeský, Czech Republic
description: The Labský Half Marathon is a running race held in Lysá nad Labem, offering two courses of approximately 12.5 km and 21.3 km. The routes pass through the flat Polabí forest, on a mix of paved and unpaved roads, trails, and short sections of asphalt or concrete. The start and finish are at the racecourse, where refreshments, baggage storage, and other facilities are available. The race is suitable for the general public and is limited to 700 participants. The program also includes children’s races with distances varying by age.
course_highlights: The courses are flat and run through the beautiful Polabí forest
Start after approximately 1 km on the racecourse
Refreshment stations at km 8 and 17 on the 21 km course, and one station at km 8 on the 12 km course
additional: The race is limited to 700 participants. Baggage storage, changing tents, toilets, refreshments, and a raffle are available for runners. Parking in the venue costs 50 CZK per car. Children’s races range from 200 to 1,000 metres depending on age. The route is marked with ribbons, signs, and flour arrows, and each kilometre is marked approximately. The race includes children’s races, registration is available online, and the route may be modified due to reconstruction work in the area.

name: Závod dvojic
description: Hostivařské dvojice is a relay running race for pairs, offering a unique team-running experience in the beautiful surroundings of Hostivař. The race is for pairs who want to enjoy a sporting challenge as well as the friendly atmosphere. The route passes through scenic terrain and is suitable for runners of all levels. Come for a run and enjoy a great sporting event in a welcoming community.
course_highlights: Relay race in pairs
Scenic surroundings of Hostivař
Friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, in Kladno. It is a team relay event, and registration is available online.

name: Hornická desítka
location: Národní dům, Frýdek-Místek, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hornická desítka is a traditional running race held in Frýdek-Místek. It has been held since 1980, with interruptions, and the tradition was revived in 1996. The event offers various running disciplines, including youth races, a Run for Health and the main 10 km race. It celebrates exercise and sporting spirit, attracting hundreds to thousands of participants of all ages. It is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere. The race starts at the National House in Frýdek-Místek and is suitable for the general public, including families with children.
course_highlights: The course runs in the Frýdek-Místek area; the event dates back to 1980
A main 10 km race, accompanied by youth races and a Run for Health
Start and finish at the National House in Frýdek-Místek
additional: The event includes a non-competitive parents-and-children run, youth races, a Run for Health and the main 10 km race. It is known for its excellent organization and relaxed atmosphere. The organizer is Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s. The race takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at the National House in Frýdek-Místek. The event involves road closures and traffic measures.

name: Malá Pardubická cross country
location: Labe and vicinity, near TJ Dynamo canoe club, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Malá Pardubická - cross country is a traditional cross-country race organized by the AC Pardubice athletics club. The race takes place near the Elbe River and close to the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoe club. The organizers warmly invite all runners and running fans to this popular event, which offers a sporting experience in a natural setting. The race regulations and further information are available on the club’s website.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on natural terrain near the Elbe River
Start and finish close to the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoe club
A traditional running event organized by AC Pardubice
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, is open to the general public, including children and young people, and is part of the local sports calendar.

description: Jizerun is a relay running race from Prague to the Jizera Mountains, following the Jizera River. Teams of 4–5 runners cover a total of 165 km along cycle paths and trails in the Jizera Mountains in a single day. The race offers a unique sporting experience and the chance to work as a team in men’s, women’s, mixed, and corporate categories. The route is divided into several stages of varying difficulty, allowing each runner to choose a suitable segment.
course_highlights: A 165 km route from Prague to the Jizera Mountains along cycle paths and trails
A relay race for teams of 4–5 in several categories
Stages with difficulty ratings from 1 to 8 on a 10-point scale, across varied terrain
additional: The entry fee includes timing, GPX tracking and the JIZERUN app, portable toilets, finish-area facilities including showers, a speaker and sound system, medical services throughout the race, gifts from partners, photos and video, and full event staffing and all relevant permits. The route is divided into 14 stages of varying lengths and difficulty; for example, the Bradlec–Klášter stage is 14.7 km and rated 7/10. The 2026 edition is sold out; the organizer mentions a waiting list. Teams consist of four or five runners.

description: The Run Against Addiction is a running race in Homolka Forest Park in Plzeň, with courses for different age groups, from children to adults. The route follows paved paths and includes both flat children’s courses and the varied terrain of the 6 km main race. There is also a relay race for teams of three, with each runner completing one lap. The event is suitable for runners of all abilities who want to support the fight against addiction and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in nature.
course_highlights: The route follows paved paths in Homolka Forest Park
The 6 km main race features varied terrain and three laps
The children’s courses are flat and adapted to different age groups
additional: Race numbers are distributed from 9:00 to 10:30. Children’s races begin at 10:00, with staggered starts by age group. The men’s and women’s main races and the relay start at 11:30. The relay has three runners, each completing one lap of approximately 2,000 m. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 12:15. A recommended route is available on Garmin Connect as a single lap, which will be run three times during the race. The organizer lists children’s races and a 6 km race; Kudy z nudy also lists a 3 × 2 km relay for 2026. The race regulations available on the organizer’s website are for the 2024 and 2025 editions, so prices from those editions have not been assigned to the 2026 race.

description: Gorlicki Mountain Run is an annual running event held in the scenic surroundings of Radocyna and Magura Małastowska in the Low Beskids. The event offers three distances: 7.6 km, 23.9 km, and a 2.3 km Vertical race with significant elevation gain. It attracts both amateurs and elite runners, offering a unique atmosphere and cash prizes. The participant limit is 400, and the start and finish are located at the State Forests Holiday Resort “Radocyna” and Magura Ski Park. This is the event’s eleventh edition, combining sporting competition with the beauty of mountain nature.
course_highlights: 24 km course with 610 m of elevation gain
7 km course with 160 m of elevation gain
2.3 km Vertical with 340 m of elevation gain to Magura Małastowska
additional: Participant limit: 400 (150 for 7 km, 250 for 24 km). Start and finish at the State Forests Holiday Resort “Radocyna.” Race office open from 7:45 to 10:00. The time limit for the 24 km race is 5 hours. Runners must attach their bibs to the front of their shirt or shorts. Participants with a Rate My Trail ranking of 730 points or higher may enter free of charge. The courses include mountain trails and muddy sections, and the start is scheduled for 10:30. The event attracts both amateurs and experienced trail runners.

name: FUSS EGY NAPOT!
description: “Run for a Day!” is an ultrarunning event held at Benkó Zoltán Park in Kecskemét. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and create a shared community sports experience. Runners can test their abilities over various distances in a friendly and supportive environment. The program includes a carnival atmosphere and the joy of exercising together.
course_highlights: Ultrarunning around Benkó Hill
Varied terrain close to nature
A community spirit and carnival atmosphere
additional: Participants can choose from several distances. The registration deadline is November 5, 2025. Options for changing clothes and equipment at the venue are limited, and access to the lake during the run is not guaranteed.

name: HALLOWEEN RUN
description: Halloween Run 2026 is a special, exciting running event in Budapest, held on the grounds and in the cellar system of the former Kőbánya Brewery. During the race, participants run along a dark, spooky course accompanied by frightening characters and eerie effects. Races are held over various distances, from short tours to longer multi-lap events, so everyone can find a suitable option. At the finish, music and celebrations await the brave participants who have overcome the challenges.
course_highlights: Course on the grounds and in the cellar system of the former Kőbánya Brewery
Dark, spooky visuals and frightening effects
A variety of distances, including a 21 km lap race and running through a tunnel
additional: The event takes place at Rottenbiller Park in Budapest's 10th district. It is easily accessible by public transport, but parking is limited. The program includes several races, from 2.5 km Halloween tours to a 21 km individual and relay race. On-site registration is available up to 45 minutes before the race start, provided online registration has not filled up. The awards ceremony begins at 15:40. Multiple races, a themed dark atmosphere, various distances, venue: Rottenbiller Park, Budapest, online and on-site registration, awards ceremonies.

name: VASKAPU TRAIL
organizer: Esztergomi Triatlon Kulturális és Szabadidősport Egyesület
description: The Vaskapu Trail is a nature-focused trail-running race in Esztergom, offering runners a challenge over three distances: 8 km, 16 km and 22 km. The course follows trails and marked hiking paths, with minimal road sections, allowing participants to enjoy the natural scenery and varied terrain. The event is environmentally conscious, with cup-free aid stations and support for the Green Forest program. The start and finish are at the Vaskapu Restaurant, at the Brilli Gyula shelter, where participants can also use changing rooms and bag storage.
course_highlights: Trail running on paths and marked hiking routes
Three distances: 8 km, 16 km and 22 km, with varied levels of difficulty
Minimal road sections for a nature-focused experience
additional: The race uses chip timing; chips are issued against a 2,000 HUF deposit. The event is cup-free, so participants must bring a hydration vest or their own cup. Race-pack collection takes place at the race center on race day; earlier collection is not available. Entries may be cancelled until 2026.10.15; after that, they can only be transferred to the following year. The race center has separate women’s and men’s changing rooms and a built-in toilet, but no washbasin. All finishers receive a finisher’s medal, and the top three women and men overall receive separate awards. Participants must bring the equipment needed for hydration. Changing rooms and bag storage are available on site, and environmentally friendly solutions are used to support participants.

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Strážske
description: Beh oslobodenia mesta Strážske je tradičný bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná na počesť výročia oslobodenia mesta. Tento športový sviatok priláka bežcov rôznych vekových kategórií, vrátane mládeže a dospelých, ktorí súťažia na rôznych dĺžkach tratí. Podujatie organizuje mesto Strážske v spolupráci s bežeckým klubom MBO Strážske a je známe svojou dlhou históriou a silnou komunitnou atmosférou. Bežci si môžu užiť atmosféru mesta a zároveň si zmerať sily v priateľskom a súťažnom prostredí.
course_highlights: Viacero kategórií vrátane mládeže a dospelých
Štart pred budovou Mestského úradu v Strážskom
Tradičný beh s dlhou históriou a komunitnou podporou
additional: Podujatie má dlhoročnú tradíciu, v roku 2026 sa uskutoční 49. ročník. Bežci sú rozdelení do viacerých vekových kategórií vrátane predškolákov, žiakov a dospelých. Po behu sa oceňujú najrýchlejší v jednotlivých kategóriách a organizuje sa tombola s hodnotnými cenami. Trať vedie mestom Strážske s cieľom pred budovou Mestského úradu.

name: Žandovská desítka
description: Žandovská desítka is a traditional 10-kilometer race held in Žandov in the Liberec Region. The event is part of the Českolipsko District Running League and welcomes runners of all ages. The course runs on both roads and trails, offering varied surroundings for competitors. The race is popular with the regional running community and provides an opportunity to challenge yourself and meet fellow running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The course runs on both roads and trails
Part of the regional Českolipsko running league
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race takes place in November 2026. Registration and further details are not specified. The event is part of a broader series of regional races.

name: Dobřichovický běh
location: Škvárový stadion TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Dobřichovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Run is part of the Brdy Running Cup and offers runners a course approximately 6 km long. The race starts at the cinder track at TJ Sokol Dobřichovice and follows farm roads, providing pleasant running terrain. The event is suitable for both adults and children, who have their own races. The main race starts at 13:00 and is organized by ASK Dipoli.
course_highlights: Course approximately 6 km long
Starts at the cinder track at TJ Sokol Dobřichovice
The course follows farm roads
additional: Start location: TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Pražská 375. The course was measured by GPS at 5.72 km, though the race information lists it as 6 km. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup, which also includes children's races. The course combines a cinder track and farm roads. The course includes a cinder track and farm roads; online registration is available; races are suitable for all age groups.

name: Velká kunratická
location: Kunratický les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Velká kunratická is one of the oldest running races in the Czech lands. It is held every year on the second Sunday in November in Kunratice Forest in Prague. The race has been run continuously since 1934 and is known for its challenging course and changeable weather, which contribute to its unique atmosphere. A wide range of runners take part, from young children to veterans, competing on six courses ranging from 370 to 3,100 metres. The event is organised by the Spartak Praha 4 athletics club.
course_highlights: Challenging courses through Kunratice Forest
Six courses ranging from 370 m to 3,100 m
Wave starts in pairs, with a 10-second interval
additional: All categories start in pairs at 10-second intervals. Official BUSHMAN-brand T-shirts are available exclusively during registration. Ordered T-shirts can be collected at the tent on the dam. The total number of participants is limited to 3,600, with a limit of 2,700 runners on the route over Hrádek. Registration changes can be made by email until 14 October 2026; after that, they can only be made at check-in. The race takes place in November, with the number of participants limited to 3,400. Online registration opens on 5 October 2026, and on-site registration is available. There are various age and performance categories.

description: Krumlovská 11 is a St. Martin’s charity run held on 8 November 2026 at Hornobránský Pond in Český Krumlov. It offers a main run of approximately 11 km for runners aged 15 and over, a family run for children aged 2 to 15, and relay races. The route passes through beautiful countryside via Křížová hora and Přídolí. The event supports the Personal Assistance social service, which helps children with disabilities and seniors in the region. There is also a varied program of accompanying activities and running T-shirts available to purchase.
course_highlights: Main route: approx. 11 km via Křížová hora and Přídolí
Family run: 1–2 km depending on age category
Relay race: 2 × 5.5 km, with the baton exchange at Hornobránský Pond
additional: The main run and relay races start at 12:11; the family run begins from 10:01, with staggered start times for the different categories. The main run has a capacity of 200 runners, and the family run a capacity of 200 children. Race packs with bib numbers can be collected at the venue from 8:45 to 11:30. Running T-shirts and St. Martin’s goose are available to purchase for an additional fee. Relays may be women’s, men’s, mixed or corporate. The event is a charity event, with proceeds supporting the Personal Assistance social service in Český Krumlov. The start and finish are at Hornobránský Pond; the main run starts from 12:11. Online registration is open until 30 October 2026 and is mandatory. The race has a capacity of 200 participants.

name: Marceliński Bieg Jesienny 2026
description: Marceliński Autumn Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic courses that showcase the location’s aesthetic appeal. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Wielkopolska, offering participants a unique running experience in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
Courses that showcase the location’s aesthetic appeal
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts from Wielkopolska
additional: The race route is available on Garmin Connect. Race packs can be collected using an authorization form template. Cross-country race, event in Marceliński Forest, November 8, 2026, puzzle-piece medals, forest routes

name: Feldwar Trail 1 / 5 / 10 / 17 / 23
description: Feldwar Trail is a friendly, family-oriented trail running race among the hills of Dunaföldvár, with stunning views and an impressive race headquarters at Ispánház. Runners can choose from several distances, from children’s races to the 23 km course, with women’s and men’s categories awarded separately. The courses run mostly on dirt roads, with minimal paved sections, allowing participants to enjoy being close to nature. The event is run as a green event, so the organisers ask runners to bring a reusable bottle or their own cup to the refreshment stations.
course_highlights: Trail routes among the hills of Dunaföldvár
Stunning views of the southern Danube Bend from Kálvária and the ridge along the Danube
Mostly dirt roads, with minimal paved sections
additional: On-site registration: Sunday, 2026.11.08, 9:00–10:00 (children: 9:45). An instant-run option is available within one year after November 10, 2025, by prior arrangement; the fee is 3,000 Ft. Chip timing with the Traxpace system and online split results. The race is limited to a maximum of 400 participants, including a maximum of 100 preschool and primary-school children. Disposable cups are not provided at the refreshment stations, so participants are asked to use their own bottle or cup. The time limit is advisory; finishers receive a medal even if they finish after the time limit. Distances: 1, 5, 10, 17 and 23 km; refreshment stations on the various distances; chip timing; instant-run option; children’s races; individual or group registration; awards by category.

name: Běh na Dobrošov
location: Náchod-Běloves, Náchod, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Dobrošov is a public uphill race with a mass start, held in Náchod-Běloves in the Hradec Králové Region. The race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and gives athletes the chance to test themselves on a challenging uphill course. It is organized by the Redpoint Teplice nad Metují club and is popular with runners who enjoy challenges in a natural setting. Runners of all ages and ability levels traditionally take part.
course_highlights: Uphill race with a mass start
Challenging course through the natural surroundings of Náchod-Běloves
Part of the Běžecké vršky series
additional: This is a public mountain race with various categories, including historical information about the race and related events.

name: 14. PKO Bieg Niepodległości w Rzeszowie
description: The 14th PKO Independence Run in Rzeszów is an annual running event organized by the Rzeszów Running Club “Rzeszów Biega,” in partnership with the Rzeszów City Hall and PKO Bank Polski. The 10 km main race starts and finishes at Rzeszów Market Square and takes place on November 11 at 11:11. The event promotes an active lifestyle and running in the Podkarpackie region, offering age-group classifications and special categories, including for doctors and lawyers. Participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt, bib number and chip, and a commemorative medal at the finish. The participant limit is 3,000, and entrants must confirm they are fit to run by providing a medical certificate or declaration.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race starts and finishes at Rzeszów Market Square
Separate age-group classifications and special categories, including for doctors and lawyers
Participant limit of 3,000; race pack includes a T-shirt, bib number and chip
additional: Medal engraving is available for an additional fee of 30 zł. The number of race packs available on race day is limited, and the entry fee is non-refundable. Participants must be over 16 (minors require parental or guardian consent). Participants receive race packs containing a T-shirt, bib number and chip. The course is marked every 1 km, and the event includes warm-ups and refreshment stations along the course. Wearing the organizer’s T-shirt is mandatory.

name: 36. Bieg Niepodległości w Warszawie
description: The 35th Independence Run in Warsaw is an annual running event held to celebrate National Independence Day. The main 10 km race takes place on the streets of the capital, with the start and finish on Jana Pawła II Avenue. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs, and also offers a Nordic walking category and the accompanying Independence Mile, covering 1,918 m. The main race starts in waves to ensure participants’ comfort and safety. The organizers provide a varied program and efficient race services, including convenient pre-race bib collection dates.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through Warsaw certified by the PZLA
Start and finish on Jana Pawła II Avenue, level with Miła Street
Wave starts for the main race, with runners divided into zones according to their expected finish time
additional: The main race starts at 11:11, with wave starts divided into time zones. The Independence Mile starts at 10:00. Athletes using active wheelchairs, handbikes, and tandems start at 11:08. Race bibs can be collected at Westfield Arkadia from November 7–10. On race day, the race office is closed, except for package collection by participants from outside Warsaw between 8:00 and 10:00. Participants are asked to line up at the start wearing white or red shirts to form a red-and-white flag. The route is well-known and popular, and around 20,000 people take part in the event. The event includes various running categories, including the main race, Nordic walking, and virtual options available until November 17. In previous years, the event was the largest running event in Poland.

name: Poznański Bieg Niepodległości – Kocham Polskę!
location: Strzeszyn, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
price_range: 20 zł za koszulkę techniczną, wpisowe na stronie nie jest wyraźnie podane
description: The Poznań Independence Run – I Love Poland! is a cross-country race held in picturesque locations in Poznań, particularly in Strzeszyn near Malibu Beach. The event is part of the activities of a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland since 2014, with an emphasis on attractive courses and the sporting character of the event. The race has a patriotic dimension and takes place on 11 November, combining sport with a celebration of Poland’s independence. Runners are invited to take part in a range of distances amid beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country course around Strzeszyn and Malibu Beach
Picturesque green areas of Poznań
A patriotic race held on 11 November
additional: The organiser is a group of running enthusiasts from Greater Poland, active since 2014 and specialising in cross-country races. The race takes place in the green areas of Strzeszyn, near Malibu Beach. The event has a patriotic character and is part of the Poznań Running Triad. Participant limit: 750; picturesque courses; cross-country races.

name: 10 Bieg Niepodległości z wąsem
location: Stadion Olimpijski, Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Wrocław Independence Day Run with a Mustache is an annual running event held at the Olympic Stadium in Wrocław, commemorating the 107th anniversary of Poland regaining independence. Participants can choose between the 10 km and 5 km distances, and the main race course is certified by the PZLA. The race takes place on roads closed to traffic, and runners receive a medal and a post-race meal at the finish. Free accompanying runs are available for younger participants, and runners can purchase a high-quality technical T-shirt featuring the race logo.
course_highlights: The PZLA-certified 10 km course consists of two 5 km loops
Start and finish at the Pergola at the Olympic Stadium
The course follows asphalt and gravel roads at the foot of the flood embankments
additional: Race packs can be collected from the race office at the Olympic Stadium on November 10 and 11. The pack contains a race number, mustache-patterned socks, a stick-on mustache, sponsor products, a calendar, a T-shirt (if ordered), a medal, and a post-race meal. There is a hydration station on the course. The race takes place on roads closed to traffic. Free accompanying runs are organized for children. Technical T-shirts can be ordered until 16.10.2025 for 90 zł. Changing rooms and a bag deposit are available on site. The 5 km race starts at 10:11 and the 10 km race at 11:11. The race takes place on roads closed to traffic; accompanying runs for children are available; T-shirts can be purchased through the registration form on datasport; participants receive medals; on-the-day registration is available.

name: XIV Bieg Niepodległości
description: The 14th Independence Run is an annual 10 km road race held in Rzeszów, promoting an active lifestyle and running in the Podkarpacie region. The start and finish are at Rzeszów Market Square, and the race takes place on November 11, Poland’s Independence Day. Runners compete in multiple age categories and special classifications, including those for doctors and lawyers. Participants receive a race pack containing a T-shirt, race number and chip, and a commemorative medal at the finish. The participant limit is 3,000, and entrants must confirm they are fit to run by providing a medical certificate or a declaration.
course_highlights: A 10 km road race starting and finishing at Market Square in Rzeszów
Separate age-group and special classifications (e.g. doctors and the legal profession)
A commemorative medal for every participant at the finish
additional: The participant limit is 3,000. Participants must be at least 16 years old on race day. Minors may participate with the consent of a parent or legal guardian. The race pack contains a T-shirt, race number and chip. Medal engraving is available for an additional fee of 30 zł. The entry fee is non-refundable. On race day, race packs are available only for cash and in limited quantities. Participants can expect a clearly marked course, detailed safety regulations, and information about registration and participant limits. The race takes place in Rytro, and the event is part of the National Independence Day celebrations.

name: Zemplínsky extrém – Beh v múzeu
price_range: 20€ online, 25€ na mieste pre hlavné kategórie; 3€ online, 5€ na mieste pre deti
description: Zemplínsky extrém - Beh v múzeu je jesenný bežecký závod v areáli Zemplínskeho múzea v Michalovciach, ktorý sa koná 14. novembra 2026. Tento beh ponúka unikátny zážitok spojený s kultúrnym prostredím múzea a okolitou prírodou. Pretek je súčasťou série Zemplínsky extrém, ktorá zahŕňa viacero podujatí v regióne. Bežci môžu očakávať zaujímavú trať s atmosférou jesene a miestnej histórie.
course_highlights: Trať vedie areálom Zemplínskeho múzea v Michalovciach
Jesenné prostredie s kultúrnym nádychom
Súčasť série Zemplínsky extrém s viacerými podujatiami
additional: Podujatie sa koná 14. novembra 2026, súčasťou je viacero kategórií vrátane detských, a prebieha v areáli Zemplínskeho múzea v Michalovciach.

name: Beh na Minčol
description: Beh na Minčol je náročný horský beh do vrchu v krásnom prostredí Višňovskej doliny. Trasa vedie značeným turistickým chodníkom s prudkými stúpaniami až na vrchol Minčola vo výške 1363 m.n.m., kde sa bežci môžu tešiť na krásne výhľady na Krivánsku a Lúčanskú časť Malej Fatry. Pretek je určený pre odvážnych bežcov, ktorí si chcú vyskúšať svoje sily na náročnej trase s minimom priestoru na oddych. Po dobehu je zabezpečené občerstvenie a vyhodnotenie pretekárov s cenami pre najlepších v kategóriách.
course_highlights: Značený turistický chodník s modrou značkou
Prudké stúpania od začiatku až do konca trate
Cieľ na vrchole Minčola s výhľadmi na Krivánsku a Lúčanskú časť Malej Fatry
additional: Prezentácia pretekárov je od 8:30 do 9:30. Vyhodnotenie výsledkov je krátko po dobehu posledného pretekára, približne o 12:30. Na trati je občerstvenie približne na 2 km a v cieli, po dobehu sa podáva obed (domáca kapustnica a nápoj). Bežci môžu využiť drop bag, ktorý bude prevezený do zázemia pod zjazdovkou, kde sa budú odovzdávať ceny. Organizátori zabezpečujú odvoz vecí pretekárov do miesta vyhlásenia výsledkov. Po dobehu je zabezpečené občerstvenie a vyhodnotenie pretekárov s cenami pre najlepších v kategóriách.

name: Ferčekovská desiatka
location: Ferčekovce, Spišská Nová Ves, Ferčekovce, Spišská Nová Ves, Malé pole
description: Ferčekovská desiatka je bežecký pretek konaný v obci Ferčekovce pri Spišskej Novej Vsi, ktorý ponúka trate pre deti, dorast a dospelých. Preteky sa konajú na lesných cestách a trávnatých, zvlnených terénoch, čo vytvára príjemné a prírodné prostredie pre bežcov všetkých vekových kategórií. Organizátorom je Športový klub Ferčekovce v spolupráci s mestom Spišská Nová Ves. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť vrátane rodín a bežeckých nadšencov, ktorí si môžu vybrať z viacerých kategórií a vzdialeností.

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec is a traditional autumn trail race in the Plzeň area, offering scenic routes through nature with minimal asphalt. The race is intended both for fans of healthy outdoor exercise and for competitive athletes and elite trail runners. Choose from routes of 42 km with 700 m of elevation gain, 22.5 km, 7 km, and shorter children’s and youth routes, including a multigenerational relay. The race hub, start and finish are in the suburban district of Plzeň - Bílá hora. The organizers follow the motto “I don’t run on asphalt” and prepare a race focused on running in nature and enjoying beautiful views.
course_highlights: Scenic trails along both banks of the Berounka River valley
Forests around the Bolevec ponds
A climb to Krkavec with 700 m of elevation gain on the marathon route
additional: Three main routes are available (42 km, 22.5 km, 7 km), along with shorter children’s and youth routes, including a multigenerational relay. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup. The race hub is in the suburban district of Plzeň - Bílá hora. Terrain: trail, cross-country; the race takes place in November 2026; exact registration details are not provided.

name: BoBoBěh
description: BoBoběh is the final mountain race in the BoBoloppet trilogy, taking runners through the beautiful Jizera Mountains. The race offers a challenging 30 km course with climbs up Olivetská hora, a section across the Černá Nisa dam, and a tough ascent up Bílý Štolpich. A shorter 10 km course is available for less experienced runners, as well as a 1 km children’s MINI run. The race is open to all running and nature lovers, whether they are registered for the full trilogy or wish to take part in this race only.
course_highlights: 30 km mountain race over Vysoký hřeben and Kanál
Two climbs up Olivetská hora and a section across the Černá Nisa dam
The toughest climb in the Jizera Mountains — Bílý Štolpich
additional: The race does not have a mass start. The start area is open for two hours, during which runners choose their start time. The course is not marked, so the race involves some orienteering. There are three options: 30 km, 10 km (fit), and the 1 km children’s MINI run. The event is open to everyone and offers registration for different course options, with an emphasis on natural beauty and sporting experiences in a mountain setting.

name: Běh přes Černovírský les
description: The Run through Černovír Forest is a flat 10 km race held in Hlušovice near Olomouc. It is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners and attracts local runners who enjoy a course along cycle paths and paved roads. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers not only a sporting experience but also a chance to meet the local running community. The race is a welcome opportunity to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and spend time actively outdoors.
course_highlights: Flat course along cycle paths and paved roads
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners
Open to participants in various age categories
additional: 10 km race, part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for distance runners, flat terrain, participation by local distance runners

name: Běh Dlouhými záhony
description: Běh Dlouhými záhony is a challenging 6.8 km cross-country race with significant elevation changes, held in Úpice. The race is part of the Czech Cup in Hill Running and the Winter Running League for the King of the Jestřebí Mountains. The course challenges runners with hilly terrain and beautiful natural scenery in the Jestřebí Mountains. This race is suitable for experienced runners looking for a technically demanding mountain run.
course_highlights: Challenging cross-country race with significant elevation changes
Course length: 6.8 km
Part of the Czech Cup in Hill Running and the Winter Running League
additional: The race is part of the Winter Running League and the Czech Cup in Hill Running, with the best Czech hill runners ranked after the race.

name: Svatomartinský běh
location: Petřkovice u Starého Jičína, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The St. Martin’s Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Petřkovice near Starý Jičín in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race offers a sporting experience in beautiful countryside, with a course approximately 5.5 km long that is suitable for the general public. The event is organized at the Hotel Zámek Berchtold grounds, which provide facilities and comfort for participants and spectators alike. The race is ideal for runners who want to combine sport with a pleasant atmosphere and beautiful views of the surrounding area.
course_highlights: A 5.5 km course in a natural setting
Picturesque surroundings of Petřkovice near Starý Jičín
Start and finish at the Hotel Zámek Berchtold grounds
additional: Results from previous editions are available online. The route passes through natural surroundings and is mostly on forest and field surfaces. The Zámek Berchtold grounds offer facilities for participants, including parking and refreshments. The race takes place in November 2026; exact details about registration and the courses are not provided. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle.

name: Ludgeřovický kros

price_tiers.distance: běh 10 km, 4 km, Nordic walking 9 km, děti

description: Ludgeřovice Cross-Country Race is a traditional running event held in the natural surroundings of the village of Ludgeřovice, attracting runners of all ages every year. The main course is 10 km long and follows varied terrain, including forest roads, field paths and routes past local landmarks. In addition to the main race, there are shorter 4 km runs, a 9 km Nordic walking event and children’s races by age category. The event is part of the Prajzsko-Opavská Running League and is subtitled the Veterans’ Run, paying tribute to heroes from both past and present.
course_highlights: Main 10 km course with 140 m of elevation gain
Terrain includes forest roads, field paths and routes around local landmarks
Additional events: 4 km run, 9 km Nordic walking and children’s races of 100 m and 500 m
additional: A custom-designed metal finisher’s medal; a commemorative magnet for the first 200 participants to register in person; a copy of the book Ještě jeden maraton for the first 300 entrants; cash prizes for the main race winners; chip timing for children’s races too; awards presented down to fourth place in all races; the accompanying Ludgeřovice Veterans’ Day programme; personal race videos and photos; changing rooms, showers and convenient parking; children’s races with an awards ceremony and a raffle. Courses: 10 km, 9 km, 4 km and children’s races. Weather uncertain. Held in conjunction with Veterans’ Day.

name: Půlmaraton pátera Václava Kosmáka
description: The Páter Václav Kosmák Half Marathon is a road race running from Moravské Budějovice to Lukov and back. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves over the half-marathon distance in the picturesque Vysočina region. The race is suitable for anyone looking for a quality road race with a traditional atmosphere. The organizers welcome both experienced and beginner runners and look forward to your participation.
course_highlights: Road race from Moravské Budějovice to Lukov and back
Picturesque setting in the Vysočina region
Traditional half-marathon course
additional: The race is open to all age groups and is part of a running league. It offers a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to take part as a recreational runner.

description: Hubert’s Forest Trail is a running race for children and adults, held in the beautiful surroundings of the Hradec forests on the Forest “Finnish” Running Trail in Malšovice. The start and finish are located near the Forest Cemetery. The event offers children’s categories with shorter, untimed courses, as well as a main race for adults. Medals and small gifts are prepared for the first three finishers in each category. Results are published on the organiser’s website within 24 hours of the race.
course_highlights: Forest “Finnish” Running Trail in Malšovice
Start and finish 200 m from the Forest Cemetery
Beautiful woodland setting in the Hradec forests
additional: Registration is available online until 10.11.2026 or in person on race day. Children’s categories start from 10:20, with check-in for children from 09:30 to 10:15. The main adult race starts between 11:00 and 11:45. Medals and small gifts are prepared for the first three finishers in each category. Results are published on the organiser’s website within 24 hours. The children’s races start at 10:20 and the main race at 12:00. The entry fee includes timing, refreshments and a medal; the first three finishers in each category also receive a small gift. Public transport: bus line 9, Forest Cemetery stop; parking is available at the Forest Cemetery.

name: Dvouetapový kros Zaječov
location: Louka, Malá Víska, Zaječov, Czech Republic
description: Dvouetapový kros Zaječov is a two-day running race held at Louka, Malá Víska near Zaječov. The race offers two stages: a long 13.5 km route with 330 m of elevation gain and a short 6.7 km route with 190 m of elevation gain. Both follow courses originally designed for sled-dog races. The main challenge is the combined competition across both stages, covering a total of 20.2 km with 520 m of elevation gain. The race is open to everyone regardless of gender or age, with finishing times adjusted by age and gender coefficients. The long stage starts on Saturday at 9:00, and the short stage starts on Sunday at 8:30.
course_highlights: Long stage: 13.5 km with 330 m of elevation gain
Short stage: 6.7 km with 190 m of elevation gain
Routes run through meadows and along forest paths prepared for sled-dog races
additional: Registration is online only, and you must register separately for each stage. Race numbers can be collected from 7:00 on Saturday and on Sunday. The competition is open regardless of gender or age, with finishing times adjusted by age and gender coefficients. The first 5 runners are announced after each stage. For runners taking part in both stages, times are added together and the 10 runners with the fastest combined times are announced. Online registration is open until 11. 11. 2026. To enter the combined competition, you must register separately for each stage; the entry fee must be paid by 11. 11. 2026.

name: Kuchařovická výzva
location: Víceúčelové zařízení (kulturní dům), Kuchařovice, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč hlavní závod; 50 Kč dětské závody

description: Kuchařovická Výzva is a running race held in Kuchařovice, offering courses for men, women, and children. The men’s course is 8.4 km with 114 m of elevation gain, the women’s course is 5.9 km with 71 m of elevation gain, and the children’s course is 150 m long. The race takes place in pleasant surroundings, mainly on forest paths and sections of asphalt, giving the course a rolling profile. The start and registration are in front of the multi-purpose facility in Kuchařovice, creating a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Rolling course profile with 114 m of elevation gain for men and 71 m for women
70% forest paths and 30% asphalt
Start and finish in front of the multi-purpose facility in Kuchařovice
additional: Registration for the main race takes place from 8:30 to 9:30 in front of the multi-purpose facility in Kuchařovice. Parking is available by Emrammus restaurant, by the kindergarten, and on Větrná Street. The start and facilities are at the multi-purpose facility (cultural center) in Kuchařovice. The listed children’s race distances are 100, 300, and 600 m. Parking is available by Emrammus restaurant, by the kindergarten, or on Větrná Street.

name: Hrouzovka 2026
description: Hrouzovka 2026 is a running race taking place on November 14, 2026, in Krnov. The race offers a route approximately 15 km long, crossing hilly terrain with varied surfaces, including asphalt, grass, and rocky paths. The event is for runners seeking a challenge in a natural setting and looking to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in beautiful surroundings. Details about the organizer and registration have not yet been announced, but the race is part of the local running calendar.

name: W rytmie biegu, w rytmie jeziora
Tanúhegyek Trail 7 / 21 / 42
description: The Tanúhegyek Trail is a trail-running race organized by the Terepfutó Műhely Sports Association in one of the most beautiful parts of the Balaton Uplands National Park, in Badacsonytomaj. Participants can choose from 7, 21, and 42 km distances, taking on 1, 3, or 5 witness hills, with wonderful views of Lake Balaton and the surrounding countryside. The start and finish are at Halászkert. The race also supports a charitable cause: participants can donate their timing chip deposit to the Üröm Animal Shelter. A dog race is also held over the shortest distance. Everyone is warmly welcome at the event on November 14, 2026.
course_highlights: Trail running in the Balaton Uplands National Park
Breathtaking views of Lake Balaton and the countryside in its autumn colors
Routes taking in 1, 3, or 5 witness hills
additional: Timing is electronic, using a chip. The chip deposit is 2,000 HUF, which is refundable or can be donated to charity. Unannounced checkpoints may be placed along the course. A dog race is also held over the shortest distance. The race does not close public roads, so traffic rules must be observed. Distances: 7 km, 21 km, 42 km; dog race over 7 km; charitable event supported through donations of timing chip deposits.

name: III. „Egri Portya” tájékozódási teljesítménytúra és futás 3 / 6 / 10 / 15
Beh jastrabskými vŕškami – 3. ročnik memoriálu Jána Dobáka
location: Šarišské Jastrabie, Obec Šarišské Jastrabie, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Šarišské Jastrabie, ZŠ s MŠ Šarišské Jastrabie
price_range: € (rôzne kategórie, niektoré zadarmo pre špecifické skupiny)
description: Beh jastrabskými vŕškami je 3. ročník memoriálu Jána Dobáka, ktorý sa koná v obci Šarišské Jastrabie. Pretek ponúka kategórie pre deti aj dospelých s rôznymi vekovými skupinami a disciplínami vrátane 10 km behu a 5 km behu pre mužov a ženy, ako aj nordic walking. Štart pre deti je o 12:30 a pre dospelých o 14:00 hod. Organizátormi sú Obec Šarišské Jastrabie a ZŠ s MŠ Šarišské Jastrabie, ktorí vítajú bežcov všetkých vekových kategórií a úrovní.
course_highlights: Trasa vedie cez jastrabské vŕšky v obci Šarišské Jastrabie
Kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny a disciplíny vrátane nordic walking
Štart v areáli Obecného úradu Šarišské Jastrabie
additional: Registrácia na mieste je možná len vo výnimočných prípadoch po dohode s organizátorom. Detské kategórie, obyvatelia obce Šarišské Jastrabie, muži nad 70 rokov a ženy nad 60 rokov majú štartovné zdarma. Možnosť výhodného balíčka pretekov Z Ľubotína na Hrad Plaveč + Beh jastrabskými vŕškami. Podujatie zahŕňa trate na 5 km a 10 km, registrácia je možná online aj na mieste, ceny sa líšia podľa kategórie a spôsobu registrácie. Súčasťou sú kategórie pre deti, seniorov a Nordic Walking.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 11. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelný bežecký závod na vzdialenosť 2 míle (3,218 km), ktorý sa koná v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave. Organizuje ho Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team a je súčasťou série pretekov s bodovaním podľa kategórií mužov a žien. Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste pri volejbalovom ihrisku od 9:30, štart je o 10:00. Súťažia kategórie detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov, pričom pretekári môžu získať body aj za zlepšenie svojich časov v roku.
course_highlights: Trať dlhá 2 míle (3,218 km)
Prezentácia a štart pri volejbalovom ihrisku v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda
Kategórie pre deti, juniorov, ženy, mužov a veteránov
additional: Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste pri volejbalovom ihrisku od 9:30. Súťaž o Putovný pohár Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu s bodovaním podľa koeficientov podľa roku narodenia. Pri rovnosti bodov rozhoduje najlepší čas a potom veľkosť topánky. Na konci roka sa zrušia 2 mesiace s najnižším počtom bodov (amnestia). Registrácia je možná priamo na mieste; podujatie sa koná v rôznych kolách počas roka, pričom každý beh má dĺžku približne 2 míle (3,218 km).

name: Beh na Husárik
location: Horské hoteli Husárik, Čadca, Žilina, Slovakia
description: Beh na Husárik je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný Klubom Kysuckého maratónu Čadca, Mestom Čadca a Horským hotelom Husárik. Tento pretek sa koná na počesť dňa študentstva a ponúka bežcom možnosť zmerať si sily v krásnom horskom prostredí. Štart je vždy o 11. hodine a pretek je známy svojou priateľskou atmosférou a pohárom primátora mesta Čadca ako ocenením pre víťazov. Beh na Husárik je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť, ktorá má záujem o šport a prírodu.
course_highlights: Horské prostredie okolo Horského hotela Husárik
Pretek na počesť dňa študentstva
Pohár primátora mesta Čadca pre víťazov
additional: Online registrácia je ukončená, prihlásiť sa je možné aj v deň preteku za zvýšené štartovné 8 EUR. Pretek sa koná 15. novembra 2026, štart o 11:00, možnosť online registrácie, trať je kopcovitá a trailová, organizované v Čadci v blízkosti Horského hotela Husárik.

name: Hermanovská desiatka
location: Hermanovce nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Hermanovce nad Topľou a Hermanovský bežecký oddiel

description: Hermanovská desiatka je bežecký pretek organizovaný obcou Hermanovce nad Topľou a Hermanovským bežeckým oddielom. Pretek sa koná pred budovou Obecného úradu v Hermanovciach nad Topľou a ponúka kategórie pre deti, mládež aj dospelých. Štart pre deti a mládež je o 12:00 hod., pre dospelých o 14:00 hod. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a podporuje aktívny životný štýl v regióne.
course_highlights: Súťaž pre rôzne vekové kategórie vrátane detí, mládeže a dospelých
Organizované v malebnom prostredí Hermanoviec nad Topľou
Možnosť registrácie cez QR kód a nízke štartovné 10 €
additional: Štart pre deti a mládež je o 12:00 hod., pre dospelých o 14:00 hod. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane domácich kategórií. Registrácia je povinná do 10.11.2025 cez QR kód. Pretek je určený pre bežcov všetkých úrovní, s kategóriami pre deti, mládež a dospelých. Podujatie sa koná 15. novembra 2026, štart je o 12:00 pre deti a o 14:00 pre dospelých.

name: XXIV Maraton Odrzański
description: The 24th Odra Marathon is a race held in Kędzierzyn-Koźle and organized by the Odra Consortium Foundation. The event offers two categories: a full marathon of 42.195 km and a half marathon of 21.097 km. It is a sporting and recreational event, with the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Kędzierzyn-Koźle as its partner. The race office operates on the days before the race and on race day, providing support for participants.
course_highlights: Marathon and half-marathon courses in Kędzierzyn-Koźle
Organized by the Odra Consortium Foundation
In partnership with the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre
additional: The race office is open on 14.11.2025 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 15.11.2025 from 7:00 to 8:30. Organizers' telephone contacts: Piotr (+48) 500 028 811, Piotr (+48) 604 589 483, Ania (+48) 602 534 780. The event's partner is the Municipal Sports and Recreation Centre in Kędzierzyn-Koźle. Electronic timekeeping; a 6-hour time limit; the event includes both a marathon and a half marathon and takes place in November in Kędzierzyn-Koźle.

name: X Komprachcicka Niepodległościowa Dycha
location: Komprachcice, Opole County, Opole Voivodeship, Poland

name: Krosová 12°
description: Krosová 12° is a 12 km or 6 km running race on a hilly 6 km loop around Velešín in the South Bohemian Region. This cross-country race challenges runners with demanding, hilly terrain, making it ideal for those who enjoy trail running and hills. The race is suitable for the general public who want to try running off-road amid beautiful views and a natural atmosphere. Recommended running gear and accessories are presented on the official website.
course_highlights: Hilly 6 km loop with elevation gain
Choice of 12 km or 6 km course
Natural terrain with views around Velešín
additional: The race offers two course distances: 12 km and 6 km, both on a hilly loop. The website recommends running gear and accessories such as Ultra Trail socks, Altra and Puma running shoes, and lightweight jackets suitable for changeable weather. The race is suitable for runners of all levels, offering an attractive hilly course and a choice of two distances.

name: Běh 17. listopadu
location: Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The 17 November Run is a traditional running race in Ostrava-Hrabová commemorating an important day in Czech history. It offers two main distances: the certified 10 km Freedom Ten and the 5 km Revolution Five. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere and support the idea of freedom. Check-in and registration take place at ZŠ Paskovská, with the races starting in the morning. The routes pass through the scenic surroundings of Ostrava-Hrabová, which is easy to reach by public transport and shared Nextbike bicycles.
course_highlights: Certified 10 km Freedom Ten course
5 km Revolution Five
Routes through Ostrava-Hrabová, with good public transport connections
additional: On-site check-in and registration take place at ZŠ Paskovská 110/46 from 8:30 to 9:40. The individual races start in the morning. Public transport is available on lines 27, 39, 41 and 77, with a stop at Šídlovec. Shared Nextbike bicycles are also available. The race includes several course distances, online registration is available, and the event has a long tradition, with results from previous editions.

name: Sametový běh
location: Odolena Voda, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 150,- pro závodníky starší 18 let při registraci on-line do 30. 9., platba převodem

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 200,- pro závodníky starší 18 let při registraci on-line do 11. 11., platba převodem

tiers.label: tier_3

description: The Velvet Run is a traditional running event held in Odolena Voda, offering races for all age groups, including a family run for parents and children. The event takes place at the football field and includes distances of 300 m, 600 m, 5 km and 10 km. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere, a handmade gingerbread medal and light refreshments after the race, including tea and mulled wine. The organizers ensure the course is safe and also prepare a raffle with a variety of prizes. The main race is scheduled to start at 11:17.
course_highlights: Distances of 300 m, 600 m, 5 km and 10 km
Start and finish at the football field in Odolena Voda
Handmade gingerbread medals for participants
additional: Race-day registration opens at 08:45 at the event venue. Light refreshments are available after the race, including tea, mulled wine and homemade buns. Runners receive a race bib with a timing chip and safety pins. Parking is available by Penny Market. The organizers provide course and event safety. Categories are divided by age and gender, including the Fighters, Champions and Legends categories. The course surface includes the football field; the event features a raffle, refreshments and fun activities for families. Registration is available on site.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Přerov
description: The November 17 Run in Přerov is a traditional athletics event organized by Atletika SK Přerov. The race offers runners of all ages and abilities the opportunity to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and test themselves on an interesting course. It takes place in the beautiful surroundings of the city of Přerov and is part of the local athletics calendar. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: A 9 km cross-country race, with children’s categories also available
Part of the Grand Prix of Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region
Online registration and results available
additional: The race is part of the local running calendar, offers various courses including cross-country, and attracts a wide range of participants from the region.

name: Běh kolem koupaliště
description: The Run Around the Swimming Pool is a traditional running race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletics Club Kopřivnice. The race takes place on a 5,000-meter course that runs around the local swimming pool. The start is at 11:00, and participants can compete in several age categories. Race facilities include registration at the sports hall, changing rooms and showers. After the race, the results are announced and prizes are awarded. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 5,000-meter course (4 laps)
The route runs around the swimming pool in Kopřivnice
Start and registration at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall
additional: Registration from 9:45 at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall. Categories are divided by age and gender. Changing rooms and showers are available. The results will be announced at 12:30 in the sports hall buffet, with prizes awarded. Registration takes place at the SOU Kopřivnice sports hall. The race is open to men and women; participants run 4 laps. Roots and stones are marked for safety. Refreshments are available at the finish, and there is a raffle. The ceremonial start is signaled by a pistol shot fired by the mayor.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Kadaň
location: Rooseveltovy sady, Kadaň, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The November 17 Run in Kadaň is a traditional running race organized by the SK Městská policie Kadaň sports club. The race takes place in Rooseveltovy sady and offers an opportunity for runners of all ages. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and support for the local running community. The race information and further details are available to download in PDF format on the official website.
course_highlights: The race runs through Rooseveltovy sady in Kadaň
A course suitable for different age groups
A friendly atmosphere and support for the local running community
additional: The race information is available to download in PDF format. Results and photo galleries from previous editions are published on the website. The organizer is SK Městská policie Kadaň, a sports club with Bc. Jiří Vlasák as its contact. The event includes starts at various distances (e.g. 100 m, 280 m, 550 m, 1300 m, 1800 m, 2500 m, 5000 m). Registration is available on the website, and the event is suitable for all age groups. The venue is in Rooseveltovy sady in Kadaň, behind the sports hall.

name: Běh městem Hradec Králové
location: V Lipkách, Hradec Králové, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Běh městem Hradec Králové is a traditional road race held in the city centre on a flat course. The race offers a 9.7 km route consisting of five laps. A shorter 200-metre lap is prepared for children and young athletes. The event is suitable for the general public and is organised by TJ Liga 100 Hradec Králové with the support of the Czech Athletics Federation.
course_highlights: 5 laps on a flat course in the city centre
200-metre children’s lap
9.7 km road race
additional: The first category starts at 10:00, and the main category starts at 12:00. The race takes place in the V Lipkách residential area, near ZŠ Josefa Gočára in Hradec Králové. The organiser is TJ Liga 100 Hradec Králové z.s.; the contact person is Jiří Brych. Starts are scheduled for 10:00 and 12:00. Registration is available through the sport-reg.cz sports portal.

name: Běh 17. listopadu Polička
location: Lesopark Liboháj, Polička, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč hlavní závod, dobrovolné startovné lidový běh
description: The November 17 Run in Polička is a traditional cross-country race held in Liboháj Forest Park. The main race is 6 km, split into two 3-kilometre loops, and is complemented by a 3 km fun run. The race is part of the ISCAREX running cup and also offers an additional uphill race on the Polička ski slope for the brave. The start is at the ski slope at 11:00, with registration from 10:00 to 10:45. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in Liboháj Forest Park, with paths and trails
Main race: 6 km (2 × 3 km loops); fun run: 3 km (1 loop)
Additional uphill race on the Polička ski slope
additional: Runner registration is from 10:00 to 10:45. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup. The additional uphill race on the ski slope is for brave runners. The weather is usually autumnal, and the course may be slippery or icy after overnight rain. The course follows paths and trails in the forest park; a special challenge is the uphill race on the ski slope. Part of the ISCAREX Cup 2025

name: Beh oslobodenia mesta Michalovce
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, ZŠ Pavla Horova Michalovce
description: Beh oslobodenia mesta Michalovce je tradičný večerný bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná v centre mesta Michalovce. Pretekári bežia mestskými ulicami s dĺžkou trate približne 5,8 km, ktorá je tvorená viacerými okruhmi. Po dobehnutí na cieľ ich čaká občerstvenie a účastnícka medaila. Pretek je vhodný pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka príjemnú atmosféru s možnosťou osobnej prezentácie v deň preteku.
course_highlights: Večerný beh centrom mesta Michalovce
Trať dlhá 5,8 km, tvorená okruhmi po 1 450 m
Občerstvenie a účastnícka medaila po dobehnutí
additional: Prezentácia prebieha vo vestibule Mestského úradu od 16:30 do 17:45, odporúčajú sa čelové LED lampy kvôli bezpečnosti. Po dobehnutí sa štartové číslo vracia a pretekári dostanú medailu. Vyhlásenie výsledkov je o 19:30 v telocvični 8. ZŠ P. Horova. Trať je skrátená na 5,8 km, beží sa na asfaltových a kamenných povrchoch, registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste, štartovné pri registrácii je 20 €, znížené pri online registrácii do 19.11.2025

name: Lesný beh priateľov Šemše
price_range: 12-18 € v závislosti od dĺžky trate a spôsobu registrácie
description: Lesný beh priateľov Šemše je bežecké podujatie v obci Šemša v okrese Košice okolie, ktoré ponúka tri trate rôznej dĺžky: 22 km, 11 km a 5,5 km. Trať vedie po spevnených lesných cestách, cestičkách, poľných cestách a asfalte, čo vytvára príjemné a rozmanité bežecké prostredie. Preteky sú otvorené pre všetky vekové kategórie bez rozdelenia na vekové skupiny a organizuje ich občianske združenie Šemša v pohybe. Štart je rozdelený na dve vlny, pričom dlhšia trať začína o 10:00 a kratšie trate o 11:00 hodine. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov, ktorí hľadajú lesný beh s rôznou náročnosťou a dĺžkou trasy.
course_highlights: Trať vedie po spevnených lesných cestách a cestičkách
Zahrnuté sú poľné cesty a asfaltové úseky
Tri dĺžky tratí: 22 km, 11 km a 5,5 km
additional: Štart je rozdelený na dve vlny: o 10:00 štartuje 22 km trať, o 11:00 štartujú trate 5,5 km a 11 km. Kategórie sú bez vekových obmedzení, určené pre deti, mužov a ženy. Organizátorom je občianske združenie Šemša v pohybe. Povrch trate je rôznorodý, zahŕňa lesné cesty, poľné cesty a asfalt. Preteky sa konajú na teréne s lesnými cestami, poľnými cestami a asfaltom. Registrácia je možná online alebo na mieste. Súčasťou sú kategórie pre deti, mužov a ženy, s možnosťou výberu medzi krátkymi a dlhými traťami.
