tiers.description: 12.00 € - účastníci preteku Beh na Hrad v kategórii „M - A, B, C a Ž - E, F, G“, pri prihlásení cez prihlasovací formulár a platbe prevodom do 18.11.2024.

description: Beh na Kysacký hrad je bežecké podujatie organizované Klubom orientačného behu Kysak a obcou Kysak, ktoré sa koná pri Kultúrnom Dome v Kysaku. Trať vedie prevažne lesnými cestami (85 %) s menším podielom asfaltu (15 %). Pretek je určený pre rôzne vekové kategórie od dorastencov až po veteránov, s rozdelením podľa veku a pohlavia. Štartovné je rozdelené podľa kategórií a platí sa pri registrácii a platbe prevodom do určitého termínu. Podujatie ponúka príjemnú atmosféru a možnosť súťažiť v krásnom prírodnom prostredí.
course_highlights: 85 % lesné cesty, 15 % asfalt
Štart pri Kultúrnom Dome v Kysaku
Viacero vekových kategórií od dorastencov po veteránov
additional: Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku a pohlavia: dorastenci, juniori, muži a ženy v rôznych vekových skupinách. Miesto štartu je pri Kultúrnom Dome v Kysaku. Pretek je organizovaný v prostredí historického Kysackého hradu s možnosťou registrácie cez online formulár a platbou bankovým prevodom do 18.11.2024. Súčasťou sú kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny a pohlavia.

name: Kružská Kundratická - Memoriál Honzy Šíra
description: Kružská Kundratická - Honza Šír Memorial is a hilly road race in Kruh, Liberec Region. Men run a 12 km course with a turnaround in Kundratice, while women run 5 km, turning around earlier. The race is named in memory of Honza Šír and is suited to runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain. Contact details for the organizers are available for more information. The race is part of the running community and offers an opportunity to test yourself on a demanding course.
course_highlights: Hilly road course
12 km course for men with a turnaround in Kundratice
5 km course for women with an earlier turnaround
additional: For information about the race, contact Jiří Sedláček (606280856) or Jan Šír (732851697). Race information is also available by calling Jiří Sedláček (606280856) or Jan Šír (732851697).

name: Přáslavická desítka
location: Přáslavice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Přáslavice Ten is a traditional running race organised by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the village of Přáslavice near Olomouc. The race offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners to enjoy a course in the picturesque surroundings of Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support for the regional running community. The Přáslavice Ten is part of the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje race series and attracts runners of all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque countryside around Přáslavice near Olomouc
Mostly asphalt and forest terrain
Part of the Velká cena vytrvalců Olomouckého kraje
additional: The race takes place on 21 April 2026 and is part of a series of local runs. The course is mostly on asphalt roads.

name: Běh na Čáp
location: Teplice nad Metují, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Běh na Čáp is a public hill running race with a mass start, held in Teplice nad Metují. This traditional race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and offers a sporting experience in beautiful natural surroundings. It is suitable for the general public and gives participants the chance to test themselves on challenging terrain. It is organized by Redpoint Teplice nad Metují, which ensures high-quality organization and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Hill race with a mass start
Challenging terrain around Teplice nad Metují
Part of the Běžecké vršky series, with a long tradition and history
additional: A hill running race with categories. Registration is available for an entry fee of 50 Kč. The race takes place on terrain with a challenging elevation gain. Results are published regularly, and the race has a long tradition.

name: Forestovo Nočník
location: Záluží u Plzně, Plzeň-sever, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Forestovo Nočník is a nighttime trail race in Záluží near Plzeň, offering a 5 km course full of fun and challenges. The race takes place in the dark, so a headlamp is mandatory, and the course is marked with reflective elements to ensure safety and create a unique atmosphere. Tea and refreshments are provided for participants after the finish. This race is ideal for fans of night running and trail challenges who want to experience running in an unusual setting with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 5 km nighttime trail course
Course marked with reflective elements
Headlamp mandatory for safe running
additional: Tea and refreshments are provided for runners at the finish. The race is characterized by 100% darkness and 100% fun. The organizers are Jiří Cipra and team. The course is 5 km long, a headlamp is mandatory, the course is marked with reflective elements, refreshments are available at the finish, and the race is intended for various age groups.

name: Slánské běhy
description: Slánské běhy is a traditional orienteering race organized by the Slaný Orienteering Sports Club. The race takes place around the town of Slaný and offers various categories, including a 12 km main category and children’s categories. The race is suitable for the general public and attracts runners of all ages. The organizers provide facilities and a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: 12 km main category around Slaný
Children’s and youth categories with shorter courses
Facilities provided at Gymnázium V.B.T. Slaný
additional: The race is traditionally held in November; the most recent edition took place on 29 November 2025. The organizers thank all participants and look forward to the next edition. In the past, around 70 runners took part in the main category, along with several dozen children and young people. The main race is 12 km. Registration takes place at Gymnázium V.B.T. Slaný, and the races are held on Saturday, 21 November 2026, at 10:00.

name: Čertovskej wintertrail
location: Hamr na Jezeře, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Čertovskej wintertrail is a trail race through the hills, forests and rocky terrain around Hamr na Jezeře. The race offers two distances, 33.3 km and 16.6 km, and runners can switch between them free of charge. Participants can expect challenging winter conditions, several aid stations and an unforgettable experience on the “hellish” course. Both distances start together at 10:00, and the time limit is 7 hours. The entry fee includes timing, gifts and refreshments on the course and at the finish.
course_highlights: Trail running through hills, forests and rocky terrain
Two distances: 33.3 km and 16.6 km, with the option to switch free of charge
3 aid stations on the long course and 1 on the short course, plus refreshments at the finish
additional: The maximum number of participants is 400. The time limit is 7 hours, with cut-off times at the aid stations at km 15 (3 hours) and km 25 (5 hours). Runners must bring their own drinking cup; a Čertovskej running cup is available to buy at race registration. The entry fee includes pre-race refreshments (coffee, homemade cake), gifts in the race pack (sports socks), chip timing and split times, and food and drinks at the finish (soup, main course, beer, soft drink, mulled wine, tea). Marked course, aid stations, bring your own drinking cup, accommodation nearby, registration on Friday and Saturday before the race.

name: Vranov Trail
location: Vranov, Brno-Country District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Vranov Trail is a series of running races organized by friends who run ultratrails and create high-quality events with carefully planned courses, good food, and a relaxed atmosphere. The races take place around Brno and Vranov, often in forests and on trails with carefully marked routes. Each race has its own special feature, such as a winter night run or a spring half marathon symbolizing the balance between day and night. After each race, there is an afterparty with hot food and drinks, adding to the friendly atmosphere of the event.
course_highlights: Courses follow forest paths and trails around Brno and Vranov
Routes are clearly marked with red-and-white and yellow tape and reflective spray
A winter night trail with a heated tent and hot drinks
additional: Race facilities are often set up outdoors at the Stará Prádelna or Samovýčep venues. There are plenty of refreshments on the course, including water and sports drinks, and hot food after the finish. After the race, there is an afterparty with hot food and drinks, including mulled wine. Bus travel is recommended, with stops nearby. Parking is limited, and participants should follow the organizers’ instructions. Race bibs are collected at designated times before the start.

name: XLVII MnO Pierwszy Śnieg
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Rozwoju Orienteeringu, GKT Cyrkino Gliwice, Czartak Katowice, AKInO Kraków, RO PTTK Częstochowa, PlesInO Pszczyna, be-lość Piekary Śląskie, Krokus Miliardowice
description: The Silesian Voivodeship Orienteering Walks Cup is a series of events organized by tourism clubs and groups across Silesia. Competitions take place in different rounds throughout the year, with participants competing in six age categories and a team classification. The “First Snow” round is the tenth edition of the cup in the 2026 season and will take place on November 21 in Katowice. The event combines sporting competition with spending active time outdoors and navigating the terrain.
course_highlights: Orienteering walks across the Silesian Voivodeship
Competition in six age categories
Team classification and cups for the top participants
additional: The event includes different age categories, is part of an orienteering event series, and takes place in forested and urban areas in Katowice.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Górskich
405. Malá cena Monaka
description: The 405th Malá cena Monaka is a traditional running event taking place on November 22, 2026, in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The event is part of the Monaka race series and offers runners of all levels the opportunity to take part and enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a picturesque setting. Exact details about the course and registration are not yet available, but the race is popular with both local and visiting runners.
course_highlights: A traditional local race in the heart of the Pardubice Region
A welcoming atmosphere and friendly setting
The opportunity to take part in various categories and at different performance levels
additional: The race is part of the Monaka series, which has a long tradition in the region. Exact information about registration and course distance has not yet been published.

description: The 13th Maków Fifteen is an annual race held in Maków Mazowiecki, taking place on November 22, 2026. The event features two distances: 15 km and 5 km, with the start and finish located at the municipal stadium. It is organized by the Maków Mazowiecki Athletics Club together with local authorities. The race attracts both experienced runners and younger participants, offering sporting competition and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the municipal stadium in Maków Mazowiecki
Two distances to choose from: 15 km and 5 km
An urban course suited to adult and youth runners
additional: Timekeeping uses a modern UHF RFID system with passive chips. Results are displayed instantly on a television at the finish and sent to runners by SMS. The race is filmed in Full HD, and an electronic clock at the finish tracks the time. The organizer provides original race bibs made of synthetic or laminated paper. Runners can choose between the 5 km and 15 km races; the event includes training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks and expert support; the race is part of a series of sporting events in the region.

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque Panewnickie forests in Katowice. The race takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times. The event promotes an active lifestyle and education about appropriate conduct in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both recreational runners and members of sports clubs.
course_highlights: A route through the Panewnickie forests, approximately 4,882 m long
The loop is marked every 1 km
The route can be completed up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for running and Nordic walking is 3 hours. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration accepting responsibility for their participation or provide a medical certificate. Children and young people under 18 may participate only when accompanied by a parent or guardian. A package covering all starts during the year is available for purchase. Entry fees are non-refundable, but they may be transferred to the next start if the request is submitted by 3:00 p.m. on the Thursday before the start. Running and Nordic walking events; 3-hour time limit; annual packages available.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (12) – listopadový
description: 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (12) – November is a regular running race in Prague’s Braník district, offering a pleasant, fast course along the Vltava. The race is part of the 16th edition of the Vaší Liga running series, where runners can compare their performances with others and track their progress throughout the year. The course is certified, and the 10 km race offers the opportunity to achieve the qualifying standard for the Czech Championships. After the race, enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, refreshments, and the chance to share your experiences at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex.
course_highlights: A pleasant, fast course along the Vltava in Prague’s Braník district
Course measured by a certified measurer; suitable for achieving the Czech Championships qualifying standard over 10 km
Relaxed running atmosphere with refreshments after the race
additional: The 10 km race starts at 14:00 and the 5 km race at 14:05. Check-in is open from 13:00 in the blue tent by the cycle path near U Kempinku 2, Prague. After the race, an isotonic drink is available, as well as refreshments at the Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is available in the organizers’ tent. The race is timed using chip timing, and each runner also receives a chip time. The race takes place in November 2026; registration is probably through the official website. The series includes multiple races throughout the year.

name: Mikulášský běh Zlín
description: The St. Nicholas Run in Zlín-Louky is a traditional running race held in the beautiful setting along the Dřevnice River. The event offers 5 km and 10 km routes on flat loops with crossings over small bridges and cycle paths. It also includes a 1.5 km family run in costume, a children’s programme, and St. Nicholas and devil-themed festivities. Runners receive a race pack with gifts and a commemorative medal at the finish. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant Advent atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route follows a wide grassy path along the Dřevnice River
Crossings over a concrete bridge and an iron footbridge
Flat loops around the football pitch in Zlín-Louky
additional: A 1.5 km family run in costume, with gingerbread as a finish-line reward. A children’s programme and St. Nicholas and devil-themed festivities in costume. The race pack contains gifts from partners and a commemorative medal. A charity raffle for Krtek, with prizes sold and awarded during the event. 5 km and 10 km races, family and children’s runs, a charity event, start and finish by the football pitch in Zlín-Louky, a varied accompanying programme, and a race pack.

name: Výběh na Lovoš
location: Lovoš, Lovosice, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run up Lovoš is a traditional uphill race held in Lovosice, in the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race offers a challenging trail run climbing to the summit of Lovoš, a popular destination for runners seeking a challenge and beautiful views. The start is on Lovošská Street, and the race is suitable for runners who want to try uphill running in a natural setting. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with registration available in advance or on site.
course_highlights: Off-road uphill run
Start on Lovošská Street in Lovosice
Challenging climb to the summit of Lovoš
additional: Luggage transport is available from 12:30 to 13:30. The vehicle carrying the bags departs at 13:30, so be sure to watch the departure time. The race is part of the Král středohoří sports event series. Registration is available in advance or on site. The start is at 14:00, and luggage departs at 13:30.

description: Stupenská sedmička is the sixth edition of a trail running race, taking place on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at the TJ Sokol Stupno grounds. The race features a 7.2 km loop running mostly along forest paths with very little asphalt, suitable for experienced runners and beginners of all ages. The atmosphere is friendly and relaxed, with extensive facilities and refreshments after the finish. The entry fee includes a finisher’s medal, timing, race photos, prizes, and a raffle. The race is open to all athletes, taking their health and abilities into account.
course_highlights: A 7.2 km loop running mostly along forest paths with very little asphalt
A forest trail with tree roots and several wooded hills
A road crossing supervised by a volunteer and a section along an MTB route
additional: The entry fee includes refreshments after the finish, including tea, water, mulled wine, beer, lemonade, homemade cakes, savory pastries, Christmas breads, bananas, and energy bars. Winners are announced and raffle prizes are drawn after the race. The race bib has a timing chip that must be returned after finishing (a 500 Kč fee applies if it is lost). Race facilities include toilets, changing rooms, and parking at the TJ Sokol Stupno grounds. Runners are advised to write any allergies and an emergency contact on the back of their race bib in case of medical complications. A medical professional will be present at the start and finish area. Registration, including gift vouchers; proceeds support charity; a detailed route description is available.

The course runs along forest trails, fields, and cycle paths, with several hills and road crossings monitored by volunteers.
course_highlights: A 7.2 km loop, mostly on forest paths with very little asphalt
Forest trail with tree roots and several hills
Road crossings monitored by volunteers, with part of the route on a cycle path
additional: The entry fee includes post-race refreshments (tea, water, mulled wine, beer, lemonade, homemade cakes, savoury pastries, Christmas bread, bananas, and bars), a finisher’s medal, course marking, timing, race photos, prizes for the winners, and a raffle. Runners attend a briefing and course description before the start; the awards ceremony and raffle draw take place after the race. The race is also suitable for complete beginners and children. The sixth edition takes place on November 28, 2026. The first category starts at 10:00.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: The 146th Gliwice Park Run Provocation is an annual running event held in Gliwice, combining sport, a friendly atmosphere and time among the city’s green spaces. The run is open to both experienced runners and people who want to spend time actively without the pressure of competition. The start traditionally takes place in the clearing behind the Piast Stadium, and participants can look forward to a welcoming atmosphere and an active way to wrap up February. The event is a great opportunity to start a new month with energy and in a good mood.
course_highlights: Start in the clearing behind Piast Stadium (entrance from Leśna Street)
The route passes through the city’s green spaces
The event combines sport, a friendly atmosphere and recreation
additional: The event office is open from 9:00. To be included in the results, advance registration and an entry fee are required. The event takes place on the last day of February, making it a great way to end the month actively. trail run, online registration, start and finish in the clearing behind Piast Stadium

name: Jesienny Ultra Świr
description: Jesienny Ultra Świr is a mountain ultramarathon held in Grybów, offering a challenge for fans of long-distance running in natural terrain. The course runs mainly along forest and gravel paths, with minimal asphalt, providing an authentic trail-running experience. The event offers different competition formats, including timed races and Nordic Walking, catering to various levels of experience. It is organised by experienced enthusiasts who ensure a welcoming atmosphere and participants’ safety.
course_highlights: 98% of the course runs along forest and gravel paths
Minimal asphalt: just 2%
Start and finish at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa
additional: The start, finish and race office are at the Winter Sports Centre in Ptaszkowa. On race day, the race office is open from 06:45 to 07:30 for the 6/12/24-hour distances and until 09:30 for Nordic Walking and the one-lap race. In the 6-hour and 12-hour races, the winner is the participant who completes the greatest number of full 17 km laps. Running is prohibited during the Nordic Walking event, and judges on the course monitor proper technique. Participants must check in at the race office with an identity document and have the mandatory equipment. The event is part of the Jesienny Ultra Świr series, which includes various distances and activity formats, with online registration. The course may be changed due to weather conditions.

name: XXIII Maraton Komandosa
description: The XXIII Commandos Marathon is a demanding 42.195 km marathon held in Lubliniec. The race takes place on 28 November 2026 and is organised by the Wojskowy Klub Biegacza „Meta” Lubliniec. The course has recently been changed and is available online. Participants can expect professional timekeeping and full technical support for the event.
course_highlights: The new course is available online
Marathon distance: 42.195 km
Organiser: Wojskowy Klub Biegacza „Meta” Lubliniec
additional: The race office is open on 28 November from 15:00 to 20:30 and on 29 November from 07:00 to 08:40. The entry fee can only be paid via an individual link to quick online payments through tpay.com, sent by email. After 31 October 2026, entry is possible only with the organiser’s consent and without the full race package. The participant limit has been reached and registration is suspended. New course; participant limit reached; urban and forest terrain; electronic timekeeping.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly running race made up of optional laps in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint. The half-marathon distance is covered by completing four laps. Participants may run as many laps as they wish. The suggested entry fee is 500 Ft per lap to help cover the race costs. All participants are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine, and receive a commemorative medal; the top three men and women also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, and registration takes place on site.
course_highlights: The course is in the Dióskert area of Törökbálint
The half-marathon distance is covered in 4 laps
Participants may run as many laps as they wish
additional: Registration is on site, with a suggested voluntary entry fee of 500 Ft per lap. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and the top three men and women also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. After the race, participants are offered hot tea, mulled wine and apples. Four laps make up the half-marathon; participants may run fewer laps. On-site registration; refreshments included.

name: 45 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Kamiennik, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is a walking orienteering event in which teams of 2–5 plan their own route to visit as many checkpoints as possible within a set time. The checkpoints are spread across the terrain and marked on a map. The event is open to participants of different ages and experience levels, from enthusiasts and recreational participants to families. Rogaining combines tourism and sport, and participants can modify their route at any time during the competition, making it an appealing way to enjoy the outdoors. The event is organised by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin District Branch, which has been holding orienteering competitions in the region for many years.
course_highlights: Teams travel on foot only, using a map and compass to navigate the terrain
Checkpoints have different point values depending on how difficult they are to find
Participants can choose and change their own route, at any length from 5 to 70 km
additional: The competition is open to all age groups and genders. Teams consist of 2–5 people. Rogaining combines tourism and sport and is suitable for both experienced competitors and families. Routes can be changed during the competition. In 2026, four rogaining events are planned around Strzelin, including the 45th edition in November. The events offer distances from 5 km to 70 km and use maps and compasses. They cater to different experience levels and offer both recreational and competitive participation.

name: Szybka Piątka
description: Szybka Piątka is a 5 km race held in Lublin on 29 November 2026. The event is part of a series of races organized by the Sports Development Foundation in Lublin, which promotes physical activity and the integration of the local community. The race is an excellent opportunity for runners of all levels to test their fitness and enjoy the city’s sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the city
Training support for 8 to 20 weeks
Organized by a local sports foundation
additional: The race is part of local sporting events and includes various distances and age categories, as well as the Lublin Grand Prix classifications.

name: Maraton Praha – Dobříš
location: A Park, Braník, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Prague–Dobříš Marathon is a traditional trail race held on 5 December 2026. The event offers three distances: 42 km with an individual start, and 21 km and 10 km with mass starts. The route runs from Prague 4, Braník, through Dobříš to Kytín, with elevation ranging from 125 to 593 metres. Runners can use baggage transport from the start to the finish. Overall winners and age- and gender-based category winners are announced. The event is suited to trail-running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in a natural setting, with a choice of distances.
course_highlights: 42 km course with 593 m of elevation gain
Start in Prague 4, Braník; finish in Kytín
Baggage transport for runners from the start to the finish
additional: The 42 km race has an individual start; the 21 km and 10 km races have mass starts. The 42 km course has aid stations at kilometres 10, 16, 27 and 33, and at the finish. Parking is available near the start and finish area. Runners take part at their own risk and must take extra care when crossing roads. The course is suitable for runners of all levels. Online registration is available, along with course maps and information about race categories.

name: Mikulášský běh Čimelice
description: The Mikulášský běh Čimelice is a traditional annual race held in Čimelice, a popular event with a long history that usually takes place in early December. It attracts local runners and visitors, who can look forward to a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere. Exact details about the course and race distance are not currently available, but the race is part of the local sporting calendar and has a long tradition.
course_highlights: A traditional race with a long history in Čimelice
Held annually in December
Friendly atmosphere and local community
additional: The race is part of the local sporting calendar. Results from 2025 are available online.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - prosinec
description: The 2-Mile Run in Zlín-Příluky is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps of a precisely measured asphalt loop. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month, with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and the start at 9:00. Every participant is rewarded at the finish with a warm cinnamon pancake.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly among gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
A precisely measured asphalt loop covering just under two laps (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and over, and children aged 12 and under (boys and girls). Every runner is timed, and the top three finishers in the adult and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, by car, on inline skates, or by trolleybus No. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The course is a precisely measured asphalt loop; the children's course is 800 m long. The race is open to all age groups, with categories for men, women, boys, and girls. You can start by bicycle, on foot, by car, on inline skates, or by trolleybus No. 11.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - prosinec
description: The 2-mile run in Prague’s Stromovka Park is an open 3.2 km race for all ages and running abilities, including children up to 12 years old, who run 1.6 km. The race has a friendly atmosphere and encourages everyone to enjoy running, whether you want to improve your personal best or simply enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. After the finish, everyone gets a warm cinnamon pancake. The course follows the park’s paved paths; adults run two laps and children one.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km); children up to 12 years old run 1 lap (1.6 km)
Beautiful setting in the Royal Game Reserve – Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate (below the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45. Pre-registration online is available for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age, with an age-adjustment coefficient used for the year-round Lívancový Cup. Recommended ways to get there are by bicycle, on foot, on roller skates, or by tram (Výstaviště stop). Changing and bag-drop tents, a mobile valuables storage facility, and toilet cabins are available. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou Street. 3.2 km course, road surface, registration is voluntary, and running without a bib is permitted.

name: LEKI WINTER SkyRace®
description: LEKI WINTER SkyRace® is a winter skyrunning race held at Ještěd, in the ski jump area. The race offers a challenging 22 km royal course with 1,180 metres of elevation gain, bringing the 2025 skyrunning season to a close. Shorter courses and children’s races are also available, welcoming a wide range of runners. The event atmosphere is rounded out by the winners’ ceremony and an accompanying programme.
course_highlights: Winter SkyRace® royal course: 22 km with 1,180 m of elevation gain
Other courses: Winter Trail 12 km / 520 m+, Winter Easy 6 km / 220 m+
Children’s races: 200 m, 500 m and 1,200 m
additional: The winners’ ceremony starts at 15:30. The race takes place in the ski jump area at Ještěd. Canicross races are also available over the same distances as the main courses. The race is part of the LEKI JEŠTĚD SERIES. winter mountain race, multiple courses, children’s races, canicross, registration, race equipment and refreshments

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace®
description: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace® is a trail-running race held on the Ještěd Ridge in the Liberec Region. It offers challenging courses with beautiful views and natural scenery, appealing to both experienced runners and fans of mountain running. The race is part of the JEŠTĚD SKYRACE series and is known for its friendly atmosphere, high-quality organization, and extensive accompanying program, including healthy refreshments and a partner zone. Participants can also purchase original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary.
course_highlights: Trails on the Ještěd Ridge with beautiful views
Challenging mountain terrain with courses of varying distances (22 km, 13 km, 6 km)
Extensive accompanying program, including healthy and varied refreshments
additional: Participants receive a specially stocked race bag. Healthy and varied refreshments are available, including meat, vegetarian, and vegan options, as well as quality coffee. The event also features a TV studio with interviews and competitions, and an expanded partner zone with equipment and accessories for runners. Original merchandise for the race’s 10th anniversary is available. Races on different courses, a series of summer and winter races, registration, results, and rules are available on the official website.

name: Čertovská 5
description: Čertovská 5 is a traditional winter run in Unhošť over a distance of 5.7 km. It offers not only a sporting experience, but also a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Runners are welcome to wear devil costumes, adding a unique atmosphere to the race. The race is divided into categories by age and gender, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place at the Sokol hall and is popular with locals and visitors alike.
course_highlights: Traditional 5.7 km winter run
Runners in devil costumes are welcome
Sokol Cup results announced after the race
additional: The race takes place on 6 December 2025 from 08:00 to 11:00 in Unhošť, at the Sokol hall, Melicharova Street. Categories are divided by age and gender (men and women in different age groups). After the race, there is a social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Terrain: winter course. Registration via naZávody.cz. The event is suitable for all age groups and fans of dressing up.

name: Běh do vrchu Ráztoka-Pustevny
description: The Ráztoka–Pustevny Uphill Run is a traditional mountain race held in Ráztoky and around Pustevny. It offers a challenging course with elevation gain that tests runners’ endurance and strength in the beautiful setting of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids. The event is popular with athletes of all levels and has a rich history dating back to 1969. It welcomes everyone who enjoys mountain running and wants to experience the race’s unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Climb to Pustevny with 400 m of elevation gain
Course length of approximately 5.7 km
Mountain setting in the Moravian-Silesian Beskids
additional: The race is also suitable for children. Weather may affect conditions. Registration details are not provided. The event has a long tradition and is very popular.

name: Jested Series
description: Ještěd Skyrace is a technical trail-running race on the Ještěd Ridge, featuring challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 metres of elevation gain. The race is suitable for both recreational runners and professionals and includes several route options, including races for children. The event is part of a race series with a friendly atmosphere and a generous participant race pack.
course_highlights: Technical trail sections on the Ještěd Ridge
Challenging climbs and descents with up to 1,390 m of elevation gain
Route options from 6 km to 22 km, including children’s races
additional: Mandatory equipment is required. Race bibs and timing chips are provided. On-site registration is available, along with bag storage, changing rooms and toilets. Refreshments and an awards ceremony are provided after the finish. The race is livestreamed, and results are available online. The race also offers canicross options and children’s races on shorter routes. The series also includes children’s races. The listed Winter SkyRace distances are 22, 12 and 6 km; the date 5 December 2026 is not confirmed in the available information.

name: Last Man Standing Run VYSOČINA
description: Last Man Standing Run Vysočina is a unique endurance race held on December 5, 2026, at Želiv Monastery. Competitors repeatedly complete a 6.7 km loop, starting every hour, with the aim of lasting as long as possible and lining up for another start on the hour. The inaugural edition is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops, with the winner being the person who completes all 24 loops. The race is not about speed, but about endurance and the ability to overcome physical and mental challenges in the winter conditions of Vysočina.
course_highlights: A 6.7 km loop through the hilly terrain of Vysočina
A new start every hour, up to a maximum of 24 loops / 24 hours
The official time is set by the tolling of the church bell at Želiv Monastery
additional: The race is limited to a maximum of 24 hours and 24 loops. Every competitor must wear their race bib throughout the event and keep a timing chip on their ankle. Headphones are prohibited on the course for safety reasons. Registration is processed manually; payment details are sent by email after the application has been processed. A T-shirt can be ordered as an add-on for 490 Kč. The official race time is set by the tolling of the church bell, which also symbolically closes the finish gate on the hour. The entry fee includes participation, light refreshments and facilities. Mandatory equipment includes a red rear light, a reflective item, neck protection and a personal drinking container. Part of the route may run along roads open to regular traffic.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy, active lifestyle and bringing together runners of all abilities. The event takes place in Mysłowice and is open to all age groups and running levels. Participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to compete throughout the Grand Prix series. Registration is available only at the Race Office on race day, and participation is free.
course_highlights: 10 km race in the scenic surroundings of Mysłowice
A series of seasonal events promoting a healthy lifestyle
A running community and opportunities to connect with the local community
additional: Registration for the Grand Prix series is available only at the Race Office on race day. Participation in the Grand Prix races is free. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age or ability. It focuses on promoting physical activity, health, and the running community, with varied courses and seasonal editions.

name: ADVENTI JÓTÉKONY FUTÁS
description: The Advent Charity Run is a welcoming, family-friendly running event in Bölcske, where participants can test their abilities over 3 or 6 kilometers. Part of the entry fee goes to charity, making the event not only a sporting activity but also a chance to help others. It is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners looking to enjoy a pleasant winter running event.
course_highlights: Choose between 3 km and 6 km
A family-friendly running event supporting charity
Set in the natural surroundings of Bölcske
additional: HUF 500 from each entry fee goes to charity. Runners can choose whether to take part in the 3 km or 6 km event. Family registration is also available for the 2 km distance, for up to 4 participants. The event supports charitable causes, payment of the entry fee is mandatory, and participation is open to all ages. The run takes place at 1435/6 Csorda út, Bölcske.

name: ADVENTI KOCOGÓ
description: The Advent Jog is a charity running event held at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre in Kecskemét. The aim is to raise donations for the NM Foundation for the Recovery of Muscles, supporting children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, including Marci Nemes. The event offers participants a sense of community and an active experience while serving a worthy cause. The organizers thank all the runners and volunteers who contributed to its success.
course_highlights: The run takes place at the Benkó Zoltán Leisure Centre
A charity event supporting children with Duchenne muscular dystrophy
A community-focused sporting experience for families and runners
additional: Volunteers also help behind the scenes at the event. The run is organized for charity, supporting the local foundation and children with the condition. It is part of the Advent season; the run supports the recovery of sick children and is traditionally held every year to bring the community together.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 12. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelný bežecký závod na 2 míle (3,218 km) organizovaný Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team v areálu kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave. Závod je určený pre širokú škálu kategórií vrátane detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov. Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste od 9:30 a štart je o 10:00. Súťaž je súčasťou série, kde bežci zbierajú body do Putovného pohára Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu, pričom výsledné časy sa prepočítavajú podľa koeficientov podľa roku narodenia.
course_highlights: Dĺžka trate 2 míle (3,218 km), deti cca 200 m
Miesto konania: Areál kúpaliska Kuchajda, Bratislava
Prezentácia pri volejbalovom ihrisku
additional: Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste pri volejbalovom ihrisku od 9:30. Kategórie sú deti (13 rokov a mladší), juniori, ženy, muži, veteránky a veteráni. Súťažiaci sú bodovaní podľa počtu účastníkov v kategóriách, juniori a juniorky sú bodovaní samostatne. Pri rovnosti bodov rozhoduje rok narodenia a najlepší čas v danom roku. Na dve účasti je vyhlásená amnestia, kedy sa zrušia 2 mesiace s najnižším počtom bodov. Preteky majú rôzne kolá počas roka, vrátane decembrového 12. kola. Registrácia je možná na mieste, podrobnosti o cene nie sú špecifikované, a trať je prevažne asfaltová v mestskom prostredí.

name: Mikulášsky nočný výbeh na rozhľadňu na Balážke
location: Základná škola Hviezdoslavova, Lipany, Prešov, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné je stanovené na minimálnu sumu 7€.

description: Mikulášsky nočný výbeh na rozhľadňu na Balážke je adrenalínový nočný beh určený pre účastníkov starších ako 15 rokov. Podujatie sa koná 6. decembra 2025 so štartom o 19:00 zo Základnej školy Hviezdoslavova v Lipanoch. Bežci sa môžu tešiť na jedinečný zážitok v nočnom prostredí s výhľadom z rozhľadne. Štartovné je stanovené na minimálnu sumu 7 € a záujemcovia sa musia prihlásiť do 5. decembra 2025.
course_highlights: Nočný beh s adrenalínovou atmosférou
Trasa vedie na rozhľadňu na Balážke
Podujatie určené pre účastníkov starších ako 15 rokov
additional: Podujatie je jedinečné nočné podujatie s minimálnym štartovným 7 €. Účastníci musia byť starší ako 15 rokov. Registrácia je možná do 5. decembra 2025. Štart je zo ZŠ Hviezdoslavova v Lipanoch. nočný beh, štart zo ZŠ Hviezdoslavova, registrácia do 5.12.2025, možnosť zľavnených štartov pre skupiny a na kostýmy, podujatie zahŕňa občerstvenie a sprchy

name: Malá cena Velké Verandy
description: The Malá cena Velké Verandy is a traditional forest cross-country race held in Choceň. The race is 4,300 metres long and follows forest roads and trails, with approximately 200 metres of elevation gain. The course is marked with ribbons and includes a short stretch of asphalt. The race is also the Jirka Švadlena Memorial and is popular with runners looking for challenging terrain with a hilly profile.
course_highlights: 4,300 m along forest roads and trails
Hilly profile with approximately 200 m of elevation gain
Course marked with ribbons, approximately 400 m of asphalt
additional: The race includes approximately 400 m of asphalt and is suitable for runners looking for a challenge in a natural setting. It is part of the local sporting calendar.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - prosinec
description: The Olomouc 2-Mile Run is an open 2-mile (3.2 km) race for all ages and running abilities, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of Smetana Gardens in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily against themselves. It also includes a cup competition, with results adjusted using an age coefficient and runners collecting points throughout the year. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The start is by the fountain in the park.
course_highlights: A 2-mile (3.2 km) course in Smetana Gardens in Olomouc
A race suitable for all ages and running abilities
A picturesque park setting, with the fountain as the starting point
additional: Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:00. The race venue is by the fountain in Smetana Gardens, except for two races in June and August, which take place by the river on U Dětského domova Street. The top three finishers in each category receive awards. The race is held on an asphalt course. It is part of a series of runs in Olomouc, with multiple dates throughout the year.

name: Festiwal Biegów Świętych Mikołajów – XXIV Półmaraton Świętych Mikołajów
XV Grand Prix Krakowa w biegach górskich – Bieg Mikołajkowy
STOP-MIKULÁS FUTÁS
description: The Stop Santa Claus Run is a traditional, family-friendly running race in Tatabánya, held for the 33rd time in 2025. The event features three distances: 200 metres for young children, and 1,900 and 5,900 metres for adults and older runners. More than 200 people took part, each receiving a unique finisher’s medal, and Santa’s gifts await the youngest participants. The race has a welcoming, family atmosphere, with the organisers presenting numerous prizes and special awards. Participants can also celebrate those with December birthdays with cake and pastries.
course_highlights: Three distances: 200 m, 1,900 m and 5,900 m
Unique finisher’s medal for the 1,900 m and 5,900 m distances
Family-friendly atmosphere, with gifts from Santa for the children
additional: Runners over 70 are honoured with certificates, and the sportiest families receive a special award. The event’s main sponsors are Tatabányai SC and Stop Cukrászda, which treats participants to cake and pastries. The oldest participant completed the longest distance at the age of 87. Community support, an awards ceremony, gifts and a cheerful winter running celebration.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Nižbor
price_range: 390 Kč za závod, 1 900 Kč za 6 závodů, 2 900 Kč za celou sérii

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voucher na celou sérii 12 běhů = 2 900 Kč (240 Kč/závod)

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races in the beautiful surroundings of the Berounka River, from Radotín to Nižbor, running from January to December 2026. The routes follow trails with stunning views and varied terrain, often near nature reserves and historical sites. The series is suitable for experienced runners and beginners alike, and aims to encourage regular running. Most starts are at accessible locations with train connections and facilities at local pubs. At the end of the series, winners are announced and prizes are awarded in 12 categories.
course_highlights: Trails with views of the Berounka River and the Český kras Protected Landscape Area
Challenging climbs and nature reserves, such as Klapice and Radotínské skály
Starts at accessible locations with train connections and facilities at local pubs
additional: Refreshments, baggage storage, changing rooms with showers, and race bibs are available at the race venues. Bringing a headlamp is recommended. Rankings are based on the 10 highest-scoring races in the series. Most starts are near train stations and at local pubs that provide facilities. Trail races in the Berounka area; starts mostly accessible by train; winners announced in December; 12 categories; scoring based on the 10 best races

name: BORVIDÉK FÉLMARATON
distance_verbose: 23 km, Félmaraton, 14 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km

name: Winter Milada Run
location: Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: WINTER Milada Run is a winter running race held in the unique landscape of a former brown-coal mine, transformed into the beautiful natural setting of Lake Milada, between the Ore Mountains and the Central Bohemian Uplands. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in Chabařovice and offers 12.5 km and 5.3 km routes, as well as Olympia children’s races. The event marks the end of the running season in northern Bohemia and attracts hundreds of runners each year to the lake’s magical snowy and icy landscape. All races have a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere and are suitable for children, families and adult competitors.
course_highlights: Routes run through the natural surroundings of a former brown-coal mine transformed into Lake Milada
A winter run through the snowy and icy landscape of Lake Milada
Two main routes: a 12.5 km long route and a 5.3 km short route, plus children’s races
additional: A race pack and medal for every competitor. The official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt can be ordered during registration and collected on race day. The first 100 children to register receive a children’s T-shirt free of charge. The race is limited to 500 competitors. The accompanying programme includes St. Nicholas, a devil and an angel, and the Olympia children’s corner. Terrain in the former mine area, winter/icy conditions, family and children’s categories, on-site registration, medals for all participants, official T-shirts available for purchase.

name: Mikulášský běh Úpice
location: Náměstí v Úpici, Úpice, Czech Republic
description: The St. Nicholas Run in Úpice is a traditional running race organized by the Maratonstav Úpice sports club. The race takes place in the square in Úpice and offers categories for children and adults. The race bib is valid for the entire series of races organized by the event organizer. The event is suitable for all age groups and runners of different levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the square in Úpice, by the A. Jirásek Theatre
Categories for children and adults, with separate starts
Friendly atmosphere and the option to take part in the race series
additional: The race office opens one hour before the first category starts. Registration closes at 13:30 for the children’s categories and at 14:00 for adults. The race bib is valid for the entire race series and must be brought to each subsequent race. Results are not announced after each individual race but are published on the organizer’s website. The race takes place on 12 December 2026 in the square in Úpice. The scheduled start times are 14:00 for children and 14:30 for adults. Registration takes place one hour before the start, and results are published online.

name: Zručský adventní běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zruč Advent Run will take place for the seventh time on December 12, 2026. It is both a charity event and a race. The aim is to encourage more people to take up sport, help those in need, and give participants a chance to unwind from pre-Christmas stress by running through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas. The route passes through the beautiful chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere. You can preview it in a video or download the GPX file for your smartwatch. After the race, warm soup and mulled wine will be served to round off the event.
course_highlights: Run through Zruč, illuminated for Christmas
The route passes through the chateau park and surrounding area, filled with a festive atmosphere
Downloadable GPX route file for smartwatches
additional: The race is a charity event, and warm soup and mulled wine will be served to participants after the run. The overall male and female winners hold the course record with a time of 19:10. The route is illuminated for Christmas, and festive decorations add to the atmosphere. The event offers two distances, 900 m and 5,500 m, and is open to children and adults. It features a Christmas atmosphere and a downloadable GPX route file.

name: Předvánoční běh
description: The Pre-Christmas Run is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1984, held in Frýdek-Místek. The race offers courses for both young people and adults. Young runners take on asphalt loops in the stadium grounds ranging from 180 m to 1.7 km. Adults run kilometre loops: men run 8 km and women 3 km, with various distances available in the stadium grounds. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of the TJ Slezan Frýdek-Místek athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Asphalt loops in the stadium grounds for young runners, from 180 m to 1.7 km
Kilometre loops in Staré Město for adults — 8 km for men and 3 km for women
Race with a long-standing tradition dating back to 1984
additional: A run in the stadium grounds, with on-site registration, refreshments in the stadium clubhouse, and various distances from 200 m to 8 km

name: Vranovský noční Trail
location: Samovýčep, Vranov u Brna, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Vranov Night Trail is a winter race run in the dark around Vranov u Brna, offering a challenging yet beautiful course. The race symbolizes the balance between day and night and is the first real running test of the new season. The start and finish are at the Samovýčep venue, which has facilities including a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. After the race, warm Italian food, mulled wine and a relaxed after-party await. The organizers emphasize quality refreshments and a friendly atmosphere that runners can enjoy after finishing.
course_highlights: A 21.3 km course in the Podkomorské forests and around the reservoir
The course is marked with red-and-white and yellow tape and reflective spray
A winter race run in the dark over challenging terrain
additional: Race facilities at the Samovýčep venue include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea. There is plenty of water and sports drinks on the course. After the race, there is warm Italian food, mulled wine and an after-party with the opportunity to share feedback and socialize. A headlamp is essential. Facilities include a heated tent, hot coffee and tea, a warm post-race meal and an after-party.

name: 9 Bieg Śladami Żubra
description: The Bieg Śladami Żubra is an annual running event organized by the Aktywna Pszczyna Sports Association in Studzienice, held in December. The route follows one or two loops through Studzienice Forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest, offering scenic woodland views. The event features several distances, including the Fancy Dress Run, children’s races, 6 km and 12 km runs and Nordic Walking, as well as a half marathon and marathon. Participants can expect medals, awards for costumes, and traditional pea soup at the finish.
course_highlights: The route runs through Studzienice Forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest
Races cover one or two forest loops
Scenic woodland views and natural mud
additional: Start times are staggered: 08:00 marathon, 08:30 Fancy Dress Run (1.8 km), and 10:10 half marathon. Children’s races are offered over distances of 200 m, 400 m, 800 m and 250 m, 400 m, 850 m, depending on age. Medals and awards for the most creative costumes await at the finish. A team classification is held (the four fastest times after one loop). The route is also used for Nordic Walking. Traditional pea soup is served at the finish. GPX files are available for the half-marathon, marathon, and 6 km and 12 km routes. New marathon distance, changed start and finish location, food and recovery attractions, honorary patronages, additional cross-country races, and team classification.

location: Kasinka Mała, Mszana Dolna, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

organizer: Akademia Wychowania Fizycznego im. Jerzego Kukuczki w Katowicach
price_range: 20-110 zł, pakiety od 220 zł do 800 zł, opłaty dla pracowników i studentów 30 zł

description: Panewnicki Bieg Dzika is a recreational running and Nordic walking event held in the picturesque Panewniki forests in Katowice. The event takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 metres long, which participants can complete up to four times. It promotes an active lifestyle and education about responsible behaviour in forest areas. Participants can compete individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both recreational runners and athletes affiliated with sports clubs.
course_highlights: A route through the Panewniki forests, approximately 4,882 m long
The loop is marked every 1 km
The route can be completed up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for running and Nordic walking is 3 hours. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration accepting responsibility for their participation or provide a medical certificate. Minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian during verification. Annual race-entry packages are available for purchase. Entry fees are non-refundable but may be transferred to a subsequent race if requested by 3:00 p.m. on the Thursday before the race. The event is recreational, with a 3-hour time limit and online registration; entry fees are non-refundable. It also has an educational aspect, promoting responsible behaviour in forest areas.

name: Bieg po moczkę i makówki
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Stanowicach, Stanowice, Opole, Poland
description: Bieg po Moczkę i Makówki is an annual, friendly running event held in Stanowice. Since 2012, it has become a fixture on the holiday running calendar. The course is 10 km long, divided into four 2.5 km loops, and runners may finish after any number of loops. After the run, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and traditional moczka and makówki, and can also enjoy hot coffee and tea. The event has a relaxed, friendly atmosphere, with a prize-winning contest for the most interesting costume and a spectator competition.
course_highlights: A 10 km course divided into four 2.5 km loops
Start and finish at Stanowice Primary School, ul. Szkolna 17A
Runners may finish after any number of loops
additional: After the run, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and servings of traditional holiday dishes: moczka and makówki. A prize-winning spectator competition is held along the course, as well as a contest for the most interesting individual or group holiday-carnival costume. The event has a relaxed, friendly atmosphere and encourages active spectating. It features costume contests and recreational activities, is based at Stanowice Primary School, and offers the option to take part in the 10 km run. The event is usually held in December during the holiday season.

name: Grand Prix Dziewiczej Góry w Biegach Gór...
406. Malá cena Monaka – Vánoční
description: Malá cena Monaka - Christmas is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. This Christmas race is part of the Malá cena Monaka series and gives runners the opportunity to compete in a pleasant pre-Christmas atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public and is known for its friendly organization and sporting spirit. It is organized by KRB Chrudim, which has been organizing running events in the region for many years.
course_highlights: A traditional Christmas run in the picturesque surroundings of Slatiňany
A friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization
Part of the long-running Malá cena Monaka series
additional: The race takes place on 20 December 2026 in Slatiňany, Pardubice Region, and is part of the Malá cena Monaka series. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels.

name: Vánoční běh Opava
description: The Opava Christmas Run is a traditional running race organized by the BěhOpava association team. The race covers a 4.7 km course starting on Englišova Street and heading toward Gappay (Latarna) along a farm track with an asphalt surface, with several turns before returning to the finish. Kilometer markers are placed along the course to help runners track their performance. The race is open to various age categories, from pupils to men across several age groups. The organizers provide small prizes for the top runners and hold a prize draw for additional prizes.
course_highlights: A 4.7 km course along a farm track with an asphalt surface
Kilometer markers along the course for orientation
Start and finish by Englišova Street – the gate of the School Farm
additional: The course record is held by Petr Gebel, set in 1994 with a time of 13:39. Participants race at their own risk and are advised to take care when crossing roads and follow the organizers’ instructions. The finish judges are members and supporters of the BěhOpava association. The race takes place on an asphalt course with a slight uphill section, starts at the School Farm, and includes small prizes and a commemorative run.

name: Vánoční běh v Ďáblickém háji
location: Ďáblický háj, Praha 8, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Christmas Run in Ďáblický háj is a non-competitive running event held at the health area in Ďáblický háj in Prague 8. The course consists of two loops through Ďáblický Forest. It is mostly flat, with one gentle hill, making it suitable for runners of all levels. The event traditionally takes place on 24 December, with the first category starting at 10:00. It is organised by AVC Praha and is free of charge, fostering a friendly, community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Two loops through Ďáblický Forest
Flat terrain with one gentle hill
Woodland setting in the health area
additional: This is a non-competitive event. The start is at the health area in Ďáblický háj, and the run is free of charge. It is organised by AVC Praha. Contact: Zdeněk Weig, tel. 733 690 323. The course is suitable for all age groups. The event takes place on Christmas Eve, 24 December 2026, at the health area in Ďáblický háj.

name: Štěpánský běh Prachatice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné činí 150 Kč při přihlášení do 25. prosince 2025

description: The St. Stephen’s Run in Prachatice is a traditional sporting event being held for the 44th time, open to everyone from children to veterans. The morning program begins with children’s and youth categories. The 10 km main race and 5 km hobby race start at 11:00. The route follows paved roads, with an elevation gain of 176 metres on the main course and 68 metres on the hobby course. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Stadium in Prachatice and is part of the 2025 South Bohemian Running Cup.
course_highlights: 10 km main course with an elevation gain of 176 metres
5 km hobby race with an elevation gain of 68 metres
Start and finish in front of the Municipal Stadium in Prachatice
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available to runners in the stadium stand, and refreshments (tea and pastries) are provided at the finish. Race numbers and timing chips are issued during check-in and must be returned to the organizers after the race. Trophies, prizes in kind, and cash bonuses for breaking the course record are awarded to the top finishers. The first 100 participants in the main races to register and pay will receive gifts from sponsors. The event includes 5 km and 10 km courses. Registration is available via maraton.cz, and showers, refreshments, and facilities for runners are provided.

name: Štěpánský kros pro děti všech kategorií a Lidový běh
location: Svitavy, Svitavy District, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
description: The Štěpánský Cross-Country Race for children of all age groups and the People’s Run is an open running event held in Svitavy, with courses for children and adults on a mixed asphalt and grass surface. The race is suitable for all age groups, from the youngest children running 100 metres to adults taking part in the 4,200-metre People’s Run. The event takes place in all weather and offers a sporting atmosphere and support for all participants. Registration is available online, by email or on site on race day.

description: The St. Stephen’s Run in Zlín is a traditional running race organized by the Běhy Zlín association in Příluky. The 10 km main race consists of three laps and starts at the football field at 10 a.m. The event also includes free children’s races, held after the main race. The race offers rewards for adult runners and original medals for category winners. It attracts runners from the wider area and is part of the Běhy Zlín series.
course_highlights: 10 km main course consisting of three laps
Around the football grounds in Příluky
Children’s races after the main race

Children’s races are free, with a small reward for every child and no winners’ awards ceremony. The race is part of the Christmas season celebrations, with the awards ceremony at 11:45, and offers various categories and prizes for winners. The event takes place around the football grounds in Příluky and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Vánoční běh Třtice
description: The Třtice Christmas Run is a traditional running race held annually on December 26 in the village of Třtice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 4.8 km long, with categories based on age and gender. This popular sporting event continues a long-standing tradition and attracts runners from the surrounding area. It is part of the village’s sporting activities and offers a pleasant atmosphere for athletes and spectators alike.
course_highlights: 4.8 km course
Categories by age and gender: A (up to 39 years), B (40–49 years), C (50–59 years), D (over 60 years), E (women)
Traditional Christmas run held since 1976
additional: The race uses the same categories as the summer Třtická Punčocha run. Results from previous editions are regularly published on the village website. Třtice offers sports facilities, including a children’s playground and a multi-purpose sports court. The race takes place on December 26, 2026, and is attended by approximately 200 runners. The course is around 4.8 km long, with approximately 50 metres of elevation gain. The race is suitable for the general public and fosters a festive Christmas sporting atmosphere.

Runners can complete the half-marathon distance in four laps, or choose to run fewer laps. The event has a welcoming atmosphere, with apples, hot tea and mulled wine for participants. Every entrant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three men and women receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00, and registration is on-site, with a suggested voluntary entry fee.

The half-marathon consists of 4 laps, but runners can choose to complete fewer
A friendly, community atmosphere with apples, hot tea and mulled wine

The event is part of a long-standing tradition and promotes physical fitness and sportsmanship.

Pretekári súťažia na 10 km trati vedúcej z obce Horovce do Tušíc a späť. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka kategórie pre rôzne vekové skupiny vrátane detí. Atmosféra behu je priateľská a ideálna na zakončenie roka športovým výkonom.

description: The Silvestrovský běh in Karviná is a traditional 10 km road race held every year on December 31. The route runs along the city’s outer streets and features more than 100 metres of elevation gain, making it a challenge for every runner. The event also includes free children’s races in the local forest park, over distances from 200 m to 1.8 km. The start and registration take place at the city stadium, which also serves as the event’s base. After the race, participants can enjoy refreshments and the medal ceremony for various categories.

The race starts at 10:00, and the children’s races start at 10:05. Registration is open until December 28 or 29. The event takes place at the City Stadium and in the forest park.

It is suitable for adults, juniors, and youth runners, and concludes with New Year’s Eve refreshments at the finish. The race starts at the HAPO grounds in Havlovice, where runner registration also takes place. The event is part of a long-standing tradition of running races in the region.

New Year’s Eve refreshments at the finish

Winners are announced shortly after the race, with prizes awarded to the top finishers in each category.

It is suitable for all runners who want to end the year on an active and enjoyable note, with the option to start in different waves according to pace. After the race, there will be an awards ceremony, a get-together and refreshments for participants. The organizer, KERMI Stříbro, provides a friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.

A futók egy változatos útvonalon haladnak, amely a város és környéke utcáin vezet, és a verseny során a szél és a hideg időjárás is kihívást jelenthet. A résztvevőknek 18 év felettieknek kell lenniük a maratonon, és 16 év felettieknek a félmaratonon.

name: Zimní běh na Blaník
description: Zimní běh na Blaník is a legendary January race in the picturesque town of Načeradec, taking place on 16 January 2027. The event offers two main races: a challenging 19.9 km main race over Velký and Malý Blaník, and an accompanying 11.2 km race. The routes pass through the beautiful Podblanicko countryside, with significant climbs, forest sections, and views from the lookout tower on Velký Blaník. The start and finish are right in the centre of Načeradec, with cosy facilities. The race is limited to 700 runners, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and high-quality organisation.

description: The Świętokrzyski Winter Marathon is a unique outdoor event held in the scenic Świętokrzyskie Mountains, around Chęciny and Ciekoty. Participants can choose between two routes: Royal Battle and Knights’ Charge, which cross natural terrain in challenging winter conditions. The event attracts hundreds of runners and hiking enthusiasts from across Poland every year, offering a distinctive atmosphere and beautiful views. The organizers look after participants’ safety and comfort, providing refreshment and checkpoint stations along the routes.

Refreshment and checkpoint stations along the routes, and a GPX file available to download

Race packets are issued only to participants with a signed Participant Card and proof of identity. The event does not provide official timing; it focuses on outdoor activity and tourism, with tourist attractions and a sense of community. Registration is available through the B4SPORTONLINE platform.

For years, the organizers have promoted outdoor activity and mountain tourism by creating and restoring hiking trails. This event is for those who enjoy long-distance challenges and being close to nature.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains
Scenic landscapes and natural hiking trails
Routes suitable for running, hiking and run-walks
additional: The organizers also restore and promote hiking trails in the region. The event is part of a broader range of outdoor activities in the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. Aid and checkpoint stations are available to participants, as is the option to download a GPX file with the routes. The event is aimed at runners and hikers taking on challenging winter conditions.

description: Tihany Trail is a winter trail-running and Nordic walking race held on varied, challenging terrain in the beautiful surroundings of the Balaton Uplands. The course is especially distinctive because participants run along the rim of the caldera and on a rocky cliff edge, making for an exciting and scenic race. Participants can choose from 5, 10 and 15 km distances, and aid stations provide hydration and energy. This is a real treat for trail runners, attracting running enthusiasts even in winter.

Aid stations with water, energy drink, glucose tablets and salted pretzels

There will be no cups at the aid stations, so participants must bring a flask or cup. On the 15 km course, the first aid station is at the Forest School (approximately 6.9 km) and the second is beside the Apáti Church (approximately 10.3 km). <i:am> mineral+ energy drink and cherry-flavoured hypotonic drink are also available on the course. Trail-running shoes are recommended, with anti-slip aids if needed; road-running shoes are not suitable for the terrain. The race starts at 10:30. The event centre is at Tihanyi Bencés Iskola, Tihany, Csokonai u. 73. The organisers recommend trail-running shoes and, if needed, anti-slip aids.
