The start is at the Rožnov campsite and the finish is by the chapel on Radhošť at an elevation of 1,129 m above sea level. The race is open to all runners over 15 and offers categories by age and gender. The event also includes an accompanying programme and children’s races.
course_highlights: 6.5 km course with 734 m of elevation gain
The first kilometre is on asphalt, followed by rocky terrain and forest paths
Finish by the chapel on Radhošť at an elevation of 1,129 m above sea level
additional: Transport of belongings to the finish is provided by car from the start at 9:30; transport for people is not provided. The award ceremony is scheduled for approximately 13:00 in the campsite grounds. Vehicles are prohibited from driving to the summit of Radhošť without a permit. Runners compete at their own risk; participants under 15 may take part only with written consent from a legal guardian. The race is intended for participants aged 15 and over; children’s races are also part of the programme. According to the available information, refreshments, chip timing and a participant medal are provided.

name: Vratislavický Běhoun 2026
location: Koupaliště Sluníčko, Vratislavice nad Nisou, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: Vratislavický Běhoun is a traditional cross-country race, held for the 32nd year at the Sluníčko swimming pool complex in Vratislavice nad Nisou. The courses run mostly along field and forest paths, with a short section on asphalt, offering a pleasant running experience in a natural setting. The race is also part of the Mayor of Vratislavice nad Nisou’s Traveling Cup and is suitable for the general public and runners of all ages. RunBo Team organizes the event, ensuring it runs smoothly and has a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Courses run along field and forest paths, with a short section on asphalt
Start and finish at the Sluníčko swimming pool complex in Vratislavice nad Nisou
A long-standing cross-country race (32nd edition)
additional: The start and finish for all categories are at the Sluníčko swimming pool complex. The race is part of the Mayor of Vratislavice nad Nisou’s Traveling Cup. It is organized by RunBo Team z.s. The race is associated with the Mayor of Vratislavice nad Nisou’s Traveling Cup.

name: Hodinovka Veselí nad Lužnicí
location: Veselí nad Lužnicí, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hodinovka Veselí nad Lužnicí is an hourly race organized by the South Bohemian Marathon Club and held on a tartan surface in Veselí nad Lužnicí. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and gives runners the opportunity to test themselves in a one-hour run with precise performance measurement. This traditional event is suitable for the general public as well as competitive runners looking to improve their endurance and pacing strategy in a timed race. The organizers provide a friendly atmosphere and quality facilities for all participants.
course_highlights: One-hour race on a tartan track
Precise performance measurement over 1 hour
Part of the South Bohemian Running Cup
additional: The race counts toward the South Bohemian Running Cup standings. It is organized by Martin Gazda, the cup manager. Results and photos from previous editions are available. The organizer can be contacted with any questions. The race starts at 10:00. The race is organized by Martin Gazda.

name: Bělkovický kros
location: Bělkovice-Lašťany, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: Bělkovický Cross-Country Run is a traditional race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque surroundings of Bělkovice-Lašťany near Olomouc. The race is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Endurance Runners and gives athletes the opportunity to test themselves in a fitness and performance run. The Liga stovkařů club is known for its long-standing tradition and support of the running community in central Moravia. The race is suitable for the general public, including children and young people, who have their own race series.
course_highlights: Run in the natural surroundings of Bělkovice-Lašťany
Part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Endurance Runners
Traditional endurance race with a long history

name: Běh metropole MČ Praha 6
location: Park Ladronka, Praha 6, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Run of the Metropolis, Prague 6 District, is part of a series of public running races held across Prague’s city districts. The series promotes a healthy lifestyle and residents’ sense of belonging to their district. The race is open to all ages, from children to seniors, as well as to people with disabilities, who represent their district. Every participant contributes points to their district’s score in the series. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, and original medals for each category serve as a memento of the race.
course_highlights: Ladronka Park in Prague 6
Part of the Run of the Metropolis running series
Runners represent their city district
additional: The race is part of a series in which each participant represents the district where they have permanent residence and contributes to the competition to find Prague’s most athletic district. Special medals are prepared for each category as a memento of the race.

name: Lesní půlmaraton Říčany
location: Říčany, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Říčany Forest Half Marathon is a cross-country and trail race through the picturesque countryside around Říčany near Prague. It offers distances of 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km, suitable for runners of various levels. The race is organized by Jan Kalkus and is part of the Czech Running Club under the Czech Athletics Federation. The main category traditionally starts at 11:00, attracting runners looking for an enjoyable race in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail race routes
Distances of 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km
Picturesque countryside around Říčany near Prague
additional: The race is part of the Czech Running Club and the Czech Athletics Federation. It is organized by Jan Kalkus. Entry fees start at CZK 329. The race offers several distances suitable for different runners. The main category starts at 11:00. The stated start time for the main category is 11:00.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Abertamy
location: Abertamy, Karlovy Vary Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s., Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Běžím Krušnohořím Abertamy is part of a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. The event offers a 7 km main running race, an experience route of 20 to 30 km with participants choosing their own route using a map, a walk with checkpoint hunting, and children’s races of various distances. The event is suitable for the general public, including families with children, seniors, and nature lovers. It starts in Abertamy, a town with a rich history and beautiful nature at an altitude of around 900 metres.
course_highlights: 7 km main race in the Ore Mountains
20–30 km experience route, with participants choosing their own course using a map
Children’s races from 200 m to 1,400 m, plus a walk with checkpoint hunting
additional: Registration opens at 07:00. The experience route starts between 07:30 and 08:00, with individual start times. The main canicross race starts between 08:15 and 08:45, also with individual start times. Prize-giving takes place from 11:00 (canicross, children’s races, walking and dog trekking) and at approximately 13:00 (running and the experience route). The course for the experience route and the walk/dog trek is available at registration before the start. Routes are available for children according to age category, and the main race course is also suitable for runners with dogs.

name: Chrastavská desítka
description: Chrastava Ten is a successful 10 km running race starting from 1 May Square in Chrastava. The first edition took place at the end of August, and the course was very popular with runners. The race is held under the auspices of the town of Chrastava and offers a pleasant road course suitable for the general public.
course_highlights: 10-kilometre road course
Start and finish at 1 May Square in Chrastava
Pleasant weather and a course popular with runners

name: Sherwood kros
location: Porubský les, Ostrava-Poruba, Ostrava, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dospělý účastník 350,- Kč on-line (platba nejpozději do 23. 4. 2026)

description: Sherwood Cross-Country is a running race held in Poruba Forest in Ostrava-Poruba. The course runs mainly along unpaved forest paths through natural, more challenging terrain. The race is suitable for trail-running enthusiasts, and running shoes with suitable tread for cross-country and trail running are recommended. The event also includes children’s races on a paved loop near Porubská Myslivna, with children competing in different age categories. The main race is divided into categories by age and gender, and every participant who completes the course receives an original finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: Race mainly along unpaved forest paths in Poruba Forest
Children’s races on a paved loop near Porubská Myslivna
Challenging natural terrain suited to trail-running shoes
additional: The maximum number of participants is limited to 400. The children’s races start at 10:00, with approximately 10-minute intervals between categories. The children’s category awards ceremony is at 11:00, and the main race starts at 12:00. Every participant who completes the race receives an original finisher’s medal; children also receive a sweet treat. Trophies and prizes are prepared for category winners. The main race has age and gender categories. Everyone who completes the course receives a finisher’s medal; winners receive trophies and prizes.

name: Běh Škarmanem (Domažlice)
organizer: Sportovní klub policie ŠPS Domažlice z. s.
description: Běh Škarmanem is a traditional cross-country race held in Domažlice in Škarman Forest Park. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series and offers adults and junior athletes the chance to run in a beautiful natural setting. The start is at 10:00, and the race has a friendly atmosphere that welcomes runners of all levels. Participants can enjoy more challenging forest trails that test their endurance and strength.

name: Pieniny Ultra Trail Spiski Wędrowiec - 135.7 km
IV Siemianowicki Bieg i Nordic Walking
V ATT RUN FUN Półmaraton Polkowicki
IX. Miklósi Futónap
description: A IX. Miklósi Futónap egy családbarát futóverseny Szigetszentmiklóson, amely 2026. április 26-án kerül megrendezésre. A verseny több távon kínál lehetőséget a futásra, 500 métertől egészen a félmaratonig (21 km). A rendezvény a Városi Sportcsarnok elől indul, és a Szebeni út, Petőfi út, Gerincút útvonalon halad, majd visszatér a sportcsarnokhoz. A futók számára öltöző, ruhatár és WC is biztosított a helyszínen. A verseny célja a sport és közösség népszerűsítése minden korosztály számára.

name: III. Strázsa-hegyi Trail Futóverseny 2 / 5 / 10 / 21
description: A III. Strázsa-hegyi Toyota Kovács Trail Futóverseny 2026. április 26-án kerül megrendezésre Monoron, a Strázsahegyi dűlőben. A versenyen 500 méteres családi futam, valamint 2, 5, 10 kilométeres és félmaratoni távok közül választhatnak a résztvevők. A futók változatos terepen, természetközeli környezetben teljesíthetik a távokat, melyek között megtalálhatók a 10 km-es és félmaratoni útvonalak is. A rendezvény célja a sport és a természet szeretetének népszerűsítése, családbarát hangulatban.

name: STRÁZSA-HEGYI TRAIL
description: A III. Strázsa-hegyi Toyota Kovács Trail Futóverseny 2026. április 26-án kerül megrendezésre Monoron, a Szent Orbán téren. Ez a harmadik alkalom, hogy a versenyzők a festői Strázsa-hegy környékén, változatos terepen mérhetik össze erejüket. A futóverseny családias hangulatban, természetközeli környezetben kínál kihívást minden résztvevőnek. A rendezvény a sport és a közösségi élmény jegyében zajlik, várva a futás szerelmeseit.

name: ÍROTTKŐ HILLCLIMB
description: Az Írottkő Hillclimb egy változatos és emlékezetes hegyi futóverseny, amely 2026. április 26-án kerül megrendezésre Kőszeg Rőtfalva környékén. A verseny új rajthelyszínnel, Bozsokról indul, és több távon kínál kihívást a futóknak, a 7 km-es bevezető terepfutástól a 102 km-es Alpokalja Ultráig. A pályák változatos terepen, szép panorámákkal és frissítőpontokkal várják a résztvevőket, akiknek kitartásra és jó fizikai felkészültségre lesz szükségük. A verseny családbarát programokat is kínál, így a legkisebbek is élvezhetik a természetvédelmi és interaktív kiállításokat.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
description: A Futapest Terepfutás Bér verseny egy izgalmas terepfutó esemény, amely Bér, Virágospuszta festői környezetében kerül megrendezésre. A futók változatos, természetközeli útvonalakon mérhetik össze erejüket, élvezve a természet szépségeit és a kihívást jelentő terepet. A verseny a Futapest Klub szervezésében zajlik, amely hosszú évek óta támogatja a terepfutás és crossfutás sportágát Magyarországon. Minden futót szeretettel várnak, akik szeretnének egy jó hangulatú, közösségi futóeseményen részt venni.

name: Přeštická desítka
description: Přeštická desítka is a traditional running race in Přeštice, offering a fast, flat ten-kilometre course on soft terrain along the Úhlava River. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup and is open to both competitive and recreational runners of all ages. In addition to the main 10 km race, there is also a 5 km Fit Run and children’s races. The start and finish are at the Loděnice venue, which offers comfortable facilities, including a buffet, heated changing rooms and hot showers.
course_highlights: Flat 10 km course on soft terrain along the Úhlava River
Part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup
Facilities at the Loděnice venue include a buffet, changing rooms and showers
additional: Registration opens at 9:00 at the Loděnice venue. The awards ceremony takes place after the last runner finishes, usually around noon. Facilities include an open buffet, heated changing rooms, hot showers and toilets. Homemade treats prepared by the organizers are included in the entry fee. Race facilities are at the Loděnice venue.

name: 6666m
location: Chotěšov, Ústí nad Labem Region, Czech Republic
description: The 6666m Run in Chotěšov is a cross-country race covering 6666 metres, held in the picturesque surroundings of the Ústí nad Labem Region. The race gives runners the chance to enjoy natural terrain and the sporting atmosphere of regional running events. The start is traditionally in the afternoon, and the race is suitable for a wide range of people who enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain in the natural surroundings of Chotěšov
A course exactly 6666 metres long
An afternoon start with the atmosphere of a regional running event
additional: The organiser is O. Maršík, who can be contacted by phone at 606 248 978. Registration takes place directly on the race website. Results from previous editions are archived on the website. The start time is 16:00. The email address is protected against spam and is not directly available.

name: Macurův memoriál
organizer: DSO – Prostřední Bečva a Horní Bečva
description: The Macura Memorial is a legendary run held in the picturesque surroundings of Martinák in Horní Bečva. The race offers a wide range of categories for children and adults, from the youngest runners on short courses to the main 4.15 km race. Participants can enjoy the atmosphere of a traditional run, with changing rooms and a valuables storage facility available. After the race, a refreshment area with broth and drinks will be ready. The main categories start at 16:00, with the results announced at 17:00.
course_highlights: A 4.15 km course for the main categories
Children’s categories with courses from 170 m to 960 m
Start and finish in the grounds in front of the primary school in Horní Bečva
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available in the small gym at the primary school. A valuables storage facility is also provided and is accessible only with a race number. Participants will receive a chip, race number, voucher for a beer or Kofola, and broth at the finish. The last transport to the start of the main categories leaves at 15:45. The program includes children’s categories. Showers and a valuables storage facility are available to participants.

name: Běh Hvězdou - Memoriál Vladimíra Fiřta
description: Běh Hvězdou – Vladimír Fiřt Memorial is a running race in Prague 6, offering men a 6.6 km course and women a 3.3 km course. The race is part of the SABZO series and attracts runners looking for a quality race atmosphere in an urban setting. The event is open to the general public and offers a chance to test your strength on an interesting course.
course_highlights: 6.6 km course for men
3.3 km course for women
Part of the SABZO series

name: Mintal Nemčiansky beh
organizer: Marathon Banska Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z.
description: Mintal Nemčiansky beh je bežecké podujatie v obci Nemce, ktoré ponúka trate pre deti aj dospelých. Preteky sa konajú na rôznych vzdialenostiach od 1 000 m pre deti až po 10,6 km pre dospelých. Trať vedie po poľnej ceste a spevnenom turistickom chodníku, čo zabezpečuje príjemný zážitok z behu v prírode. Podujatie je organizované Marathon Banská Bystrica, s.r.o., ON-POINT o.z. a Nemciansky Beh OZ a je vhodné pre širokú vekovú kategóriu bežcov.

name: Podvihorlatský maratón, Michalovský polmaratón
location: Michalovce, Michalovce, pred MsÚ v Michalovciach
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, Obec Vinné
description: Podvihorlatský maratón a Michalovský polmaratón sú tradičné bežecké podujatia konané v krásnom prostredí Zemplínskej šíravy a mesta Michalovce. Preteky ponúkajú maratónsku trať, polmaratón a polmaratónsku štafetu, ktoré sú vhodné pre širokú verejnosť vrátane skúsených bežcov aj rekreačných športovcov. Organizátori zabezpečujú kvalitné služby vrátane elektronickej časomierky, občerstvenia na trati a v cieli, štýlových tričiek a účastníckych medailí. Podujatie je známe svojou priateľskou atmosférou a podporou bežeckej komunity v regióne.

name: ETHOS Májový beh cyklotrasou
location: Krásno nad Kysucou, Krásno nad Kysucou, Námestie pred Kultúrnym domom
description: ETHOS Májový beh cyklotrasou je štvrtý ročník bežeckej súťaže, ktorá sa uskutoční 1. mája 2026 v Krásne nad Kysucou. Preteky vedú po cyklotrase v krásnom prírodnom horskom prostredí s minimálnou premávkou, čo zaručuje bezpečný a príjemný zážitok. Súťažiť je možné na certifikovaných tratiach v kategóriách muži a ženy, s rôznymi vekovými skupinami. Organizátor vyzýva pretekárov na online registráciu a zabezpečuje občerstvenie a medaily pre všetkých účastníkov.

name: Medzinárodný pouličný beh Komárom – Komárno
organizer: Bežecký spolok Komárom - Európa (KEFE), Komárom-Európa Futó Egyesület (KEFE)
description: Medzinárodný pouličný beh Komárom - Komárno je tradičný bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná v meste Komárno s štartom pri Mestskej športovej hale. Pretek ponúka trate na 5,5 km a 10 km, ako aj detskú súťaž, pričom štart je na križovatke ulíc Arany János a Vág v Komárome. Podujatie je organizované Bežeckým spolkom Komárom - Európa (KEFE) a je vhodné pre širokú vekovú kategóriu bežcov. Atmosféra preteku je medzinárodná a priateľská, s dôrazom na športový výkon a komunitný zážitok.

name: Pečovskonovoveský šľapák – prvomájový beh zdravia
location: Pečovská Nová Ves okr. Sabinov, Pečovská Nová Ves okr. Sabinov, Základná škola Pečovská Nová Ves
organizer: Obecný úrad Pečovská Nová Ves, základná škola s materskou školou Pečovská Nová Ves
description: Pečovskonovoveský šľapák - prvomájový beh zdravia je tradičný bežecký pretek organizovaný Obecným úradom Pečovská Nová Ves a základnou školou s materskou školou v Pečovskej Novej Vsi. Pretek je určený pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí, juniorov a dospelých v rôznych vekových kategóriách. Súťaž prebieha v kategóriách podľa veku a pohlavia, vrátane behu o cenu starostu obce na 5 km. Podujatie podporuje zdravý životný štýl a športové aktivity v komunite.

name: Primátorská desiatka
location: Poprad,, Poprad,, Poprad Kvetnica časť Strelnica
organizer: Mesto Poprad, MsÚ Poprad, Centrum voľného času Poprad, Mestské lesy Poprad, Triklub Poprad
description: Primátorská desiatka je tradičný bežecký pretek v Poprade, ktorý sa koná v časti Kvetnica - Strelnica. Pretek je určený pre deti, mládež aj dospelých, s kategóriami rozdelenými podľa veku a pohlavia. Štart pre deti a mládež je o 10:00, hlavná kategória štartuje o 10:45. Organizátormi sú Mesto Poprad, MsÚ Poprad, Centrum voľného času Poprad, Mestské lesy Poprad a Triklub Poprad. Pretek ponúka príjemnú atmosféru a možnosť športového vyžitia pre všetky vekové kategórie.

name: Zay Cross
organizer: Čachtické podzemie o.z., PD Uhrovec, člen skupiny AGRAVITAL, RZP a.s.
description: Zay Cross je bežecké podujatie, ktoré sa uskutoční 1. mája 2026 v obci Žitná-Radiša na futbalovom ihrisku. Pretekári si môžu vybrať medzi dvoma traťami - hlavnou 14 km traťou s prevýšením +550 m a malou 5 km traťou s prevýšením +200 m. Trasy vedú kombináciou asfaltu, lesných ciest, chodníkov a trávnatých lúk, pričom sú dobre značené a zabezpečené občerstvovacími stanicami. Podujatie ponúka aj detské behy a atrakcie v bezpečnom prostredí areálu štartu a cieľa. Organizátorom je Občianske združenie Čachtické podzemie spolu s partnermi a obcou Žitná-Radiša.

name: Charitatívny beh Liskovským chotárom
location: Lisková, Lisková, Základná škola, ul. Pod Chočom 550
description: Charitatívny beh Liskovským chotárom je bežecké podujatie v Liskovej, ktoré ponúka kategórie pre deti, dorast, juniorov, dospelých a hobby bežcov vrátane Nordic Walkingu. Štartuje sa pri Základnej škole na ulici Pod Chočom 550, pričom žiaci štartujú o 9:00 a hlavný a hobby beh o 10:45. Preteky sú vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a podporujú charitatívne účely. Organizátorom je Jozef Bukový, ktorý poskytuje informácie o podujatí.

name: Memoriál Luboše Svobody – cena Běžce Vysočiny

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 Kč - muži, junioři, ženy, juniorky přihlášené on-line

description: The Luboš Svoboda Memorial – Vysočina Runner’s Prize is a traditional running race held in Heulos Forest Park in Jihlava. The race offers various categories for men, women, juniors, youth and children, with distances ranging from 1.2 km to 8.8 km. The course follows paved and unpaved paths through the forest park, including a 2.2 km loop, and is suitable for recreational runners. The race commemorates runner Luboš Svoboda and has been held regularly since 2008 as a major sporting event in the Vysočina Region.
course_highlights: A 2.2 km loop along paved and unpaved paths in Heulos Forest Park
Part of the course runs along the Jihlávka River and past the Summer Cinema amphitheatre
Various distances for all age groups, from 1.2 km to 8.8 km
additional: The start is at the Na Stoupách Athletics Stadium in Jihlava. Changing rooms are available beneath the stadium grandstand, along with toilets. Online registration is open until 12:00 on race day; a season ticket for race entries can be used. The course is run in the opposite direction to the one shown on the map. The race is divided into age categories with different course distances. The main course is 8.8 km; the race includes categories for children and veterans.

name: Běh na Doubravku
location: Tenisové kurty Panorama, Teplice, Ústí nad Labem Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run to Doubravka is a traditional sporting event held in Teplice, celebrating the arrival of spring each year. The race is part of an all-day sports event at Doubravka, where participants and visitors can enjoy a range of sporting and cultural activities in addition to the run. The course has been changed from previous years and starts at the Panorama tennis courts. The event is suitable for the general public, including those who don’t want to run but would like to have fun and take part in other sports.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Panorama tennis courts in Teplice
Course changed from previous years
Includes an accompanying sports and cultural programme
additional: The event is part of a sports day at Doubravka, featuring games, strength events, shooting, axe throwing and live music. Chip timing was introduced in 2022 for accurate timekeeping.

name: Karlovský kopcovák
location: Karlov Hill (svah Karlova), Benešov, Czech Republic
description: Karlovský kopcovák is a traditional running race held on the slope of Karlov in Benešov. The race is 4.5 km long and is part of the Běžec Podblanicka series, which offers a varied calendar of running events in the region. This race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge on hilly terrain and wanting to enjoy the atmosphere of a spring run in picturesque surroundings. Registration is available online in advance, making it easy for a wide range of runners to take part.
course_highlights: Race distance: 4.5 km
Hilly terrain on the slope of Karlov in Benešov
Part of the Běžec Podblanicka series
additional: The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka series, which includes 11 races per year. Categories are divided by age and gender, with points awarded to the first 9 places. Participation in at least 4 races is required to be included in the overall standings.

name: Běh KERMI
location: Areál společnosti KERMI, Stříbro, Czech Republic
organizer: KERMI ve spolupráci se Sdružením vytrvalců Stříbro

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné: 150 Kč, přihlášky na místě v areálu KERMI, školící centrum

description: The KERMI Run is a traditional 10.5 km race that runs mostly off-road, starting and finishing at the KERMI company premises in Stříbro. The race is suitable for the general public, including runners of different speeds, as participants can start at 10:00 or in the main start at 10:30. After the race, there will be an awards ceremony, a social gathering and refreshments for participants. It is organised by the Stříbro Endurance Runners Association, which supports amateur athletes and runners in the region.
course_highlights: A 10.5 km route, mostly off-road
Start and finish at the KERMI premises in Stříbro
Choice of a 10:00 or 10:30 start
additional: Registration takes place on race day at the KERMI premises, in the training centre. Refreshments and drinks will be available after the race. The organisers allow slower runners to start as early as 10:00 so everyone can enjoy the race at their own pace. Participants can start at 10:00 or in the main start at 10:30; the race is followed by an awards ceremony, a social gathering and refreshments.

name: Jarní přespolní běh Nýrsko
location: Areál pod Sjezdovkou, Nýrsko, Czech Republic
description: The Spring Cross-Country Run in Nýrsko is a traditional race organized by TJ Nýrsko z.s., held at the venue below the ski slope. The race offers courses in the sports area below Pajrek, with 20 metres of elevation gain per lap. The event is open to the general public, including children’s categories, and is part of the Ešus League series of off-track races in the Klatovy District. The organizers provide refreshments and prizes for the top finishers in each category.
course_highlights: The courses run through the Sports Area below Pajrek
Each lap has 20 metres of elevation gain
The race is part of the Ešus League series of off-track races in the Klatovy District
additional: On-site registration opens at 12:00, and closes 15 minutes before the start of each category. Competitors take part at their own risk; children compete under their parents’ responsibility. Refreshments are available at the venue below the ski slope. Prizes are awarded to the first three finishers in each category. Children’s categories start at 13:00, and the main race starts at 14:00.

name: Boskovické běhy
location: Boskovice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Boskovice Runs are a major sporting event in the Boskovice region, offering routes of various lengths, including the main 12.5 km Run over the Seven-Toothed Ridge. The event is for athletes as well as families with children, who can compete in children’s categories. Alongside the races, there is a varied program of activities, and hikers can join the runners. The Boskovice Runs promote a healthy lifestyle and community gatherings in a pleasant setting.
course_highlights: The main Run over the Seven-Toothed Ridge course is 12.5 km long
The route includes two long forest sections
Children’s races for all age groups
additional: Registration is also possible on site, and race numbers can be collected as early as the Thursday before the race. A new feature is a race for teams of three. The opportunity to receive a race number bearing your name is available for a limited time. The Boskovice Runs are held under the patronage of the town’s mayor, Jaroslav Dohnálek. The event also features a varied program of activities, including a cycling skills demonstration.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem
location: Zámecký park, Horšovský Týn, Czech Republic
organizer: Aktiv Sport Horšovský Týn, z. s.
description: The Run through the Castle Park is a sporting event organized by Aktiv Sport Horšovský Týn, held in the picturesque surroundings of the Castle Park in Horšovský Týn. The race is part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup and Běžec Chodska, creating a high-quality sporting atmosphere and competitive opportunities for runners of all levels. The event is scheduled for the afternoon of April 30, 2027, and offers an enjoyable experience in nature, with the opportunity to relax actively and take on a sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Run in the historic Castle Park
Part of the Plzeň Region Running Cup and Běžec Chodska
Picturesque natural surroundings in Horšovský Týn
additional: The race is included in the Plzeň Region Running Cup and Běžec Chodska. The race traditionally starts at 14:00. The venue is the Castle Park in Horšovský Týn. The organizer is Aktiv Sport Horšovský Týn. The date of April 30, 2027, is not confirmed in the available sources. In 2026, the race was scheduled for May 1 at 14:00.

name: Běh Krásné vyhlídky
location: Hliněný rybník, Struhařov, Benešov District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Beautiful Views Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque surroundings of Struhařov near Mnichovice. The race follows a unique panoramic route along the new Krásné vyhlídky nature trail, built by the Mnichovice and Surroundings Seniors’ Club in cooperation with local municipalities and the school. The main race is 7.4 km long and is part of the Pohár Ladova kraje running series. In addition to the main race, accompanying races are held for children and juniors. The event venue and race start are at Hliněný Pond in Struhařov.
course_highlights: Unique panoramic route along the Krásné vyhlídky nature trail
7.4 km loop for the main race
Accompanying races around the pond for children and juniors
additional: Registration for the main race is open from 14:00 to 16:00, and the main race starts at 16:30. Registration for the accompanying races for children and juniors is open from 13:00 to 14:30, and they start at 14:45. Categories include preschoolers (200 m), schoolchildren (620 m) and juniors (1860 m). The fastest man and woman from Struhařov are recognized in the main race. The race is made possible by volunteers, local associations and partners. It is part of the Pohár Ladova kraje running series; accompanying races for children are also held.

name: Běh Údolím vzdechů
location: Sudoměřice u Tábora, South Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Valley of Sighs Run is a traditional cross-country race organized by TJ Sokol Sudoměřice u Tábora. It has been held in the spring for several years. The race attracts enthusiastic athletes of all ages and offers an opportunity to enjoy a run in the picturesque surroundings of Sudoměřice u Tábora. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and community spirit, which promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through a picturesque valley
Traditional spring date on May 1
Suitable for children and adult runners
additional: Race results are published after the event. The event is organized by TJ Sokol Sudoměřice u Tábora. In previous editions, photos and downloadable results lists were available. The run is part of local sporting activities and community events.

name: Běh údolím samoty
location: Radvanec, Nový Bor, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The Run through the Valley of Samota is a traditional district running race held in the picturesque setting of Radvanec near Nový Bor in the Liberec Region. The race is part of the Českolipsko District Running League and gives runners the chance to test themselves on natural routes with varied terrain. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle amid the region’s beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Natural terrain in the Valley of Samota
Picturesque surroundings of Radvanec near Nový Bor
Part of the Českolipsko District Running League

name: Běh pro Paměť národa - Chomutov
description: The Run for the Memory of the Nation in Chomutov is a charity event held in support of the nonprofit organization Post Bellum, which documents the stories of eyewitnesses and helps them. The race takes place at Wakepark Chomutov and is part of a series of runs held throughout the Czech Republic. Participants run with a mass start, and the entry fee is a donation to a good cause, helping fund the recording and processing of eyewitness stories. The event is open to the general public and also offers the option of running symbolically anywhere outside the official course.
course_highlights: Mass-start run at Wakepark Chomutov
Charity event supporting the memory of the nation and eyewitnesses
Option to take part in a symbolic run anywhere in the Czech Republic or abroad
additional: Registered runners receive their race number at check-in on race day. It is recommended that they write any allergies and emergency contact details on the back of their race number in case of medical complications. Results are announced after the last runner has finished. The event is part of a wider series of runs throughout the Czech Republic and includes a corporate team run and a run anywhere. The race offers a timed 5 km course and an untimed 1 km family run.

name: Král Zvičiny 2026
description: Král Zvičiny 2026 is a mass-start individual uphill road race and an ideal way to start the season. The race takes place on May 1, 2026, starting in Dvůr Králové nad Labem and finishing at Raisova chata on Zvičina. The main race route is approximately 10 km long, on asphalt, with a continuous climb. Children can take part in a shorter 3 km route finishing in Dehtov. After the race, the results are announced at Motorest U Lípy in Třebihošť.
course_highlights: Main route: Lipnice → Dehtov → Třebihošť → Zvičina, approx. 10 km, asphalt, continuous climb
Children’s route: Lipnice → Dehtov, 3 km, asphalt, continuous climb
Finish at Raisova chata on Zvičina
additional: Registration takes place from 8:30 to 9:30 in Dvůr Králové - Lipnice - Zaháj. The results are announced at Motorest U Lípy in Třebihošť. Parking is available at Motorest U Lípy and at the Rodos company (start location). Categories are divided by age and gender, including youth and children.

name: LENART XI Bieg Uliczny o Puchar Starosty Powiatu Kępińskiego
XIII Bieg Borków
location: Osieczna, Leszno County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: XIII Bieg Tropami Śląskich Dinozaurów
location: Lisowice, Gmina Pawonków, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Etyekrun
organizer: RUNaway Sportszervező Kft. és Etyek Trend
description: Az EtyekRUN egy különleges futóverseny Etyek lankáin, ahol a borvidék hangulata, dűlők, szőlősorok és a tavaszi táj kíséri a résztvevőket minden lépésükön. A verseny a Garmin WTF sorozat része, amely a mozgás örömét és a teljesítmények sokszínűségét ünnepli, legyen szó akár rövidebb aszfaltos, akár hosszabb terepfutó távokról. A rendezvény családbarát, és a közösségben a fenntarthatóság, a következetesség és az öröm áll a középpontban. A versenyzők egyedülálló élményben részesülnek a természet és a borvidék szépségei között.

name: XI. Ezerjó Félmaraton 5 / 10 / 21
description: Az XI. Ezerjó Félmaraton 2026. május 1-jén kerül megrendezésre Móron, a Szent István téren. A verseny három távon kínál kihívást: 5 km, 10 km és félmaraton (21 km). A futók gyönyörű szőlőhegyek között, változatos terepen, emelkedőkkel és panorámás kilátással teljesíthetik a távokat. A rendezvény családbarát, gyerekfutamokkal is várja a kisebbeket, és a célban frissítőkkel, befutóéremmel díjazza a résztvevőket. A verseny egyedi hangulatát a helyi borvidék és a közösségi élmény adja.

name: FUT AZ ÜLLŐ
description: A "Fut az Üllő" egy hagyományos városi futóverseny, amely Üllő városközpontjában kerül megrendezésre. A verseny célja a sport és a közösségi élet népszerűsítése, amely minden korosztály számára nyitott. A rendezvényen korlátozott számban helyszíni nevezés is lehetséges a verseny napján reggel 7 órától. A verseny szervezője Üllő Város Önkormányzata, amely a helyi közösség támogatásával biztosítja a rendezvény sikerét.

name: Behaj lesmi – Smolenice
description: Behaj lesmi Smolenice je súčasťou série siedmich pretekov v krásnej slovenskej prírode, ktoré ponúkajú trasy prevažne na mäkkom povrchu a v čerstvom vzduchu. Preteky sú zaradené do UTMB Index Races, čo znamená medzinárodné bodové hodnotenie trailových pretekov. Trasy vedú pod Smolenickým zámkom, kde bežcov povzbudzujú tematické postavy a vytvárajú tak jedinečnú atmosféru. Súťažiť môžete na dvoch hlavných trasách - 12 km a 19 km, pričom na trati je aj rýchlostný úsek Conti Speed Section s hodnotnou cenou.

name: Tlmačský polmaratón
location: Tlmače okr. Levice, Tlmače okr. Levice, Tlmače – Lipník, Nám. odborárov
description: Tlmačský polmaratón a desiatka je tradičný bežecký závod, ktorý sa koná v meste Tlmače. Tento 43. ročník pretekov ponúka polmaratónsku trať dlhú 21 km a desiatku, pričom súčasťou je aj hobby beh a nordic walking na 3,5 km. Podujatie je súčasťou Bežeckej ligy Patriotov a organizuje ho mesto Tlmače spolu s miestnymi športovými klubmi. Bežci si môžu vychutnať kvalitnú organizáciu, elektronické meranie času a štartovné balíčky s propagačnými predmetmi a poukážkou na stravu.

name: Tlmačský polmaraton (10 km)
organizer: Mesto Tlmače, MsKS Tlmače, ZŠ a MŠ Tlmače, Atletický klub mesta Tlmače
description: Tlmačský polmaratón je tradičný bežecký závod v meste Tlmače, ktorý ponúka polmaratónsku trať dlhú 21,1 km a aj 10 km beh pre rekreačných bežcov. Pretek sa koná 2. mája 2026 s štartom o 10:00 hod. pre dospelých a o 9:00 hod. pre deti. Organizátormi sú Mesto Tlmače, MsKS Tlmače, ZŠ a MŠ Tlmače a Atletický klub mesta Tlmače. Bežci dostanú štartovné číslo, športové a propagačné predmety a poukážku na obed. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj hobby beh a nordic walking na 3,5 km a detské behy zdarma.

name: Jarný charitatívny beh Nitra
organizer: Mgr. Lukáš Čelinák, Rotary klub Nitra Harmony
description: Jarný charitatívny beh Nitra je komunitné športové podujatie, ktoré spája pohyb, solidaritu a podporu zdravotníctva v meste Nitra. Beží sa na podporu urgentného príjmu Fakultnej nemocnice Nitra a je organizované Rotary klubom Nitra Harmony spolu s tímom Oktoberfest Run Nitra. Podujatie ponúka rôzne disciplíny vrátane 10 km, 5 km a 1,2 km tratí, pričom je možné sa zapojiť aj tímovo. Bežci tak môžu prispieť k charitatívnemu cieľu a zároveň si užiť športovú atmosféru v Nitre.

name: Sklené sa hýbe
location: Sklené (okr. Turčianske Teplice), Sklené (okr. Turčianske Teplice), futbalové ihrisko
description: Sklené sa hýbe je bežecké podujatie konané na futbalovom ihrisku v Sklenom, okres Turčianske Teplice. Preteká sa na troch tratiach s rôznou dĺžkou a prevýšením: polmaratón (21,5 km, 740 m+), 14 km (420 m+) a 8 km (320 m+). Okrem hlavných kategórií sú pripravené aj detské aktivity. Štart hlavných kategórií je o 10:30 hod., detské behy začínajú o 10:45 hod. Podujatie je súčasťou série Beh tromi krajmi a Beh dvomi krajmi.

name: Plesnivec VerticalRun
location: Parkovisko chata Plesnivec - Tatranská Kotlina, Parkovisko chata Plesnivec - Tatranská Kotlina, Parkovisko chata Plesnivec - Tatranská Kotlina
description: Plesnivec VerticalRun je horský beh s dĺžkou 5 km a prevýšením 530 metrov, ktorý sa koná 2. mája 2026 v Tatranskej Kotline pri chate Plesnivec. Bežci si užijú náročný vertikálny profil trate, ktorý preverí ich kondíciu a vytrvalosť. Registrácia prebieha online a zabezpečuje zaradenie na štartovaciu listinu po úhrade štartovného poplatku. Podujatie je vhodné pre všetkých milovníkov horského behu, ktorí hľadajú výzvu v krásnom prírodnom prostredí.

name: Beh oslobodenia obce Budča
location: Budča, okr. Zvolen, Budča, okr. Zvolen, pred Obecným úradom
description: Beh oslobodenia obce Budča je tradičný bežecký pretek, ktorý sa koná v obci Budča s cieľom pripomenúť oslobodenie obce. Hlavný beh má dĺžku 8,4 km s prevýšením 232 metrov a vedie okolo obce cez lesné cesty a asfalt, so štartom a cieľom pri obecnom úrade. Súčasťou podujatia sú aj detské kategórie s kratšími traťami prispôsobenými veku pretekárov a kategória "Kolo pre zdravie" určená pre všetkých bez rozdielu veku a výkonnosti. Pretek je súčasťou Zvolenskej bežeckej ligy a ponúka elektronické meranie časov, občerstvenie a medaily pre účastníkov.

name: SHELMA Brnišťský půlmaraton

price_tiers.distance: hlavní závody (21,1 km, 10,55 km, štafety, Nordic Walking, běh na 3300 m)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Při včasné registraci do 31. 3. 2027 obdrží každý závodník funkční triko s logem BPM

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registrace na dětské závody možná i v den závodu, cena se nemění

description: The SHELMA Brniště Half Marathon is a traditional running race set in the beautiful Podralsko countryside, offering several events, including a half marathon, shorter runs, relays and Nordic Walking. The route passes through the village of Brniště, along the Hastrman Trail, around ponds and through the forest, with a surface that is approximately half asphalt and half trail. The event is suitable for all age groups, including children’s races, and offers a friendly atmosphere and quality facilities for competitors. The race pack includes a T-shirt, medal, refreshments and other gifts from sponsors.
course_highlights: The route passes through the village of Brniště, along the Hastrman Trail, and past ponds and grazing horses
The course surface is approximately half asphalt and half trail
There are three refreshment stations on the course, including a new station in the village square by the Ekocentrum Včelín
additional: The first children’s race starts at 10:00, and the main race starts at 12:00. Facilities include changing rooms with showers, baggage storage, three refreshment stations (at the finish, in the village square and at the Velký Grunov sports field) and a water station on the course (at the 8th km). The course is marked with colored arrows, and race marshals are stationed at intersections. Competitors run at their own risk; traffic is partially permitted, with restrictions. The program also includes children’s races and Nordic Walking.

name: Memoriál Karla Raise

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registrace do čtvrtka 30.4. 2026 do 20:00, platba převodem

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné lidového běhu 50,- Kč, registrace do 30.4.2026 do 20:00

description: The Karel Rais Memorial is a traditional road race organized by the ELNA Počerady Athletics Sports Club in Louny. The race takes place on closed roads along a certified 15 km course that descends from an elevation of 219 m to 178 m. The program also includes a roller-skating race and a fun run for all ages and fitness levels. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and an accompanying cultural program, and is suitable for the general public and sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Course on closed class II and III roads, with no motor vehicle traffic
AIMS-measured certified course, 15 km long
Start at an elevation of 219 m; finish at an elevation of 178 m
additional: Race-day registration takes place from 7:30 to 9:30 in Pavilion B at the exhibition grounds in Masaryk Gardens. Changing rooms and showers are available at the swimming pool sauna next to the exhibition grounds. Personal belongings are transported by van from the start to the finish. The race starts in four waves according to category. Buses to the start run from 9:30 from the car park in front of the Municipal Swimming Pool in Louny. The fun run starts at 10:45 and is open to all ages and fitness levels, including participants on roller skates, in strollers, or in wheelchairs. All fun-run participants receive a T-shirt and can enter a prize draw with valuable prizes. The day also includes a Children’s Day with athletics competitions and a cultural program. Facilities, including changing rooms and showers, are available at the finish; the organizers provide transport to the start.

name: Maloskalský půlmaraton
location: Žlutá plovárna, Malá Skála, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: The Maloskalský Half Marathon is a traditional running race on a scenic route from Malá Skála to Turnov and back. The race offers a half-marathon course with approximately 25 metres of elevation gain and a surface combining asphalt, gravel and farm tracks. It starts in the afternoon at Žlutá plovárna in Malá Skála. Runners can enjoy refreshments along the course and at the finish, a medal and other services. The race is suitable for runners across a wide range of ages and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organisation.
course_highlights: 21.098 km course with approximately 25 m of elevation gain
Surface: 80% asphalt, 10% gravel, 10% farm track
The route follows a cycle path and hiking trail, crossing a railway footbridge and passing Hrubý Rohozec Chateau
additional: The half marathon starts at 17:00; the 10 km race starts at 17:10. The race is at capacity, and on-site registration is not available. The entry fee includes a race number, with the option to have your name printed on it if you register by 26 April; STOPNITO chip timing; refreshments along the course and at the finish (water, isotonic drinks, glucose tablets, salt, homemade cakes, bananas, oranges and a bottle of Mattoni); a metal finisher’s medal; baggage storage; small gifts from sponsors; medical services; and a race photo gallery. Race-day registration is open from 14:45 to 16:40, and baggage storage closes at 16:40. A T-shirt with the race logo can be added to your order at Stopnito.cz. Parking is available at the central car park by the GBO petrol station in Malá Skála. According to the available description, the race provides chip timing, refreshments along the course and at the finish, baggage storage and medical services.

name: K6 Czech Ultramarathon Festival
location: Konstantinovy Lázně, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The K6 Czech Ultramarathon Festival is a prestigious ultramarathon held in Konstantinovy Lázně, featuring six races on a 2,854-metre loop. The longest event is a six-day race that attracts ultramarathon runners from many countries. In 2026, the 24-hour race will also be the Czech Republic Championship. The event offers a challenge for experienced runners and the experience of long-distance road running.
course_highlights: A 2,854-metre loop in Konstantinovy Lázně
The longest race lasts six days
The 24-hour race is the Czech Republic Championship
additional: The race is held on roads and includes several timed events: 24 hours, 48 hours, 72 hours and 144 hours. The organizer is Rumning klap z.s. The first event starts at 12:00. In 2026, the 24-hour race will also be the Czech Republic Championship.

name: Otrokovická 100
location: Otrokovice, Zlín District, Zlín Region, Czech Republic
description: Otrokovická 100 is a traditional long-distance walk in the Moravian-Silesian Region, offering a challenging 100 km route and a shorter 50 km option. The event is for experienced hikers and athletes looking to test their endurance and navigation skills in beautiful natural surroundings. Both the start and finish are in Otrokovice, and the route crosses varied terrain with GPS tracking available. The event is part of a series of timed long-distance walks with a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 100 km and 50 km routes in the Moravian-Silesian Region
Challenging terrain with varied surfaces and scenic views
GPS tracking to follow participants
additional: A total of 578 runners registered in 2026. The event is part of a series of timed long-distance walks with GPS tracking.

name: Kokina běh
location: Horka nad Moravou, Olomouc District, Czech Republic
description: The Kokina Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc and held in Horka nad Moravou. It is part of the Olomouc Region Grand Prix of Endurance Runners series and offers an opportunity for both recreational and competitive runners. The Liga stovkařů Olomouc club is known for its long-standing tradition of promoting endurance running and organizes several races in the region. The race is suitable for the general public and supports the running community in Central Moravia.

name: Přespolní běh Říp - Roudnice nad Labem
location: Tyršův stadion, Roudnice nad Labem, Czech Republic
organizer: T. J. Sokol Roudnice nad Labem
description: The Říp Cross-Country Run in Roudnice nad Labem is a traditional athletics event organized by T. J. Sokol Roudnice nad Labem. The race offers various distances for children, youth and adults, including challenging runs up Mount Říp and a longer endurance course. The start and registration take place at Tyrš Stadium, where a friendly atmosphere and sporting spirit prevail. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes outdoor activity and community gatherings.
course_highlights: Various distances, from 300 m for preschool children to 15,200 m for endurance runners
A challenging 8,700 m run up Mount Říp for men, women and veterans
Start and finish at Tyrš Stadium, with courses passing through Alej Sv. Čecha and by the small cross
additional: Registration is from 8:00 at Tyrš Stadium: until 8:45 for children and youth, and until 9:30 for adults. Entry fees are paid at registration. Categories are divided by age and course distance, with separate categories for women’s mile runners and women veterans in the 8,700 m race. The event is part of Sokol Roudnice nad Labem’s traditional sports program. According to the available information, entry fees are paid at registration.

name: Běh Klobasnou
location: Stadium TJ Lokomotiva, Veselí nad Lužnicí, Czech Republic
description: The Klobasna Run is a traditional running race organised by the TJ Lokomotiva Veselí nad Lužnicí athletics club. The race is open to the general public, including children and adults, and offers various categories and distances. The race starts at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium in Veselí nad Lužnicí. Participants can look forward to a pleasant atmosphere, awards for the top runners and a programme of activities for children. The race is part of the rich running tradition of the South Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the TJ Lokomotiva Veselí nad Lužnicí stadium
Categories for all age groups, from preparatory classes to adults
Short children’s races take place directly on the stadium grounds
additional: Athletes from Veselí nad Lužnicí can enter for free. An inflatable castle and face painting are available for children. All participants in the children’s categories receive a medal and refreshments at the finish. Parking is available in the sports complex. The race starts at the TJ Lokomotiva Veselí nad Lužnicí stadium.

name: II. Mohácsi Gőcze Trail
description: A II. Mohácsi Gőcze Trail egy szabadidős futóverseny, amely 2026. május 2-án kerül megrendezésre Mohácson, a Szőlőhegyi rendezvénytéren. A verseny a Mohácsi-dombság ösvényein zajlik, és különböző távokat kínál minden korosztálynak, az 500 méteres gyerekfutamtól a 22 km-es távig. A rendezvény családbarát, egészségügyi biztosítással és díjazással várja a résztvevőket, akik chipes időméréssel mérhetik idejüket. A versenyzők közös bemelegítésen vehetnek részt a rajt előtt, és a részvétel saját felelősségre történik.

name: MOHÁCSI GÖCZE TRAIL (2.)
description: A Mohácsi Gőcze Trail egy terepfutó verseny, amely a Mohácsi Szőlőhegyi rendezvénytéren kerül megrendezésre. A versenyen minden célba érkező fém befutóérmet kap, és a távonként, nemenként az első három helyezett egyedi díjazásban részesül, beleértve a gyermek futamokat is. A rendezvény a futás és a közösség erejét hirdeti, és a résztvevők számára kiváló minőséget és alacsony árakat biztosít. A verseny 21 km-es távon zajlik, amely Ötpróba pontokat is ér. A szervezők a futás testi és lelki egészségre gyakorolt pozitív hatásait hangsúlyozzák.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 4. kolo
description: Beh 2 míle Bratislava je pravidelný bežecký závod na vzdialenosť 2 míle (3,218 km), ktorý sa koná v areáli kúpaliska Kuchajda v Bratislave. Organizuje ho Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team a je určený pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov. Registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste v deň preteku od 9:30, štart je o 10:00. Súťaž je súčasťou série pretekov, kde bežci zbierajú body do putovného pohára podľa kategórií a výkonov.

name: Beh 2 míle
description: Beh 2 míle v Bratislave pri Kuchajde je pravidelný bežecký závod na vzdialenosť 2 míle (3,218 km), organizovaný Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamom. Prezentácia a registrácia prebieha priamo na mieste pri volejbalovom ihrisku od 9:30, štart je o 10:00 hod. Závod je otvorený pre rôzne vekové kategórie vrátane detí, juniorov, žien, mužov a veteránov. Súťaž je súčasťou putovného pohára Sri Chinmoy Marathon Teamu, kde sa výsledné časy prepočítavajú podľa vekových koeficientov a pretekári sú bodovaní podľa účasti a výkonov.

name: Stropkovská dvadsiatka
description: Stropkovská dvadsiatka je tradičný cestný bežecký pretek s bohatou históriou od roku 1977, ktorý sa koná v meste Stropkov. Trať vedie cez niekoľko obcí a ponúka bežcom možnosť súťažiť na 20 km vzdialenosti s občerstvením na trati a v cieli. Podujatie organizuje Klub Bežcov Stropkov, ktorý sa stará o rozvoj bežeckého hnutia v regióne. Bežci môžu očakávať kvalitnú organizáciu, štartovné balíčky a možnosť regenerácie po behu v krytej plavárni. Pretek je súčasťou Oblastnej bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance.

name: Stropkovská desiatka a  I. ročník Barefoot
location: Stropkov, Stropkov, Námestie SNP v Stropkove
description: Stropkovská desiatka a I. ročník Barefoot sú súčasťou tradičných cestných bežeckých pretekov v Stropkove, ktoré majú bohatú históriu od roku 1977. Podujatie organizuje Klub Bežcov Stropkov s cieľom podporiť bežecké hnutie v regióne a na Slovensku. Bežci môžu očakávať kvalitne pripravené trate s atmosférou, ktorú každoročne vytvárajú stovky fanúšikov a bežcov. Okrem hlavného behu je súčasťou programu aj beh na boso, ktorý prináša nový zážitok pre účastníkov.

name: Mistrovství ČR v maratonu mužů a žen
description: The Czech Republic Men’s and Women’s Marathon Championships is a prestigious race over the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km, held in Prague’s historic city centre, starting in Old Town Square. The race is for men and women over 18 who met the qualifying standards in previous years. It is organised by Juniorský maratonský klub, z.s. in cooperation with RunCzech. Runners can use modern timing services, and a professional photography service is available after the race. The start is traditionally at 08:00 in the morning.
course_highlights: Start and finish in historic Old Town Square in Prague
A 42.195 km route through central Prague
Professional timing and the option to download the GPX route
additional: The race office is open on 1 and 2 May 2026 at the Výstaviště exhibition grounds in Holešovice, in the Křižík Pavilions. Photography is provided by witisi.photo, with the option to pre-order during registration or order after the race. Applications are accepted only from runners who met the qualifying standards between 1 January 2025 and the registration deadline. Participation is subject to the qualifying standards and approval by the technical delegate. The available information relates to the 2025 and 2026 editions, not to the date 9 May 2027.

name: Prague International Marathon 2026
description: The Prague International Marathon is a traditional running race held in Prague’s historic center. The race offers a unique opportunity to run through picturesque streets and past the city’s iconic landmarks. Both the start and finish are in Old Town Square, giving the race a festive atmosphere. The marathon is part of the RunCzech running series and attracts a wide range of runners, from amateurs to professionals.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Old Town Square
The route runs through Prague’s historic center, with views of its landmarks
Firm asphalt surface with minimal elevation changes
additional: Marathon weekend includes accompanying runs such as the LAVAZZA Active Breakfast Run (4.2 km), the dm Family Mile (1.609 km), and the dm bambini run (100–200 m). Photography is provided by witisi.photo and can be pre-ordered during registration or ordered after the race. The time limit and rules are available on the RunCzech website. The race pack and further information are available in the RunCzech mobile app.

name: ORLEN Maraton Praha, MČR v maratonu mužů a žen
description: The ORLEN Prague Marathon is a prestigious race held in Prague’s historic city centre. It also serves as the Czech Republic Marathon Championships for men and women. The race offers runners a unique opportunity to experience the atmosphere of a city rich in history and enjoy beautiful views. The course passes iconic Prague landmarks and is suitable for both experienced and recreational runners. The running weekend also includes companion races for families and children, highlighting the community spirit of the event.
course_highlights: The course runs through Prague’s historic city centre, with views of its landmarks
A flat, fast course profile suitable for setting personal records
Also hosts the Czech Republic Marathon Championships for men and women
additional: The race pack contains everything participants need for the race. Timing is electronic, with official results. Photography is provided by witisi.photo and can be pre-ordered during registration or purchased after the race. The running weekend also includes family and children’s races, an accompanying programme and a virtual package in the RunCzech mobile app.

name: 24. Öntúlszárnyalás maraton
description: A 24. Öntúlszárnyalás maraton 2026. május 3-án kerül megrendezésre a pécsi Malomvölgyi-tónál. Ez a Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team által szervezett futóverseny családias hangulatú, körpályás, amely lehetőséget ad a maratoni és félmaratoni távok teljesítésére. A pálya erdei döngölt és zúzott köves, 30 méter szintkülönbséggel, így változatos terepen mérhetik össze erejüket a résztvevők. A versenyen chip-es időmérés biztosítja a pontos eredményeket, és a frissítőállomások bőséges ellátást nyújtanak.

name: Farkasmályi Dűlő és Pince futás
organizer: Gyöngyösi Triatlon Klub, Farkasmályi Borpincék Egyesület
description: A Farkasmályi Dűlő és Pince futás egy hangulatos terepfutó verseny Gyöngyös Farkasmály dűlősorán, amely a szőlőskertek és borospincék között zajlik. A verseny több távon kínál kihívást, köztük egy rövidebb, kevésbé szintes 3 km-es kört és egy hosszabb, 8,5 km-es emelkedőkkel tarkított kört. A futók élvezhetik a természet közelségét, a pincelátogatásokat és a változatos terepet, amely alkalmas kezdőknek és haladóknak egyaránt. A rendezvényt a GYÖTRI Klub szervezi, amely több évtizedes tapasztalattal bír a sportesemények lebonyolításában.

name: MÁSODSZOR IS CÉLBA ÉRÜNK!
description: A Koraszülöttfutás 2026 egy jótékonysági futóesemény, amely Zalaegerszegről indul és Keszthelyig tart, összesen 66 km-es távon. A futás során a résztvevők gyönyörű zalai tájakon haladnak át, tíz váltóponttal, és a teljes távot chip-es időméréssel követik nyomon. A rendezvény kiemelten támogatja a koraszülötteket, akiknek betétfutása is része az eseménynek. A célban a csapatok együtt érkezhetnek, hogy megosszák az élményt és a sikert. A rajt és a tészta party helyszíne a Zala Zone Járműipari Tesztpálya, a futás pedig május 3-án vasárnap kerül megrendezésre.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Řevnice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 240 Kč (v rámci voucheru na celou sérii 12 závodů)

description: The Berounka Running Series in Řevnice is a race held in beautiful natural surroundings, starting and finishing at the Řevnice Brewery. The route follows a green educational trail for most of its length, is well marked with red-and-white ribbons, and features a combination of long climbs and descents with views of the surrounding fields, meadows, and forests. The race is ideal for runners who want to enjoy a pleasant run through picturesque countryside, with refreshments and a baggage drop available on site. After the race, category winners receive diplomas.
course_highlights: The route mostly follows a green educational trail marked with red-and-white ribbons
Two long climbs, including a stretch past the Forest Theatre to Píšťák Pond
Views of the surrounding fields, meadows, and forests on the descent back to Řevnice
additional: Registration is available online or on site from 17:00; please arrive by 17:30 at the latest. Refreshments and a baggage drop are available on site. The top three finishers in each category receive diplomas. The start and finish are at the Řevnice Brewery; refreshments and a baggage drop are available on site.

name: Běh lesoparkem Praha Hostivař
location: Hostivař Forest Park, Prague 10, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Hostivař Forest Park Run in Prague is a trail race offering two distance options: 3.5 km for women and 7 km for men. The race is part of the SABZO series and takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Hostivař Forest Park in Prague 10. It is suitable for runners seeking a challenge on natural terrain with varied surfaces. Come enjoy a run in beautiful surroundings and test your strength against other runners.
course_highlights: Trail course in Hostivař Forest Park
Two distances: 3.5 km for women and 7 km for men
Part of the SABZO series

name: Žďárák – Čerňák
location: Parking lot by the Church of St. John of Nepomuk on Zelená hora, Žďár nad Sázavou, Czech Republic
description: Čerňák is a trail race along the paths of the Černý les forest around Zelená hora and across meadows towards Vysoké. The 7 km route, with 180 m of elevation gain, features challenging climbs and descents, including two crossings over the summit of Černý les. The race starts and finishes in the car park by the church on Zelená hora, a significant UNESCO site, and offers beautiful views of the town of Žďár nad Sázavou and the surrounding countryside. Trail shoes are recommended, as 90% of the route is off-road and 10% is on asphalt.
course_highlights: The route crosses the summit of Černý les twice and has 180 m of elevation gain
A circuit around the pilgrimage Church of St. John of Nepomuk on Zelená hora (a UNESCO site)
Views of the town of Žďár nad Sázavou and the beauty of Černý les and the area around Konventský Pond
additional: The race starts and finishes in the car park by the church on Zelená hora. The route is marked. Trail shoes are recommended. Photos from the race are available on the club website for 2023, 2024 and 2025. The start and finish are both by the car park at the church on Zelená hora. The entry fee will go towards a charity collection for a sports prosthesis for student Alex Vondra.

name: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice
location: Sportovní hala u Stromovky, České Budějovice, Czech Republic
organizer: Noční běh pro Světlušku České Budějovice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: The Night Run for Světluška in České Budějovice is a charity run supporting people with severe visual impairments. The start is at 9:00 p.m. by the sports hall near Stromovka, and participants can choose between a 2.3 km course (1 lap) and a 4.6 km course (2 laps). The event offers an accompanying programme, including a concert, and registration is available through the GoOut.cz portal. The entry fee is 500 Kč, half of which goes directly to helping people with visual impairments. The event has a limited capacity for participants’ safety and comfort.
course_highlights: Night run with a choice of 2.3 km and 4.6 km courses
Start and finish by the sports hall near Stromovka in České Budějovice
Charity run with an accompanying programme and concert
additional: Registration is through the GoOut.cz portal, where participants can choose an entry option with a headlamp or a sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP and ZTP/P cards can enter free of charge, but are not entitled to a headlamp or headband. A changing room and bag storage are available on site, and refreshments and medical services are provided. The run has a limited capacity for participants’ safety.

name: 2. E.ON Business Run
description: Az E.ON Business Run egy különleges futóesemény, amelyet a Nemzeti Atlétikai Központban rendeznek meg Budapesten. A verseny célja, hogy összehozza a vállalati világ szereplőit és minden érdeklődőt egy közös mozgásélményre, ahol egyéni és csapatszellem is érvényesül. A futók három táv közül választhatnak: 5 km egyéni futás, 3 fős váltó (3x2,7 km) és egy 2 km-es stadiontúra gyaloglás. Az eseményt zene, buli és streetfood kíséri, így a futás után is felejthetetlen élmény várja a résztvevőket.

name: E.ON BUSINESS RUN
description: Az E.ON Business Run egy különleges futóesemény, amelyet 2026. május 6-án rendeznek meg a Nemzeti Atlétikai Központban, Budapesten. A verseny nemcsak a vállalati világ szereplőit, hanem minden érdeklődőt vár, hogy együtt mozogjanak, küzdjenek és bulizzanak. A rendezvény három távon zajlik: egyéni 5 km, 3 fős váltó (3x2,7 km) és egy 2 km-es stadiontúra gyaloglás. A célban egyedi befutóéremmel várják a résztvevőket, és a hangulatról zene, streetfood és esti buli gondoskodik.

name: VSE City run Košice
description: VSE City Run v Košiciach je charitatívny beh s dĺžkou 4 km, ktorý sa koná 7. mája 2026. Podujatie je určené pre širokú verejnosť vrátane detí, študentov, seniorov a zdravotne znevýhodnených osôb, pričom štartovné je venované na podporu Platformy rodín detí so zdravotným znevýhodnením. Beh prebieha v centre Košíc a je známy svojou inkluzívnou atmosférou a komunitným charakterom. Organizátori spolupracujú s Maratónskym klubom Košice a ďalšími partnermi, pričom cieľom je nielen šport, ale aj pomoc rodinám s deťmi so zdravotným znevýhodnením.

name: Varínsky lesný beh
organizer: Žilinský pedál, XIRIS, AUTOSKLO Stehlík, Obec Varín
description: Varínsky lesný beh je bežecké podujatie v podhorí Malej Fatry, ktoré ponúka krásne trasy s výhľadmi na malofatranský hrebeň. Pretekári si môžu vybrať medzi dlhšou trasou s dĺžkou 13,7 km a prevýšením 600 m, alebo kratšou trasou 6,5 km s prevýšením 120 m. Podujatie je vhodné pre bežcov a milovníkov prírody, ktorí si chcú užiť beh v malebnom prostredí. Súčasťou programu sú aj detské preteky a po vyhlásení výsledkov je pripravená tombola. Organizátormi sú Žilinský pedál, XIRIS, AUTOSKLO Stehlík a obec Varín.

name: Memoriál brig. gen. Ľ. Kukorelliho
location: Hanušovce nad Topľou, Hanušovce nad Topľou, Mestský úrad
organizer: Mesto Hanušovce nad Topľou, Mestské kultúrne stredisko mesta Hanušovce nad Topľou, ZO SZPB Hanušovce nad Topľou, Hermanovský bežecký oddiel
description: Memoriál brig. gen. Ľ. Kukorelliho je bežecké podujatie v Hanušovciach nad Topľou, ktoré ponúka kategórie pre mužov, ženy, štafety s rôznym počtom členov a beh pre radosť. Organizátormi sú Mesto Hanušovce nad Topľou, Mestské kultúrne stredisko, ZO SZPB a Hermanovský bežecký oddiel. Pretek je bez štartovného, čo umožňuje širokej verejnosti zúčastniť sa bez finančnej záťaže. Miestom štartu je Mestský úrad v Hanušovciach nad Topľou.

name: Charitatívny beh obcou Bukovec
organizer: Obec Bukovec a občianske združenie Oáza-nádej pre nový život
description: Charitatívny beh obcou Bukovec je tradičná športová udalosť, ktorú organizuje obec Bukovec a jej starostka spolu s poslancami obecného zastupiteľstva. Tento beh sa koná v malebnom prostredí obce Bukovec, ktorá je známa svojou rekreačnou oblasťou s vodnými nádržami a prírodnou krásou. Bežci majú možnosť prežiť príjemný športový zážitok v blízkosti miestneho kostola a zároveň podporiť charitatívne účely. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a prináša komunitný zážitok v pokojnom prostredí.

name: Mistrovství ČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km mužů a žen
description: The Czech Road Running Championships for men and women over 1 mile and 5 km take place in the beautiful surroundings of the spa park in Poděbrady. The course is very fast, with no elevation gain and precisely measured 1 km laps along the spa colonnade, offering ideal conditions for personal records. The race is officially recognized by the Czech Athletics Federation and is part of the prestigious Poděbrady Walking program. The event also features an accompanying program and the chance to receive an original finisher’s medal featuring the spa fountain.
course_highlights: 5 km race over five 1 km laps along the spa colonnade
1 mile race featuring an opening 609 m section and a 1 km lap along the spa colonnade
Very fast, flat course certified for the European Race Walking Championships
additional: Registration is available online only, with payment due within 7 days of registering. Late registrations will have no name printed on the race bib. On-site registration is available until 30 minutes before the race starts. Registration can be transferred free of charge until 21.4.2026; a fee applies after that date. Finisher’s medal featuring the spa fountain. Accompanying program throughout the day along the spa colonnade. Available information about the program, registration, and prices applies to the 2026 edition; details for the date 14. 5. 2027 have not been confirmed.

name: Běh vítězství zámeckým parkem Lány
location: Zámecký park Lány, Lány, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Sokol Lány a Základní škola Charlotty Garrigue Masarykové
description: The Victory Run through the Lány Castle Park is a traditional race with a history dating back to 1972. It is held annually on May 7 in the castle park in Lány. The race offers a wide range of categories for children and adults, with distances from 60 to 7,800 metres, running mainly on gravel paths and grass. It is organised by TJ Sokol Lány and Charlotta Garrigue Masaryk Primary School in Lány under the auspices of the Municipality of Lány. The race is suitable for all ages and takes place in the pleasant surroundings of a beautiful park.
course_highlights: The courses run mainly on gravel paths and grass in the castle park
The main race follows the 3,900 m red loop; men run two laps and women one
Children’s distances range from 60 m to 1,500 m, with loops marked in different colours
additional: You can register online until 14:00 on the day before the race, or in person on race day, no later than 30 minutes before your category’s start. Check-in takes place on race day from 7:30 at the main entrance to the castle park, below the castle greenhouse. Race numbers are collected at check-in, and participants line up at the start 5 minutes before their category starts. Participants in the “Run for Health” do not pay an entry fee. The race is traditionally held on May 8; the listed date for the 2027 edition is May 7.

name: Čavisovská stovka
location: TJ Sokol sports field, Čavisov, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Čavisovská Stovka is a long-distance walk in the area around Čavisov, with routes of 30, 50 and 100 km. This traditional event offers routes of varying difficulty, from a relaxed 30 km route and a challenging 50 km route to the royal 100 km route for experienced participants. The start and finish are at the TJ Sokol sports field in Čavisov. The event is suitable for athletes who want to experience the beauty of the Moravian-Silesian Region on a long-distance walk.
course_highlights: 30, 50 and 100 km routes around Čavisov
Royal 100 km route for experienced participants
Start and finish at the TJ Sokol sports field in Čavisov
additional: The routes are divided into a relaxed 30 km route, a challenging 50 km route and a royal 100 km route. GPS coordinates for the start and finish: 49° 49' 47.4'' N, 18° 04' 59.1'' E. Registration is via a form on the website, which opens automatically once the time interval has elapsed. Tourist and aerial maps, as well as the route elevation profile, are available on the website. The organizers provide refreshments, toilets and a shower at the start. Participants may bring dogs, with no time limit.

name: Memoriál obětí fašizmu Čechtice
location: Čechtice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Memoriál obětí fašizmu Čechtice is a 6 km running race on trails around the town of Čechtice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup and gives runners the chance to test themselves in a natural setting with some gentle terrain challenges. The event is suitable for running enthusiasts looking for a quality race with a regional tradition.
course_highlights: Trail course around the town of Čechtice
Race distance: 6 km
Part of the Běžec Podblanicka Cup

name: Strážnická stovka
location: Strážnice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné dle datumu přihlášení (pouze pro prvních 150 registrací)

description: Strážnická Hundred is an extreme 100 km ultra trail marathon through the beautiful countryside of the White Carpathians in the heart of South Moravia. This race is only for people over 18 and requires real determination and physical fitness. The course is carefully marked, and runners have access to aid stations and the option to have drop bags transported. The entry fee includes an original race bib with the runner’s name and a metal badge as a reward for pushing their limits. The event offers two start waves with time limits of 15 and 24 hours, so everyone can choose their race goal.
course_highlights: The route passes through the beautiful countryside of the White Carpathians and the heart of South Moravia
The course is marked with red flags, spray-painted arrows and reflective stickers
Aid stations and the option to have drop bags transported to the Května aid station
additional: The race offers two start waves: the 24-hour time limit starts on Friday at 19:30, and the 15-hour time limit starts on Saturday at 5:00. Check-in takes place on Friday from 17:00 to 19:00; reserves should report at 18:45. Drop bags must be smaller than 30 L, labelled with the race number and handed in on Friday at 18:45. After the race, belongings can be collected from Saturday at 14:00. The entry fee includes refreshments at the race venue and aid stations, an original race bib with the runner’s name, and a logo T-shirt (if ordered). Runners receive their race number and chip at check-in. A race bib with the runner’s name is not included in the entry fee for the first 150 registrations. The race is only for people over 18.

name: Poděbrady Running - MČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km a veřejný běh na 5 km
description: Poděbrady Running is the inaugural open Czech Republic Championship in the road mile and 5 km, complemented by a public 5 km run. The race takes place in the picturesque setting of the spa colonnade in Poděbrady and features certified, very fast and flat courses, ideal for setting personal records. Come and run alongside the best Czech runners and enjoy the atmosphere of a high-quality road race. Organized by the Czech Athletics Federation with the support of the running community.
course_highlights: Certified courses suited to fast times
A very fast and flat course
Picturesque surroundings of the spa colonnade in Poděbrady
additional: The first and main category starts at 12:00. The organizer is the Czech Athletics Federation. The course is certified and suitable for attempts at personal records. The race is part of the official Czech Running calendar.

name: Běh osvobození
location: Lišany, Rakovník District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: SK Lišany, z.s. / TJ Sokol Díly
description: The Běh osvobození (Liberation Run) is a traditional 7 km road race between the villages of Lišany and Lužná, held on a low-traffic third-class road. It has a long history dating back to 1972 and is also known as the Lišany Road Seven. The race starts in Lišany, follows a route to Lužná and back, and finishes in front of the U Hřiště restaurant. The race is divided into six age categories and is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runners’ Cup. Cash prizes and bonuses motivate competitors to beat the course records.
course_highlights: A 7 km route along the low-traffic Lišany–Lužná–Lišany third-class road
Start and finish by the U Hřiště restaurant in Lišany
Bonuses for the first approximately 500 m and cash prizes for winners and record-breakers
additional: Race registration opens at 9:30 at the U Hřiště restaurant (Sokol hall) in Lišany and closes 30 minutes before the start. Competitors walk to the start in front of the municipal office. The results ceremony is at approximately 12:30. The race has four men’s and two women’s categories. Cash prizes of up to CZK 19,900. Protests may be submitted within 15 minutes after the race with a deposit of CZK 200.

name: Memoriál otce Jožky
location: Stěbořice, Opava District, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Orel jednota Stěbořice, Farnost Stěbořice, Obec Stěbořice
description: The Father Jožka Memorial is a traditional running race held in the village of Stěbořice, honoring the memory of priest Josef Motyka. The race offers various distances for men, women, seniors, and children, including a main course of over 10 km and shorter circuits of around 4 km. The event is organized by local organizations and is suitable for the general public looking to enjoy a day of sport in the pleasant surroundings of the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race has a long tradition and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: Main course of over 10 km, with different categories (men, women, 50+)
Short courses of around 4 km for different age groups, including boys and girls
Special 100 m races for preschoolers
additional: The race is organized by Orel jednota Stěbořice, the Stěbořice Parish, and the Municipality of Stěbořice. Course maps and event posters are available. The race has multiple age- and gender-based categories, including categories for seniors and children. Race records are kept for individual categories.

name: Běh Černou Horou
location: Zámek Černá Hora, Černá Hora, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Běh Černou Horou is the fourth-oldest cross-country running race in the Czech Republic, with its first edition held in 1928.
