description: Slapy Trail Maniacs is a challenging trail race in the picturesque surroundings of the Slapy Reservoir in the Central Bohemian Region. It offers three courses of 61 km, 47 km, and 33 km, crossing rugged terrain with significant elevation gain. The race is suited to experienced runners looking to test their abilities in nature and earn points toward their UTMB Index. The race hub is in the village of Cholín; start times vary by course and take place on Saturday. The organizers also provide accommodation and refreshments during the race.
course_highlights: 61 km course with 2,300 m of ascent and 2,400 m of descent
47 km course with 1,850 m of ascent and descent
Scenic routes around the Slapy Reservoir with technical sections
additional: The 61 km race starts at 7:00 in Nečín, the 47 km race starts at 9:00 in Cholín, and the 33 km race starts at 12:00 by the Živohošť Bridge. The race cutoff is 23:00 in Cholín. Accommodation is available for 250 Kč per night in a bed, or on a sleeping mat in the common room. Registration changes are free until 12 October 2025; after that, a 100 Kč fee applies. The terrain includes trails, off-trail sections, rocky areas, and climbs. The race offers accommodation, set start times and cutoffs, and contributes to the UTMB Index.

name: Olomoucký kros
location: Stadion AK Olomouc, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Olomouc Cross is a traditional cross-country race organized by AK Olomouc and held at the AK Olomouc stadium. The race features a challenging 9 km off-road course that tests runners’ endurance and strength. The main category starts at 10:15, and the race is part of the official Czech Running calendar under the Czech Athletics Federation. The organizers invite runners of all levels to take part in this popular event in Olomouc.
course_highlights: 9 km cross-country course on off-road terrain
Start and finish at the AK Olomouc stadium
Challenging terrain suited to endurance runners
additional: The race is held at the AK Olomouc stadium; registration and further details are not specified.

name: Skalička run
description: Skalička Run is an off-road running event set in the picturesque valley of the Lubě stream in South Moravia. It offers three interconnected routes of 7, 13 and 22 kilometres, running mostly through forests and meadows along hiking trails and cycle paths. The route is gently undulating, with a few hills, and is suitable for recreational runners and those who prefer a relaxed pace and want to enjoy the beautiful countryside and colourful autumn scenery. The course is well marked, and the stream crossings are shallow and easy to get across. During the race, it is possible to switch to a shorter distance.
course_highlights: Off-road route running mostly through forests and meadows, away from paved roads
The longest route is 22 km, with three interconnected loops and a moderate elevation gain of 436 m
Autumn run over fallen leaves, with a well-marked course and shallow stream crossings
additional: During the race, it is possible to switch to a shorter distance. The course is thoroughly marked with arrows and trail ribbons. The stream crossings are shallow and can be crossed with dry feet using a footbridge. The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. Trail running; registration details are not specified; an autumn race with a beautiful natural atmosphere.

name: Leskros Hradečák
location: Hradec Králové, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Hradečák is part of the Leskros series, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and running in nature. The race offers various running categories, including a half marathon, a 10K, and shorter distances for children and young people. It also includes canicross categories for different age groups and experience levels. The race takes place in the beautiful forest surroundings of Hradec Králové and is suitable for the whole family, including beginner runners.
course_highlights: GELOREN and MIZUNO forest routes of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km)
Canicross distances from 1 km for children up to 4 km for experienced competitors
Aid stations along the course and at the finish, chip timing, and a unique finisher’s medal
additional: The entry fee includes a unique finisher’s medal, a Speedcup cup, chip timing, drinks, refreshments, a race photo, gifts from partners, and parking arrangements. Canicross equipment can be borrowed by prior arrangement. Categories for children and adults, including junior and non-competitive categories for beginners. Aid stations along the course and at the finish, prize money for elite canicross competitors. Trail running and canicross, categories for children and adults, registration opens in December, the event includes charity activities and the option to borrow equipment.

name: KEEN Prague Park Race – Prokopské údolí
description: KEEN Prague Park Race in Prokopské údolí is a running race in beautiful natural surroundings within sight of Prague. The race offers a unique atmosphere and a course through a picturesque valley on both natural and paved paths. Prokopské údolí is an ideal place for nature-loving runners who want to take on a sporting challenge in peaceful, scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: The course follows paved and unpaved paths in Prokopské údolí
Natural terrain with picturesque views and scenic sections
A race near the city of Prague, with the atmosphere of a nature park
additional: The course is accessible as part of the race; no wave divisions or capacity limits are specified. After registering, participants will receive payment instructions by email. The race is part of the Prague Park Race series, which also includes races in Průhonice Park, Divoká Šárka and Konopiště. Trail running, multiple races in various parks in Prague, online registration, pre-race runs and events featuring KEEN shoe testing

name: Běhej Valachy
description: Běhej Valachy is a traditional running race held in the picturesque setting of Velké Karlovice and the surrounding area in the Beskydy Mountains. The race gives athletes of all ages and fitness levels the chance to test themselves in beautiful countryside, with views of the hills of Wallachia. Since 2013, it has been part of the Valachy Tour series, which offers attractive prizes and prize money. Come and enjoy a run in the heart of Wallachia and experience the unique atmosphere of this sporting celebration.
course_highlights: Picturesque valley of Velké Karlovice and the surrounding area
Running in the Beskydy countryside among the hills of Wallachia
Traditional race with a long history, part of the series since 2013
additional: The race is part of the Valachy Tour series, which offers events in various disciplines for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers are MORAVIA EVENTS s.r.o. and BESKYDY OUTDOOR s.r.o. The race director can be reached at +420 602 275 790. The race routes follow paved roads and forest trails, with the option to relax in thermal pools. Registration opens at 8:00, and races start at 9:30. Course maps are available on mapy.cz.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka Ostrava
description: The Golden Emil Zátopek Marathon Ostrava is a prestigious running event held on a fast, certified course in Ostrava. The event offers a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race and mixed team race, and welcomes every runner, whether a beginner or an experienced athlete. The atmosphere is professional, with world-class elite runners and extensive facilities including refreshments, music and sports shopping. The course is one loop, with the start and finish at the famous Vítkovice Stadium, where Emil Zátopek set his records.
course_highlights: Fast, certified course in Ostrava
Start and finish at Vítkovice Stadium
The chance to run alongside the world’s elite runners
additional: Race entry can also be purchased on-site in cash or by QR code during registration. The race pack includes an original Macron technical T-shirt, a finisher’s medal, refreshments during and after the race, a large expo, and free taping and physiotherapy care. The race takes place on a one-loop course, with partial traffic restrictions in effect during the event from 8:50 to 15:00. The event includes various categories, including relay races, and supports charitable activities. It is held with the support of the City of Ostrava and the Moravian-Silesian Region.

description: Moravská Sázava Ultra 50 is a challenging 50 km ultramarathon that follows the valley of the Moravská Sázava River from Zábřeh through Lázek to the river’s source on Buková hora. The route offers beautiful natural scenery, including Březná Nature Park and the Suchý vrch–Buková hora Nature Reserve, where the race also finishes. The total elevation change is 698 metres of descent and 1,369 metres of ascent. The race base is at Horský Resort Buková Hora, where runners can rest and refresh themselves after finishing. The race is suitable for runners looking for a challenge beyond a standard marathon but who do not want to take on an extreme 100 km mountain course.
course_highlights: The route follows the course of the Moravská Sázava River
Březná Nature Park and the Suchý vrch–Buková hora Nature Reserve
Finish at the summit of Buková hora, with 1,369 m of ascent
additional: Participants can hand in their own refreshment bags to be transported to the aid stations. Support is available only at aid stations. Check-in is from 10:00 at the start in the Zábřeh skatepark. Aid stations also serve as relay handover points. Soup with pasta is provided at the finish. Results are recorded both electronically and manually; the relay baton is a GPS tracker with online tracking. Participants can hand in labelled bags for the aid stations at the start. Personal support is allowed only at aid stations.

name: NN Night Run Olomouc

price_tiers.distance: BELLIS RUN proti rakovině prsu - 5 Km

description: NN Night Run Olomouc is the largest running event in Olomouc, held at the Flora Exhibition Centre. The event offers a 10 km night run, a 2 × 5 km relay, a 5 km charity run, and a 3 km family run, including children’s races. It brings an unforgettable atmosphere, a varied programme of activities, and support for charitable projects. Every participant receives a commemorative medal and can enjoy running through the city at night by the light of headlamps.
course_highlights: Night run through Olomouc, with an atmosphere illuminated by headlamps
Distances ranging from 300 m for children to a 10 km night run
Bellis Run charity race supporting the fight against breast cancer
additional: Registration and race-pack collection take place from 13:00 to 17:30, depending on the race. A baggage drop and changing rooms are available. After the race, participants can enjoy activities including a photo booth, face painting, a bouncy castle, and testing and sales of running equipment and nutritional supplements. Entry can be transferred to another participant online or on site for a fee. All participants receive a commemorative medal at the finish. The race facilities are at the Flora Exhibition Centre. Online registration closes on 19 October 2026 at 18:00; on-site registration is subject to available capacity. The time limit for the main race is 90 minutes.

name: Běh kolem Asuánu
location: Jižní konec retenční nádrže Asuán, Jinonice, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Aswan is a traditional cross-country and trail race held on the embankment of the Aswan retention reservoir in Prague 5-Jinonice. It offers courses of varying lengths for all age groups, from the youngest children to adults, over gently rolling terrain with a natural surface, finishing on an asphalt straight. The race is organized by Atletika Stodůlky z.s. and is accessible only on foot from nearby stops. The entry fee is voluntary, enabling broad participation by runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Gently rolling course with a natural surface
Asphalt finishing straight
Loops around the Aswan retention reservoir in Prague 5-Jinonice
additional: The start and race office are at the southern end of the Aswan retention reservoir, accessible only on foot from the Ovčí hájek and Galerie Butovice bus stops and the Volcano complex. Categories are divided by age, with course distances ranging from 250 m for the youngest participants to 3600 m for men. The entry fee is voluntary. The start and race office are at the southern end of the reservoir; they can only be reached on foot. Information about the 2026 edition has not been confirmed in the available sources.

name: Łemkowyna Trail
location: Krynica-Zdrój, Powiat nowotarski, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
distance_verbose: Ultramaraton, 100 km, Ultramaraton, 50 km, Maraton, 28 km, 10 km
description: Łemkowyna Trail is a mountain race along a route marked by the Main Beskid Trail in the Low Beskids. The event takes place around Krynica-Zdrój and Komańcza, offering a range of distances from 10 km to a 150 km ultramarathon. The course features substantial elevation gain and challenging natural terrain, making it a test for trail-running and mountain-adventure enthusiasts. The event has a strong tradition and attracts runners from across Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: Route marked by the Main Beskid Trail
Significant elevation changes of up to +5,860 m and -5,970 m on the longest distance
A range of distances from 10 km to 150 km, with time limits
additional: Participants can switch between courses until October 1, 2026. Participant limits for individual distances range from 300 to 550. Starts are scheduled across October 17 and 18, 2026, with different start times for each distance. Each distance has a time limit. The event takes place on natural mountain trails with substantial elevation changes. Courses include elevation gains of up to 740 m for the 30 km and 150 km ultramarathon distances, with time limits of up to 35 hours. Registration is available online, with options for entry-fee refunds and transfer of race packages.

name: SZÁDVÁR TRAIL
description: The Compressport Szádvár Trail is an exciting trail-running race that winds through the wild, rugged mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst. Participants can discover deer hidden in the forest, a monastery ruin nestled among the trees, the grueling climb up Szádvár, panoramic views from Esztramos Hill, and the atmospheric wine-cellar row near Bódvaszilas. This challenging race welcomes adventure-seekers to Szögliget in October.
course_highlights: The wild, rugged mountains and valleys of the Aggtelek Karst
A monastery ruin nestled among the trees
Panoramic views from Esztramos Hill
additional: The race takes place in October 2026, on varied terrain featuring mountains, valleys, and forests. Participants can register online and enjoy the scenic landscape and challenging course.

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap running race takes place in Dióskert, where participants can complete the half-marathon distance in four laps. Those who would prefer to run fewer laps may do so. The race has a voluntary entry fee of 500 HUF per lap, and registration takes place at the venue. After the race, runners are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine. Every participant receives a finisher’s medal, and the top three male and female finishers also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The race route is four laps covering the half-marathon distance
Participants may complete fewer laps
Location: Törökbálint, Dióskert
additional: Registration takes place at the venue. The suggested voluntary entry fee is 500 HUF per lap. Participants are welcomed with apples, hot tea and mulled wine. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. The top three male and female finishers receive a special medal. Hilly terrain; four laps for a half marathon; options to run fewer laps; refreshments provided; medals for all; awards for top finishers.

Pretek ponúka bežcom možnosť zažiť jesennú atmosféru v príjemnom prostredí amfiteátra a okolia. Organizátori OZ PERUN zabezpečujú kvalitnú prípravu a občerstvenie pre účastníkov. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a bežeckých nadšencov rôznych vekových kategórií.

Štart a cieľ v amfiteátri Bratislava - Rača
Jesenná atmosféra a kvalitné občerstvenie

name: T1 Ring kros
location: Areál T1 ring, Vechec, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia
description: T1 Ring kros je bežecký pretek konaný v areáli T1 ring vo Vecheci, okres Vranov nad Topľou. Pretek ponúka dve hlavné trate - 9 km s prevýšením približne 210 metrov a 4 km trať, pričom súčasťou je aj nesúťažná disciplína Nordic Walking. Súťažiť môžu muži a ženy v rôznych vekových kategóriách, deti majú samostatný štart. Pretek je súčasťou Bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance 2025 a štartuje o 13:00 hod. pre hlavnú kategóriu a o 11:00 hod. pre deti.
course_highlights: 9 km trať s prevýšením cca 210 metrov
4 km hobby trať a Nordic Walking nesúťažná disciplína
Pretek v areáli T1 ring vo Vecheci
additional: Štart detí o 11:00 hod. Kategórie mužov a žien podľa veku. Súčasť Bežeckej ligy Michalovce - Sobrance 2025. Preteky sa konajú v areáli T1 ring, s možnosťou registrácie online aj na mieste, štartovné od 8 do 20 eur, začiatky pretekov o 11:00 a 13:00.

name: Košickopolianska desiatka
description: Košickopolianska desiatka je bežecké podujatie organizované obcou Košická Polianka, ktoré sa koná pred kultúrnym domom v Košickej Polianke. Hlavný pretek štartuje o 13:00 hodine, detské kategórie začínajú o 11:00 hodine. Pretek je rozdelený do viacerých vekových kategórií pre mužov, ženy a deti, čo umožňuje širokú účasť bežcov rôzneho veku. Organizátori vítajú všetkých bežcov, ktorí si chcú užiť športový deň v príjemnom prostredí obce.
course_highlights: Štart a cieľ pred kultúrnym domom v Košickej Polianke
Viacero vekových kategórií pre mužov, ženy a deti
Príjemné prostredie obce Košická Polianka
additional: Detské preteky začínajú o 11:00 hod. Kategórie sú rozdelené podľa veku od 0 rokov až po seniorov. Organizátorom je obec Košická Polianka, kontaktné telefóny a e-maily sú k dispozícii pre záujemcov o informácie. Pretek je súčasťou série ročníkov a ponúka možnosť zúčastniť sa na 10 km trati s rôznymi kategóriami pre všetky vekové skupiny, vrátane detských pretekov.

name: Kobeřický půlmaraton
description: The Kobeřice Half Marathon is a traditional athletics race organized by TJ Sokol Kobeřice, with a long history dating back to 1996. The race is part of the Moravia and Silesia Championships and attracts runners from across the Czech Republic and abroad. The course offers an opportunity for both experienced and recreational runners and is part of a series of public races organized by the athletics club in Kobeřice. The organizers emphasize supporting young people and developing running traditions in the region.
course_highlights: A traditional half-marathon course in Kobeřice, with a history dating back to 1996
Part of the Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championships
Natural and urban sections suitable for runners of different levels
additional: The race is part of a series of three public runs organized by TJ Sokol Kobeřice, including the Winter Run through Kobeřice and the Kobeřice Twenty. The athletics club focuses on young people and has a long-standing tradition in the region. In 1998, the half marathon was included in the Moravia and Silesia Championships; in 2005 and 2009, the half-marathon and veterans' championships were held here. The race is part of the Moravian-Silesian Running Cup and the Prajzsko-Opava Running League, and has a history and tradition in the region.

name: Běh metropole MČ Praha 6
location: Park Ladronka, Praha 6, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Běh Metropole is a series of public running races held in various districts of Prague, aiming to promote a healthy lifestyle and residents’ sense of belonging to their district. The race in Prague 6 takes place in Ladronka Park and is part of the series, where each participant represents their district and contributes to the competition for Prague’s most athletic district. The event is suitable for all ages, including children, seniors, and people with disabilities. The organizers prepare original medals and a welcoming atmosphere for all runners.
course_highlights: Race in Ladronka Park in Prague 6
Running series across Prague’s districts
Promoting a healthy lifestyle and community spirit
additional: Each participant represents their district based on their permanent place of residence and contributes to the districts’ scores in the series. The organizers prepare special medals for each category as a keepsake from the race. Race series with multiple events; terrain details not specified; registration information on the website.

name: Chwałowicki Maraton Napoleoński
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz Rozwoju i Integracji Chwałowic, Arka Tołłoczko, Rafał Malitkowski
description: The Chwałowice Napoleonic Marathon is a small-scale marathon held in the picturesque village of Chwałowice, surrounded by forests and fields. The 42.195 km course follows forest and rural roads in a peaceful, uncrowded setting, with course markings and convenient access. The event is organized by local runners, who prioritize a friendly atmosphere and a recreational experience over competition and prizes. It is an excellent choice for fans of cross-country running in natural surroundings.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km course along forest and rural roads
Start and finish on Polna Street in Chwałowice
Every kilometre marked, with convenient parking
additional: No crowds and a relaxed atmosphere without the pressure of competition. The course is laid out and marked by the “Harcownik” Running Club. Participants can take part in a series of four marathons per year on the same course. The event is friendly and recreational in nature. Napoleonic Marathon, mainly urban parkland terrain, training preparations, online registration, various distances, entries, regulations, GPX routes.

name: XLIV Perła Paprocan
description: The Perła Paprocan Run is a unique marathon around Paprocany Lake in Tychy, combining competition with training over almost any distance. Runners can complete one or more laps of the 7-kilometre loop, up to the full marathon distance. The event is recreational and community-oriented, promoting a healthy lifestyle and a welcoming atmosphere among runners. Tychy is the only city in Poland where a marathon is held twice a year, and Perła Paprocan is one of those editions.
course_highlights: A 7 km loop around Paprocany Lake
Paved sections (over 50%), as well as compacted paths and forest trails
A refreshment point with drinks, fruit, and sweets available after each lap
additional: Start and finish at the Paprocany Holiday Centre, ul. Parkowa 17, Tychy. Race bibs can be collected in the days before the event and on race day. The participant limit is 1111. Runners do not need to declare their distance before the race and can change it during the event. Participants aged 12 and over may take part with the written consent of a parent or guardian. Valuables can be left in the baggage deposit. The event is recreational, and runners must keep to one half of the paths to allow others to overtake. Participation from age 12 with a guardian’s consent, refreshment points with drinks and fruit, a limit of 1111 participants, online registration, and an event held twice a year.

location: Ostrów Wielkopolski, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Botaniczna Piątka – edycja jesienna, Stradomia Dolna
location: Stradomia Dolna, Syców Municipality, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

XIV Pętla Krosowa Grodziskiego Klubu Biegacza

location: Bažantnice v Heřmanově Městci, Heřmanův Městec, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Enamelled Pheasant is a traditional race organized by the Heřmanův Městec Running Club, held in the beautiful surroundings of the pheasantry in Heřmanův Městec. It is the final round of the Mrdice League and gives runners the chance to test themselves over 1,500 metres in a pleasant atmosphere. The event is suitable for all runners looking for a sporting challenge within a friendly club and league.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the pheasantry on natural terrain
A 1,500-metre race serving as the final event of the Mrdice League
The friendly atmosphere of a running club in Heřmanův Městec
additional: The race is part of the Ruler of Mrdice sports league, which includes a series of races and timed training runs throughout the year. The club also holds regular timed runs every Tuesday and other sporting events in the region. The race is part of the Mrdice League; entry is by voluntary contribution. It takes place in the natural surroundings of the pheasantry, and registration and the start list are available online.

name: Sninsky Cross

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Predregistrácia online - 15 Eur(5 Eur na charitatívne účely).

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Registrácia na mieste - 20 Eur(5 Eur na charitatívne účely) v nedeľu 3.11.2024 od 8:30-10:30 (všetci účastníci)

description: Sninský Cross je tradičný bežecký pretek konaný v Amfiteátri RO Rybníky v Snine. Pretekári sa môžu tešiť na kvalitne pripravenú trať s oficiálnym meraním, ktorá vedie mestským okruhom a lesným prostredím. Podujatie je vhodné pre širokú verejnosť a ponúka skvelú atmosféru, občerstvenie a medaile pre všetkých účastníkov. Víťazi v kategóriách mužov a žien získavajú medaile a vecné ceny. Organizátorom je bežecký klub ZasRun, ktorý zabezpečuje aj časomieru a výsledkový servis.
course_highlights: 3 x 2 km mestský okruh na námestí v Snine
Trať vedie lesným prostredím na Zelený dvor a po starej ceste smer Budimír
Povrch asfaltový, trať má oficiálne osvedčenie o premeraní dĺžky trate
additional: Šatňa je k dispozícii v stane, toalety sú v hoteli Kamei, úschovňa vecí je v stane pri registrácii. Každý pretekár musí mať pripevnené štartové číslo na hrudi viditeľne, bez neho nebude čas zaznamenaný. Vyhlasovanie víťazov prebehne bezprostredne po dobehnutí všetkých bežcov priamo na mieste. Preteká sa podľa pravidiel Slovenského atletického zväzu.

name: Běh Komory daňových poradců ČR ... aneb "s daňovým poradcem vás daně nedoběhnou"
description:
5 km (1 kolo)
10 km (2 kola)
Tratě jsou vedeny v okolí Zamilované hájku částečně po asfaltových nebo hlinito-štěrkových, popř. lesních pěšinách. Start je na louce před bistrem Zamilec. Závodníci na 5 km běží jedno kolo, desítkáři dvě. Součástí je závod týmů a dětský závod.

name: Podzimní půlmaraton VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: The VAŠE LIGA Autumn Half Marathon 2026 is a 21.1 km road race taking place on October 28, 2026, in Prague 4-Braník. The course follows the cycle path along the Vltava from Braník to Vrané and back. It is flat and fast, often allowing runners to achieve personal bests. The race offers a relaxed running atmosphere and is suitable for anyone looking to enjoy a pleasant half-marathon in beautiful surroundings. The first category starts at 11:00 on the cycle path by Kempink 2.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on the cycle path along the Vltava
The course runs from Braník to Vrané and back
Beautiful surroundings and the chance to achieve a personal best
additional: The race starts on the cycle path by Kempink 2 in Prague 4-Braník. The race is organized by VAŠE LIGA; the contact person is Petr Lundák. The course is flat and fast, making it suitable for personal bests. A relaxed running atmosphere is guaranteed. The course is measured by a certified course measurer, and the race uses chip timing. It includes refreshments, a medal, a certificate, a shower, toilets, changing facilities, and the option to withdraw up to 24 hours before the start.

name: Náměšťský tvarůžek
location: Náměšť na Hané, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Náměšťský tvarůžek is a four-year running race in Náměšť na Hané, which is part of the Haná Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Grand Prix for Distance Runners. The main race is 9.22 km long and consists of three 2.9 km loops, plus an approach and a run-out. The course runs on asphalt and farm tracks, offering a combination of firm surfaces and natural surroundings. The race is open to different age categories, as well as a recreational run with no age limit, with an emphasis on fair play and participant safety.
course_highlights: Main race: 9.22 km, consisting of three 2.9 km loops
Surface: asphalt and farm tracks
Approach and run-out outside the loop: 518 m in total
additional: Race-day check-in takes place at the venue. Runners must have a chip card with a balance of at least CZK 150, which will be deducted at check-in. The results ceremony will take place at the KVS grounds; results will be published on hanackybeh.cz and liga100.cz. Categories are divided by age and gender, including a recreational run with no age limit. The race offers cash prizes for the top runners, registration is available with a chip card, and the course passes through the scenic surroundings of Náměšť na Hané.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nepomuk
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nepomuk is a fun run with no racing, held on October 28. Routes are available for adults and children. Adults run 3.2 km through the town, mostly on asphalt, while children take a shorter route with off-road obstacles. All participants receive a race pack and a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. The event base is at the local Sokol grounds, with refreshments and a place to leave belongings. The event celebrates the founding of Czechoslovakia and takes place in a friendly atmosphere, with no times or rankings recorded.
course_highlights: Adults run 3.2 km on paved paths and asphalt through the town
Children’s 350 m course features several off-road obstacles near the Sokol hall
Adults run their loop twice; the route passes the polyclinic and housing estate
additional: The race pack includes a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. All participants receive a medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Sports activity stations are set up for children at the event grounds. Parking is available on nearby streets and in the Sokol hall car park. The event base is at the local Sokol grounds, with refreshments and a place to leave belongings. The event is held every year on October 28 and is open to participants from different continents, with online registration available and a race pack that includes a medal. The route passes through town streets, by the polyclinic and the Sokol hall, with parking available nearby.

name: Provodovský běh
location: Provodov, Provodov-Šonov, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 300 Kč (online registrace), 500 Kč (při registraci na místě)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: On-line registrace za zvýhodněné startovné bude ukončena 25.10.2024

late_fee.price: dražší startovné při registraci na místě

description: The Provodov Run is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque surroundings of Provodov in the Zlín Region. The race offers three distances—5, 11 and 21 km—which run mainly along field and forest paths. Shorter age-based courses with free entry are available for children. The event is suitable for the general public and takes place whatever the weather, with an emphasis on safety and fair play.
course_highlights: Trail running mainly along field and forest paths
Three distances of varying difficulty: 5 km, 11 km and 21 km
Children’s courses by age group with free entry
additional: Race registration from 9:00 at Areál mládí and the FC Rak Provodov football pitch. Race starts: 21 km at 11:00, 11 km at 11:05, 5 km at 11:10. Children’s races from 14:00, with age-based categories. Medical supervision provided by members of the Czech Red Cross (ČČK). Entry is free for preschool children and pupils taking part in the children’s races. Each participant runs at their own risk. The organiser reserves the right to make changes or cancel the race in extreme conditions without compensation. Outdoor course; registration online or on site; compliance with road traffic rules and wearing a race number are mandatory. Refreshments and facilities are available at Areál mládí and the FC Rak football pitch.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Březník
location: Údolí Oslavy a Chvojnice, Březník, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné pro dospělé a děti (cena explicitně uvedena na stránce)
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Březník is a fun run with no racing, held on 28 October in the picturesque Oslava and Chvojnice valley. The routes follow paved and forest paths with gentle descents and climbs, ideal for anyone who wants to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia by getting active. Capacity is limited to 20 adults and 30 children, so early online registration is required. At the finish, everyone receives a beautiful medal shaped like the republic and a race pack with gifts from the organizers and partners.
course_highlights: The routes follow paved forest paths with gentle descents and climbs
The run takes place in the Oslava and Chvojnice Valley Nature Reserve
Two main adult routes: 5 km and 6.2 km, with a challenge from ambassador Katarína Pejpková
additional: Finish times are not recorded, and no ranked results list is produced. Capacity is limited to 20 adult and 30 child participants. Toilets are available, course marshals staff the route, a race pack is provided at the event facilities, and a medal shaped like the republic is awarded at the finish. Non-competitive run, routes from 0.6 km to 6.2 km, capacity of 20 for the main race and 30 child participants, accompanying programme, free refreshments, online registration, facilities on private grounds, on the border of the Divoká Oslava reserve

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Děčín
price_range: startovné, ceny u vstupného pro dospělé a děti
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Děčín is a traditional race held on October 28, offering routes for adults and children. The main race is 5 km long and runs through the picturesque city, through the castle gardens and Mariánská louka, across the new bridge with views of the Elbe, and along the Elbe Embankment. Children’s races are offered in two distances: 5 km for older children and 1 km for the youngest, who run along the river and Mariánská louka. The course is flat, with varied sections, and professionally timed. At the finish, participants receive a medal shaped like the republic. The event celebrates the republic and offers a sporting atmosphere for all age groups.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km route through the castle gardens and Mariánská louka
Cross the new bridge with views of the Elbe
Run along the Elbe Embankment and across Tyrš Bridge
additional: The race is professionally timed. At the finish, each participant receives a race pack with a race number and gifts from partners. A beautiful medal shaped like the republic awaits at the finish. The route is suitable for all age groups, including children, who have their own shorter courses. The race includes professional timing, medals, and race packs; routes pass through city landmarks and natural scenery; the event caters to various age groups with different race lengths.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Dolní Újezd
location: Dolní Újezd, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné pro děti je uvedeno, přesná cena není specifikována
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Dolní Újezd is a traditional race held on October 28 to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The main course is 8.9 km long and runs partly alongside the Desná stream, across fields and along the edge of the village, combining paved roads with surfaced forest and field paths. Children can choose a 1.4 km course on paved roads and through the housing estate. Facilities at the Sokol hall include a race pack, refreshments, changing rooms and parking. Everyone receives a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish.
course_highlights: An 8.9 km course with gentle elevation and a mix of paved roads, forest paths and field paths
The route follows the Desná stream for part of the way and crosses the surrounding fields
The 1.4 km children’s courses run on paved roads and through the housing estate
additional: The race pack includes a race bib and gifts from the organizers and partners. All participants receive a medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Facilities at the Sokol hall include changing rooms, refreshments and parking. Timing may be manual or chip-timed, but is not compulsory. Suitable for children and adults. The event takes place in Dolní Újezd, Pardubice Region, on October 28, with online registration available and facilities offering refreshments and parking.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Kutná Hora
location: Sokolák, Oleška, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: Cena u vstupného znamená cenu startovného pro dospělé, snížené pro děti
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Kutná Hora is the first edition of this traditional event, which celebrates the founding of Czechoslovakia on October 28 each year. The race offers a sporting atmosphere and a family-friendly experience in the beautiful surroundings of a city with a rich sporting tradition. The main course is just under six kilometres long, with the start and finish at the Sokol hall, which provides facilities including changing rooms, toilets and refreshments. Safe courses for children are set up on the Sokol hall grounds. Capacity is limited to approximately 155 runners to ensure high-quality organisation and timekeeping.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Sokol hall, with full facilities
Main course of just under 6 km through the city
Safe children’s courses on the Sokol hall grounds, with no need to cross roads
additional: Facilities at the Sokol hall include changing rooms, toilets and refreshments. Capacity is set at approximately 155 runners. The event is organised by a team of 4–5 people, with support from volunteers. The children’s courses are safely located on the Sokol hall grounds. The event is suitable for all age groups and offers various courses, including children’s courses, with online registration and an accompanying programme in Oleška, Central Bohemian Region.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Louňovice pod Blaníkem
location: Louňovice pod Blaníkem, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: T. J. Sokol Louňovice pod Blaníkem
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Louňovice pod Blaníkem is a traditional race held on October 28 to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The main course is 5.6 km long and passes the natural and historic sights of Malý Blaník, including its highest point, where the Chapel of St. Mary Magdalene stands. The race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series and offers a race pack, a medal shaped like the republic, and a raffle for participants in the main race. The start and finish are in the square in front of the château in Louňovice pod Blaníkem. In addition to the main race, children’s courses of 0.4, 0.8, and 1.3 km are available.
course_highlights: The course passes the natural and historic sights of Malý Blaník
Run past the Chapel of St. Mary Magdalene at the highest point of Malý Blaník
A mix of paved, field, and forest paths
additional: All races are electronically timed. After the race, participants in the main race can enter a raffle. Everyone will receive a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. Each participant can collect their race pack at the race facilities. The main race is part of the Běžec Podblanicka running series. An accompanying program and refreshments are provided. The races are electronically timed, free parking is available in the square, and proceeds support charitable projects.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Lužice
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Lužice is a traditional race held on October 28 to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The race is run without mandatory timekeeping; participants receive a starter pack and a beautiful republic-shaped medal at the finish. The main race course is 7.3 km long and runs along roads, paved farm tracks and through a vineyard, past the railway line and Lužák Pond. Shorter children’s courses of 0.2, 0.5 and 1 km are laid on paved surfaces. The race facilities are at the Sokol Hall complex, with changing rooms, showers, toilets and refreshments available.
course_highlights: The course runs along roads, paved farm tracks and through a vineyard
The route passes the railway line and Lužák Pond
Children’s courses run on paved surfaces
additional: The starter pack includes a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. All participants receive a republic-shaped medal at the finish. Facilities at the Sokol Hall complex include changing rooms, toilets, showers and refreshments. Parking is available at the car park by the Sports Hall, approximately 500 m from the complex. Children can enjoy sports activities and games at the venue. Time may be recorded manually or with a timing system, but timekeeping is not mandatory. The course runs along roads, paved farm tracks and through a vineyard. Children can run on paved surfaces. Facilities at the Sokol Hall complex include changing rooms, toilets, showers and refreshments. Parking is approximately 500 m from the complex.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Mníšek pod Brdy
location: Státní zámek Mníšek pod Brdy, Mníšek pod Brdy, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Mníšek pod Brdy is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on 28 October. The race offers a 5 km adult course passing the Sokol Hall, ponds and Hostinec u Káji Maříka, with the start and finish by the state château. Shorter children’s loops are set on a grassy area and are easy, making them suitable for different age groups. Facilities at the start include registration, changing tents, toilets and refreshments, and parking is free. Every participant receives a race pack and a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish.
course_highlights: A 5 km asphalt course passing the Sokol Hall, ponds and Hostinec u Káji Maříka
Children’s loops on a grassy area, with distances of 150 m, 500 m and 1 km
Start and finish by Mníšek pod Brdy State Château
additional: The event is run in RACE format, without the need for timing equipment, but finishing times and a winners’ presentation are provided. At the start, there is a registration tent, changing tents, toilets, refreshments and benches. Free parking is available right by the start. The course is asphalt for up to 1 km; the children’s courses are on grass. The start is by the state château, with registration and refreshments on site. Parking is free. The event has no official timekeeper, but all participants receive a medal.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Nový Bydžov
location: Revoluční tř. 774, Nový Bydžov, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné pro dospělé a děti, přesná cena není uvedena
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Nový Bydžov is a traditional race held on 28 October to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The race offers a 4.8 km course for adults, running from the town along country roads through the village of Humburky and crossing the Cidlina River via two bridges. Shorter 250 m and 420 m races for children take place at the Sportring complex. The race is held in open traffic, with marshals at intersections, and offers a race pack and a republic-shaped medal for all participants.
course_highlights: 4.8 km course with 30% asphalt and 70% country roads
Crossing the Cidlina River via two different bridges
The most challenging section is the climb in the village of Humburky
additional: The race is held in open traffic, with marshals and volunteers at intersections. A cyclist will lead the front runner. The race pack contains a race number and gifts from the organizers and partners. Participants receive a republic-shaped medal at the finish. In bad weather, race-pack collection is in the Sokol hall lobby; in normal conditions, it is outside by the clay court. The awards ceremony for the children’s races will take place shortly after they finish. The 4.8 km route is mostly on country roads. Online registration, refreshments at the finish, parking by the Sokol hall or Penny Market, start at Revoluční třída 774.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Uherský Brod
location: Sokolský stadion, Uherský Brod, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run in Uherský Brod is a traditional race held on 28 October to celebrate the founding of Czechoslovakia. The 5 km main race starts at the Sokol stadium and runs through the city centre, through residential areas and on to a garden colony, past a pond and back to the stadium. Shorter courses of 0.17 km, 0.34 km and 0.8 km are available for children and run around the stadium and nearby park. All participants receive a race pack and a beautiful medal shaped like the republic at the finish. On-site registration is available. Participants under 18 may take part only with the consent of a legal guardian.
course_highlights: The 5 km main course runs through the city centre and residential areas
Past a garden colony and a pond
Children’s courses run around the Sokol stadium and nearby park
additional: The event is run in RACE format, with no need for chip timing, but results and an awards ceremony are provided. Toilets, showers and changing rooms are available at the Sokol stadium, and refreshments are available at the start. Free parking is available in the adjacent car park and around the Sokol hall. No accompanying programme is provided. Courses include 5 km for adults and 170 m, 340 m and 800 m for children; online registration is open until 24 October 2025; the event takes place in Uherský Brod; toilets, showers, changing rooms, refreshments and free parking are available.

name: Sokolský běh republiky - Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: The Sokol Republic Run is an annual celebration of the founding of Czechoslovakia, held on October 28. This run has become a modern tradition that is growing in many places across the Czech Republic and abroad. Participants can choose from various routes for adults and children, which run on both paved roads and forest trails. The event is open to all runners who want to celebrate the founding of the republic through exercise and the joy of running.
course_highlights: The route in Alšovice has a varied profile, with uphill and downhill sections
The course runs on both paved roads and unpaved forest trails
The finish is always at the Sokol hall, where a beautiful medal shaped like the republic awaits

description: What sets the Nieuchwytni Run apart from other events is its regionally unique “moving finish line” format. Participants do not run toward a designated point; instead, they try to stay ahead of the pursuit team for as long as possible. The runners will start at 10:00, and exactly 15 minutes later the “finish line” will set off along the course—a cyclist and a car equipped with professional timing equipment. The moment these vehicles overtake a runner marks the end of their race, and their result is recorded. The pursuit team will gradually increase its speed, from an initial 15 km/h to 35 km/h in the final stage of the race.

name: II Bieg Transgranicznej Przyjaźni
description:
A 5-kilometre main race, a Nordic walking event over the same distance, and shorter races for children in the Young Athlete Zone. The event opens the Polish-Czech Grand Prix series, which concludes a month later in Ludgeřovice.

Course: moderately easy, with a new route this year

We have changed the route compared with the first edition. Four kilometres now run along Teligi and Czarnieckiego streets—on asphalt, with plenty of space and no tight turns. It’s a stretch where you can keep a steady pace from start to finish.

Only the final kilometre goes through post-mining areas. The surface gets uneven, but it’s just five minutes of running—and also the most interesting part of the course. You run through a part of Silesia that is coming back to life.

The total elevation gain is 18 metres, spread across the whole distance. There are no climbs that disrupt your rhythm. It’s a good course for your first-ever five kilometres, and a fair one for anyone looking to test their time—as long as you save some strength for the finish.
additional:
The event is part of the “Pink October” campaign and promotes breast cancer prevention. It is organised by the “Srebrne Nici” Association, with the Czech club BK Ludgeřovice as its partner.

name: XXV Bieg Sobiborski "Ocalić od zapomnienia - uczyć dla przyszłości"
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Włodawie
description: The start is at 12:00 by the Sobibór Museum and Memorial to the Victims, on county road No. 1727L along the Żłobek–Sobibór–Wołczyny section. After approximately 300 m, runners cross the tracks of railway line No. 81 Chełm–Włodawa and run to provincial road 816. They then follow provincial road 816 towards Włodawa. After approximately 8.5 km, runners cross the tracks of railway line No. 81 Chełm–Włodawa again and run through the village of Orchówek to Włodawa, continuing along Okunińska Street, Rynek Street and J. Piłsudski Avenue, with the finish at 4 Szkolna Street.
additional:
“There are places in our country marked especially by the blood of thousands of victims murdered in the cruellest way and in the name of the most despicable of ideologies—the ideology of hatred. One such place is Sobibór, where, in just over a dozen months (1942–1943), the Nazis managed to murder approximately a quarter of a million people, especially people of Jewish nationality.”

The race is an unusual history lesson for society. It contributes to achieving sporting goals and also helps instil in the younger generation a remembrance of the tragic history of the extermination camp in Sobibór.

name: Bieg Wolności Podatkowej
description:
When the tax authorities let up, the race begins! IFIRMA invites you to a special event celebrating Tax Freedom Day and the company’s 25th anniversary. It’s a race for entrepreneurs, IFIRMA customers, and everyone who values being active, independence, and good energy.

On June 13, participants can take on the 5 km or 10 km distance, either in person in Wrocław or virtually from anywhere in Poland. The main event will take place at the Olympic Stadium, and the route follows a scenic loop along the Oder. Flat and scenic—ideal running conditions in the City of a Hundred Bridges.

Every step has extra meaning here. Race participants support the “Na Ratunek Dzieciom z Chorobą Nowotworową” Foundation, showing that the energy of sport can make a real difference to others. It’s a great opportunity to combine physical activity with supporting an important cause.

Participants will also receive a generous race pack prepared by IFIRMA: the official race T-shirt, a finisher’s medal, a race bib, a reusable cup, a sports bag, and a certificate for a tree of their own in the IFIRMA forest in Oleśnica.

Join the 2026 Tax Freedom Run and celebrate freedom actively!
additional: The start and finish will be located by the Pergola at the Olympic Stadium, al. Jana Ignacego Paderewskiego 35, Wrocław.
